project_title_en: Advanced Semiconductor Technologies for IoT Applications(1/4)
institution: 財團法人工業技術研究院電子與光電工業研究所
abstract_zh_plan:
本計畫規劃自FY107起配合工業局推動之政策計畫：「晶片設計與半導體科技研發應用」，連結工業局五大推動重點，以技術研發能量為基礎，將晶片、次系統、系統原型產品一條龍式的串聯起來，建構台灣智慧系統完整產業生態環境，加強半導體產業的競爭力，建構台灣IoT完整產業生態環境。
本計畫研發主軸為：智慧決策晶片(高能效人工智慧處理器晶片、人工智慧模型開發工具與環境、計算儲存一體整合晶片、非揮發運算微控制器晶片、類神經元運算)、異質整合平台(異質整合架構設計、異質整合封裝技術、異質微型元件系統組裝、光電異質整合技術、多功能異質元件檢測技術)
abstract_en_plan:
The Project, “Advanced Semiconductor Technologies for IoT Applications”, has being planned from 2018 which is complementary to the Policy Proposal of the “Research and Development of IC Design and Semiconductor Applications” guided by the Industrial Development Bureau. By leveraging the R&D capabilities of this project and five major priority projects of the Industrial Development Bureau, “Advanced Semiconductor Technologies for IoT Applications Project” aims to vertically integrate a complete industry chain from ICs, subsystems to system prototyping products. Therefore, a thriving intelligence systems ecosystem can be accomplished to strengthen the competitiveness of Taiwan’s semiconductor industry.
The main research focuses of this project are as follows:
(1)The Artificial Intelligent IC: including the Energy Efficient DNN Inference Processor, and AI Integrated Development Environment, Non-volatile computing microcontroller chip, Chip Integration for Processing Near Memory, and Neuromorphic computing
(2)The Heterogeneous Integration Platform: heterogeneous integration Architecture Design, heterogeneous integration packaging technology
System-assembly heterogeneous micro components, Optoelectronic heterogeneous integration technology, Multi-functional metrology for heterogeneous devices

project_title: 疊層Sensor IC整合技術平台先導計畫(1/1)
project_title_en: Smart Sensor IC for Edge Devices(1/1)
institution: 財團法人工業技術研究院{智慧微系統科技中心}
abstract_zh_plan:
物聯網創新應用是未來帶動全球半導體與電子產業再成長的重要推力。 此應用必須倚賴感測器扮演虛實介面角色，搜集外界多樣化資訊，將實境資料轉化為虛擬數位資訊，再透過機器學習與人工智慧，進行資料特徵分析，辨識，與決策等目的。因此感測融合與整合晶片化技術將是物聯網應用擴散與市場競爭所需的必要基礎技術，也是目前國內在半導體與電子產業在未來物聯網應用上的一塊重要拼圖。
    本計畫目標即在開發感測融合與整合的晶片化技術 - 物聯網疊層Sensor IC整合技術。 透過感測融合的晶片化取代現今的Sensor HUB技術，在晶片層級執行感測資訊融合轉換，縮小物聯網感測點（sensor node）的系統尺寸與功耗。 感測融合與整合的晶片化技術，是以基於POST-CMOS之做法出發，透過低溫沈積疊層結構材料於CMOS晶片上，配合設計的線寬微縮，可以維持機械結構的剛性強度，滿足多樣感測器微縮與整合的多樣化目標，同時具備感測融合與智慧化晶片整合的未來產品樣態。
    台灣在這波巨大的物聯網機會與競爭中，必須積極佈局與掌握多樣感測融合與整合晶片競爭技術與關鍵專利，配合自主創新應用的串連，創造物聯網應用新興市場機會，將產業價值根留台灣，並帶動全球晶圓代工新商業機會以及創新產業價值鏈。
abstract_en_plan:
The innovative IoT applications is one of most important market driving force for the global semiconductor and electronics industry to keep growing and progress.  The sensors, are the physical-virtual interface, transform the environment physical information to the digital data. The information (data) can be further cleverly processed to characterization, recognition, decision etc., by the machine learning and artificial intelligent (AI). Therefore, the single chip integration of sensors and data fusion technology is the most crucial technology to increase the competitiveness in the international IoT market.  Besides, for the domestic semiconductor and electronics industry, it could be the most important technical puzzle for the IoT and corresponding applications.  
The target of this project is to develop the single chip integration of sensors and data fusion technology—Build up MEMS Sensor IC for IoT. It not only instead the currently sensor hub technology but also shrink the size and reduce the power consumption owing to the sensor data are fused and transformed at chip level.  The main idea of the single chip integration of sensors and data fusion technology is based on the post-CMOS technology to deposit a sensing structure layer on the CMOS and the mechanical strength can be still sustained.  Besides, it also can be satisfied the future IoT market requirements for the small size and diversification function integration. 
In order to grasp the IoT market opportunities and root the high-value industry in Taiwan, we need to more aggressive on the killer applications development and innovative patent. Furthermore, it is also needed more focus on the critical technology development for single chip integration of sensors and data fusion technology so that the new business opportunity can be expected for semiconductor industry.

project_title: AI領航推動計畫-推動機制與產業洞察(1/4)
project_title_en: AI Pilot Project-promotion mechanisms and industry insights(1/4)
institution: 財團法人資訊工業策進會
abstract_zh_plan:
隨著物聯網帶來巨量數據的蒐集、晶片技術成熟及演算法持續優化等因素，AI相關應用備受各界關注，不僅研究機構如Gartner及麥肯錫顧問公司將AI列為未來重大技術趨勢，先進國家如美國、日本、韓國皆等已將AI納入國家重要發展政策。為鼓勵企業投入人工智慧(Artificial Intelligence，AI)技術研究與發展，使AI在產業生根，深化我國企業長期競爭力與產業發展優勢，政府也有提出4年期的「臺灣AI行動計畫」，並於108年起進行「AI領航推動計畫」。
本計畫包含主要兩大主軸，(1)「AI on Chip」，促進我國AI晶片產業發展，建立AI on Chip計畫籌備小組及研擬具國際競爭之AI晶片目標。團隊針對AI晶片領域歸納四大發展議題，並成立AI on Chip示範計畫工作推動小組，討論發展藍圖及示範計畫推動執行模式與聯盟運作方式，持續對本計畫可執行之發展方向及推動期程進行收斂。透過鼓勵業者籌組AI on Chip聯盟，投入AI軟體及晶片技術發展，進而產出具有國際競爭力的系統應用與創新服務解決方案。(2) 「AI新創領航」，對準國內AI新創產業，研析AI新創領航徵案機制，聚焦利基領域，帶領AI新創企業走向國際商業落地。
此計畫有助提升未來台灣透過扮演AI相關產業之領航角色價值，帶動人才、創新樞紐、場域法規及產業AI化，鼓勵業者導引結合學界單位，投入發展產業所需技術與建構研發網絡，並且發展具有國際競爭力的系統應用與創新服務解決方案，進而落實「台灣AI行動計畫」總體目標。
abstract_en_plan:
The huge amount of data collected by the Internet of Things, coupled with the maturity of the chip technology, and the continuous optimization of algorithms, have drawn a lot of attention to AI-related applications. Therefore, research institutions such as Gartner and McKinsey & Company have listed AI as a major technological trend in the future while countries such as the United States, Japan, and South Korea have also included AI as an important national development policy. To encourage companies to invest in AI technology R&D, increase the implementation of AI in the industry, and deepen the long-term competitiveness and industrial development advantages of enterprises, the Taiwanese government has launched a four-year initiative called "AI Taiwan Action Plan," under which it is set to begin the "AI Pilot Project" in 2019.   
    The project includes two major themes, (1) "AI on Chip", which promotes the development of Taiwan's AI chip industry, establishes the AI on Chip project preparation team and develops the AI chip target with international competition .The dedicated team summarized four major development issues in the AI chip field while establishing the taskforce for the "AI on Chip" demo project to discuss development blueprint, and implementation and cooperation models associated with the demo project. In the future, the team will also monitor the development directions of the project while streamlining the planned schedule. By encouraging the industry to organize the AI on Chip Alliance and investing in AI software and Chip technology development, it will produce internationally competitive system applications and innovative service solutions. (2) "AI startups Pilot", aiming at the domestic AI new venture industry, analyzing the AI new initiative piloting the case mechanism, focusing on the niche field, leading the AI startups to the international business.
    This project will be able to highlight the role of the "AI Taiwan Action Plan" in promoting Taiwan's lead role in AI, racing to amass AI talent, building Taiwan into a hub for AI innovation, liberalizing laws and regulations, and transforming industry with AI. In addition, it will also encourage Taiwanese companies to form flagship teams and continuously invest in AI and IC technologies for Taiwan to come out with internationally competitive system applications and innovative service solutions.

project_title: AI on Chip先導技術研發計畫(1/1)
project_title_en: AI on Chip Technology Pilot Research Project (1/1)
institution: 財團法人工業技術研究院電子與光電工業研究所
abstract_zh_plan:
本規畫即依據AI on Chip籌備小組，針對「半通用AI晶片」、「異質整合AI晶片」、「新興運算架構AI晶片」與「AI晶片軟體編譯環境開發」等四大產業議題所制定的技術發展藍圖，來規劃發展，四大議題發展重點如下所述：
•   半通用AI晶片：發展特定應用的裝置端運算晶片，以協助廠商投入少量多樣市場，並聚焦於前瞻的裝置端學習技術開發。
•   異質整合AI晶片：布局下世代AI晶片封裝技術，發展異質群聚封裝技術、數位-類比混模共通介面、裝置端系統熱控等技術。協助建置台灣共通介面，取得發展地位並與國際鏈結。
•   新興運算架構AI晶片：仿照人腦運算型態，打造記憶體內運算及類比運算技術，並發展前瞻的晶片架構及材料，來大幅突破目前AI晶片的運算效能瓶頸。協助台灣半導體製造業加值既有製造技術，成果亦可帶動後續系統廠在應用上的創新。
•   AI晶片軟體編譯環境開發：提供完整的AI晶片軟體開發模擬環境，協助國內IC設計及系統業者能提前以軟體方式，模擬AI晶片在不同的AI訓練模型及不同編譯器下的效能，構築台灣 AI 軟硬體晶片設計產業鏈。
由於本國半導體產業在AI晶片的起步甚晚，為了縮短追趕的時程，本規畫依AI on Chip籌備小組決議，針對發展藍圖提出1+4年的研發規劃「1(本計畫，FY108)+4年(AI on chip終端智慧發展計畫，FY109-112)」，並以超低功耗AI晶片(FY108-110)，與超高性能AI晶片(FY111-112)，作為全程發展目標，以完成本國產業立足裝置端AI晶片領域的發展策略。本計畫(FY108)為先導計畫，將依據AI on Chip籌備小組決議的先行項目來進行發展規劃，作為未來4年關鍵技術發展的起始點。
abstract_en_plan:
The program is planned according to the technical development roadmap projected by the AI-on-Chip preparatory team with four major topics in the AI industry, which are (a) Domain-specific AI Chip, (b) heterogeneous-integration for AI chip, (c) Emerging Computing Architecture, (d) AI-chip Software Compiler Development. The development focus for each topic is described respectively as follows.
•   Domain-specific AI Chip : To develop the device-side computing chips with specific applications, assist the companies to invest in high-mix/low-volume market, and focus on the prospective device-side learning technologies.
•   Heterogeneous-integration for AI chip : To layout the technologies of next-generation packaging for AI chips, develop side-by-side heterogeneous packaging technology, digital-analog mixed-mode common interface, device-side systematic thermal-control technology, and assist the industry in Taiwan to develop a common interface to acquire a strong position for global connection.
•   Emerging Computing Architecture : To build up computing-in-memory and analog-computing based on the computing patterns of human brains, develop the prospective architecture and materials for AI chip to break through the bottleneck of today’s AI chip, and assist the semiconductor industry in Taiwan to value up the existing manufacturing techniques where the corresponding achievements can drive further innovations for system integrators. 
•   AI-chip Software Compiler Development : To provide a complete environment for Ai-chip software development, assist IC design houses and system integrators to simulate the performance of Ai chip with different AI training models and compilers in advance, and build up the industry chain of AI HW-SW chip design.
Since the development of Ai chip in Taiwan’s semiconductor industry starts comparatively late, the program is proposed with a 1+4 years’research development ( FY108: this project + FY109-112: AI on Chip intelligent terminal development project), targeting on ultra-low-power Ai chip (FY108-110) and ultra-high-performance AI chip (FY111-112) to fulfill the scope of having a strong standpoint in the field of Al chip. This project (FY108), as a pilot project, will plan and develop the priority items according to the resolution by AI-on-Chip preparatory team, as the starting point of the 4-year developments on the key technologies in the future.

project_title: 高效能AI Edge系統國際合作研發與應用計畫 (1/1)
project_title_en: International cooperation in research and development and application of high-performance AI Edge system (1/1)
institution: 財團法人資訊工業策進會
abstract_zh_plan:
本計畫之目的為透過國際技術合作並整合自有軟體技術，共同發展高效率、低功耗之AI通用晶片平台，解決3D地圖動態更新所需之即時高運算需求。
本計畫之執行內容包含有：(一)高效AI Edge系統平台優化：與Arm合作新一代AI運算晶片，進行NPU雛型架構系統軟體研發與驗證，發展AI通用晶片平台；(二)動態環境建構技術發展：與SOLFICE RESEARCH公司(Civil maps)進行動態環境建構技術交流，結合Arm based AI平台，進行feature extraction、localization演算法驗證。
本計畫預期將透過國際合作早期獲得IP技術授權，發展AI通用晶片平台，最後結合國內外廠商協助籌組AI Center公司，加速技術產業商品化(time-to-market)，並協助建構AI Edge產業生態系。
abstract_en_plan:
The purpose of this plan is to jointly develop a high-efficiency, low-power AI general-purpose chip platform through international technical cooperation and integration of its own software technology, and to solve the immediate high-computing needs required for dynamic 3D map updates.
The execution content of this plan includes: (I) Efficient AI Edge system platform optimization: cooperate with Arm to generate a new generation of AI computing chips, conduct R & D and verification of NPU prototype architecture system software, and develop AI general-purpose chip platforms; (II) dynamic environment Construction technology development: Dynamic environment construction technology exchange with SOLFICE RESEARCH,INC(Civil maps), combined with Arm based AI platform for feature extraction and localization algorithm verification.

abstract_zh_plan:
透過chiplet進行異質集成是延續半導體摩爾定律的關鍵技術，然而面對少量多樣的智能系統需求，因無法如標準化晶片可大量生產並調整至極高良率，造成產品良率不足，難以進行商業化。此外在系統型3D整合的封裝趨勢下，電路設計複雜度高，現有製程之組裝彈性不足。

為解決少量生產良率低，以及多樣化客製產品開發費用高等面臨之挑戰，本計畫將發展FPGA-like之可程式3D異質集成技術，包含：
(1) 以大量預先製造矽基核板方式，改善製程良率，並加速製造時程。此矽基核板將包含高密度TSV，在預製情況下，仍能提供足夠的彈性供電路設計用。並發展相關技術及製程，以避免高密度TSV矽基核板的翹曲現象。
(2) 透過可程式化連接(programmable interconnection)晶片，提高開發設計之彈性。並發展相對應的自動化設計、測試、驗證等技術，提供完整的系統應用平台，加值國內少量多樣智能應用系統。

本計畫架構於Å世代半導體綱要計畫項下，透過可程式化3D異質集成簡化系統整合難度，快速客製化整合需求。並將聚焦國內系統應用廠商之需求，以AIoT為驗證系統載具平台，輔以國內IC設計公司(如聯發科)的先期參與，建立可程式化封裝及晶片系統整合開發鏈結與解決方案，強化國內封裝及基板產業，完善國內高值半導體客製化AIoT產業鏈，補足半導體系統整合生態缺口，引導半導體產品創新、促生創新模組及系統應用的產業發展，確保我國IC產業持續領先。

abstract_zh_plan:

Advanced packaging pursues the ultimate in performance, power consumption, and area. Companies are able to afford high development costs in mass-produced general purpose applications (such as mobile phones and consumer products). While facing device AI applications with low-volume high-mix features, manufacturers cannot always obtain the most suitable components required by AI devices for specialized applications at a reasonable price. For example, smart glasses require high response speed and low-capacity memory to achieve low latency display, but not JEDEC standard memory (high speed, high capacity and costly). 
The limited solutions on the market cannot meet the needs of most AI system integration companies. Such limitations hinder the development of device AI applications. Therefore, many members of AI on Chip Taiwan Alliance (AITA) hope to accelerate the development of non-standard AI sensing technology. 
This program will establish an innovative architecture and technology for AI sensing modules. In a stamp-sized, multi-layered structure, signals are transmitted from sensing 
components, memory, digital or analog AI chips through optimized circuit partition analysis with taking into account module size, power consumption, and performance. With a modular architecture that can be flexibly expanded and has the ability to replace chips, it can meet the application needs of different AI systems, expand the application range of device AI chips.

受到美中貿易衝突、嚴重特殊傳染性肺炎疫情的影響，全球晶片供給呈現短缺態勢，其中臺灣半導體產業受惠於美中科技紛爭的轉單效應以及疫情帶動居家辦公、遠距教學等宅經濟相關產品的新興需求，估計推升臺灣半導體產業於2021年產值達到3.8兆元，年成長率達到18.1%。
而隨著人工智慧(AI)與5G技術逐漸成熟，物聯網(IoT)蓬勃發展，正式進入智慧物聯網(AIoT)時代，人工智慧透過物聯網滲透到日常生活之中，推動智慧物聯網創新應用以及對智慧裝置的大量需求，進而帶動半導體產業成長與相關科技的發展。本計畫借重政策之力並整合產學研能量，深化創新應用開發平台，鏈結國內供應鏈技術能力，與我國ICT堅實基礎緊密結合，促進智慧物聯網創新應用產業的發展，協助業者及早布局掌握商機。
智慧物聯網晶片化整合服務計畫運用臺灣具優勢之硬體製造環境，強化AI/IoT/5G服務能量，深耕一站式服務，包括高端電路封裝技術、軟硬體優化設計、晶圓下線鏈結與諮詢服務、晶片與矽智財應用技術方案與AIoT場域實證，協助國內外創新產品跨越商品化最後一哩路，以技術驅動與需求導向雙引擎，開拓創新產品新藍海。
abstract_en_plan:
The semiconductor industry is the cornerstone of the global development of the digital economy and technological breakthroughs, and among them, Taiwan’s semiconductor industry plays a key role in the global supply chain and is also an important pillar of Taiwan's economy. To drive the growth of Taiwan's next-generation industries, this Project takes The 5+2 Industrial Transformation Plan as the basis and cooperate with Taiwan’s national policies to perform deployment within the information and digital industries, one of the six core strategic industries, and promotes Taiwan to become a digital hub that contributes to global prosperity and security, as well as a key force in the future global economy.
Due to the impact of the US-China trade conflict and the COVID-19 pandemic, the global chips are in short supply. Among them, Taiwan's semiconductor industry has benefited from the order diverting effect from the US-China technology conflict, as well as the trend of work from home, distance learning, and other emerging demands of the home-based economy due to the pandemic. Hence, it is estimated that the output value of Taiwan's semiconductor industry will reach NT$3.8 trillion in 2021, with an annual growth rate of 18.1%.
With the gradual maturity of artificial intelligence (AI) and 5G technologies, the Internet of Things (IoT) has flourished and officially entered the era of Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT). As AI penetrates our everyday life through the Internet of Things, it generates considerable demands for smart devices, which in turn drives the growth of the semiconductor industry and the development of related technologies. This Project utilizes the relevant policies and integrates the capacity of industry, academic and research to deeply innovate application development platforms, link the technical capabilities of the domestic supply chains, and closely integrate with the solid foundation of Taiwan's ICT to promote the development of AIoT application industry, and assists the industry in early deployment to seize any potential business opportunities in a timely manner.
The Project of AIoT IC based integrated services adopts Taiwan's advantageous hardware manufacturing environment to improve AI, IoT, and 5G services, and develop one-stop services, including high-end circuit packaging technology, software, and hardware optimization design, wafer off-line linkage and consulting services, chip, and silicon intellectual property application technology solutions and AIoT field demonstrations, which are aiming at assisting domestic and foreign innovative products to cross the last mile of commercialization, and develop and innovate a blue ocean market for the products using the technology-driven and demand-oriented dual mechanism.

institution: 財團法人工業技術研究院資訊與通訊研究所{財團法人資訊工業策進會}
abstract_zh_plan:
終端移動設備的快速發展可藉由廣連結與高頻寬的網路服務，提供更多低延遲應用場景，諸如「AI即時影像分析」、「雲遊戲」、「元宇宙串流服務」等應用服務，這些應用需要強大計算力、傳輸龐大資料的低延遲網路環境、硬體加速卡、影音串流即時編碼/解碼技術、AI 等技術的支持。
為滿足上述各種軟硬體技術需求，本計畫將著重於軟體加速技術與硬體加速技術之研發，並搭配可彈性進行資源編排的邊緣雲平台，以動態滿足各式超低延遲的應用服務與需求變化，並於工作負載離峰時段，有效進行設備節能與調控。 
本計畫將在邊緣端建立一套具QoS保證與可高度彈性資源調度來同時提供多種低延遲應用服務所須的計算、儲存與網路要求，於軟體加速部分將研發低延遲非同步編碼、具反應時間保證與品質可控之AI分析，於硬體部分將開發高算力、低耗能之自主高性能運算晶片，推動國產伺服器晶片產業化，並讓本計畫最後產出的邊緣雲管理平台，可滿足高優先權的應用服務之端到端應用服務延遲需求。 
藉由本計畫三大項目產出，包括：具服務品質保證資源管理與編排技術用於邊緣雲環境、高性能RISC-V晶片硬體加速及兩項軟體加速服務滿足低延遲需求的應用情境，並藉由場域驗證可行性。未來可組合出一個統包解決方案(Turnkey Solution)，提供國內電信或伺服器業者，提升國際競爭力。
abstract_en_plan:
The rapid development of terminal mobile devices can provide more low-latency application scenarios through wide-connection and high-bandwidth network services, such as "AI real-time image analysis", "cloud games", "metaverse streaming services" and other application services, These applications require the support of powerful computing power, low-latency network environment for transmitting huge data, hardware accelerator cards, real-time encoding/decoding technology for video and audio streaming, AI and other technologies.
In order to meet the various hardware and software technology requirements mentioned above, this project will focus on the research and development of software acceleration technology and hardware acceleration technology, and match it with an edge cloud platform that can flexibly arrange resources to dynamically meet various ultra-low-latency application services and demand changes, and effectively carry out equipment energy saving and regulation during off-peak workload periods.
This project will establish a set of QoS guarantee and highly elastic resource scheduling at the edge to simultaneously provide the computing, storage and network requirements required for multiple low-latency application services. In the software acceleration part, low-latency asynchronous coding, AI analysis with guaranteed response time and quality control, will develop independent high-performance computing chips with high computing power and low energy consumption in the hardware part, promote the industrialization of domestic server chips, and make the final output of this project the edge The cloud management platform can meet the end-to-end application service delay requirements of high-priority application services. 
Through the output of the three major projects of this plan, including: resource management and orchestration technology with service quality assurance for edge cloud environment, high-performance RISC-V chip hardware acceleration, and two software acceleration services to meet low-latency application scenarios, And verify the feasibility through the field. In the future, a turnkey solution can be combined to provide domestic telecommunications or server operators to enhance international competitiveness.

institution: 財團法人工業技術研究院電子與光電系統研究所
abstract_zh_plan:
受5G、COVID-19的影響，全球數據量指數級上升至 Zera 等級，資料中心伺服器的傳輸與運算效能也因此必需大幅提升方可因應。以現行資料中心運行模式預估未來十年耗電將達全球電力3%~30%，主要耗電來自伺服器、儲存、網路等。為加速資料中心綠化以符合淨零排放願景，半導體產業無不積極投入高速傳輸效率的矽光子共封裝(Co-Packaged Optics, CPO)模組與低能耗運算儲存的高容量記憶體等技術的發展。本計畫針對伺服器高速傳輸 CPO 模組所需之近無損光電載板、光電晶片此二關鍵技術，以及提升大數據運算系統運算效能的低耗能高容量三維磁性記憶體(3D Magnetic Random Access Memory, 3D MRAM)關鍵技術進行先期關鍵技術研發投入，補足半導體產業發展 CPO模組與低能耗運算記憶體關鍵技術之缺口，並規劃透過推動聯盟將研發布局成果擴散至資料中心伺服器生態鏈中，加速產業技術升級成為全球主要供應聚落，目標2030年促進資料中心伺服
器產業年減碳106.1萬噸；同時針對低能耗 MRAM 所需之新式材料如高電壓磁異向(voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy, VCMA)磁性膜、氧化銦半導體材料之開發預計將可應用至後續之低能耗3D MRAM 技術上，可逐年實現節能效益傳輸。第一階段預計於2025年達成單一記憶單元功耗減少20%，隨著整合式晶片研發以及 MRAM、氧化銦電晶體特性提升，最終可於2027達成單一記憶單元功耗減少40%，降低晶片碳排放31.15萬噸。
abstract_en_plan: The strong demand from the Internet traffic have push the data centers around the world to their highest capacity. The zetta-bit level of data traffic will soon become the routine in the server racks. To overcome this trend, a system chip with capability of ultra-high speed data transmission and computation will be critical in the near future. This project will target on this important trend to develop the advanced technologies such as silicon photonic based co-packaged optics and the high performance computing chip system. The efforts are going to match what is lack of in the current industries, and we will apply our results towards the supply chain of data center/server industries. Hopefully they can help to promote Taiwan’s technology and also the influences in semiconductor field.

project_title_en: AIoT IC based integrated services
institution: 財團法人工業技術研究院
abstract_zh_plan:
半導體產業是發展數位經濟與科技突破的基石，我國半導體產業在全球供應鏈扮演關鍵角色，亦為臺灣經濟的重要支柱，在數位經濟發展浪潮之下，為驅動下世代產業成長，本計畫奠基於5+2產業創新計畫，並配合國家政策晶片設計與半導體產業推動方案與部署六大核心戰略產業，全力推動臺灣成為下一個世代資訊科技的重要基地，促進物聯網和人工智慧的發展。
    全球產業環境在2022年受到國際通膨、中國大陸疫情封控等影響而減緩需求動能，但仍受惠於第5代行動通訊、高效能運算、車用電子、資料中心等市場需求，以及元宇宙、6G等新興議題持續引領著技術向前發展，預估臺灣半導體產業在2022年產值達到4.9兆元，年成長率約19.7%。
    隨著人工智慧與第5代行動通訊技術進步，物聯網(IoT)相關應用日新月異，全球逐漸步入智慧物聯網(AIoT)時代，人們在日常生活更加依賴各式連接裝置與智慧物聯網應用服務，帶動對智慧裝置的大量需求與智慧創新應用發展，為掌握這一波智慧物聯網成長動能，強化半導體晶片於AIoT之布局，緣此，本計畫將借重政策之力並整合產學研能量，深化創新應用開發平台，與我國資通訊(ICT)產業緊密結合，促進智慧物聯網創新應用發展。
    智慧物聯網晶片化整合服務計畫以技術驅動與需求導向雙引擎，結合臺灣具優勢之硬體製造環境，豐富AI/IoT/5G技術量能，深耕一站式服務，包括高端電路封裝技術、軟硬體優化設計、晶圓下線鏈結與諮詢服務、晶片與矽智財應用技術方案與場域實證等，協助國內外創新產品開創新藍海。
abstract_en_plan:
The semiconductor industry is the cornerstone of the development of the digital economy and technological breakthroughs. In Taiwan, the semiconductor industry plays a key part in the global supply chain and it is also a significant pillar of Taiwan’s economy. Under the wave of digital economic development, this Project, based on 5+2 innovative industries plan and Taiwan’s national policy of chip design, semiconductor industry promotion, and the deployment of six core strategic industries, will lay the foundation for fully driving the growth of the next-generation industries and promoting Taiwan to become an important base for information technology in the coming generation, and facilitating the development of the Internet of Things and artificial intelligence.
The global industry environment in 2022 is affected by international inflation and the lockdown for epidemic control in mainland China, which would slow down the momentum of demand. However, it still benefits from the market demand for 5th-gen mobile telecommunications, high-performance computing, automotive electronics, and data centers, as well as emerging trends such as metaverse and 6G that continue lead technological development. It is estimated that the output value of Taiwan's semiconductor industry will reach NT$4.9 trillion in 2022, with an annual growth rate of around 19.7%.
With the development of artificial intelligence and the 5th-gen mobile telecommunication technology and constant improvement of Internet of Things (IoT)-related applications, the whole world is gradually entering the era of AIoT. People would rely more on various connected devices and smart IoT application services in their daily lives, which will drive significant demand for smart devices and the development of smart innovative applications. In order to grasp the growth momentum of this trend of smart Internet of Things and strengthen the deployment of semiconductor chips in AIoT, this Project aims at leveraging the help from policies and integrating the potential of industry, academics, and research to deepen the innovative application development platform. By closely cooperating with Taiwan’s information and communications technology (ICT) industry, we are expecting to promote the development of innovative applications for the Smart Internet of Things.
The project of AIoT IC based integrated services is driven by both technology and demand-oriented aspects combined with Taiwan’s advantageous hardware manufacturing environment, which would enrich the capabilities of AI/IoT/5G technology and profoundly develop the one-stop services, including high-end circuit packaging technique, software, and hardware optimization design, wafer tapeout linkage and consultancy services, chip and SIP core application technology solutions, and field demonstrations, etc., so as to assist domestic and foreign innovative products in expanding a new blue ocean market.

Chiplets are the future trend of semiconductors. This project develops low-latency AI perception computing technology with international competitive advantages, along with chiplet high-bandwidth transmission interface design and process, to achieve a comprehensive solution for design, packaging and system, and create diverse applications for post-Moore era semiconductors. 1.Key chiplet core technology development：Establish a small chip design environment
(1)Chiplet interconnection technology：Develop a common applicable chip interconnection design technology, promote the industry to invest in chiplet applications, and provide scalable system chip solutions.
(2)Memory-computing integrated chiplet：Establish a general-purpose computing and memory small chip, and use 2.5D and 3D structures to enhance the advantages of computing speed and volume reduction.
(3)Sensor-in-computing chiplet：Implement low-latency recognition in an innovative sensor-in-computing architecture.
2.Chiplet system integration technology：Develop key core technologies such as low-latency and high-bandwidth small chip system interconnection manufacturing, small chip computing tool chain, and small chip system application design
(1)Low-temperature bonding of organic materials for chiplet technology：Establish a reconstituted wafer heterogeneous packaging technology, and connect to the advanced manufacturing trial production platform to provide trial production services.
(2)Chiplet computing system software technology：Develop small chip computing compiler software.
(3)Chiplet system-level design application technology：Integrate heterogeneous packaging, system operation software and dynamic visual perception.

本計畫擬將攜手產學研技術能量，共同開發前瞻製程EDA技術工具，鏈結國際大廠既有EDA生態鏈，並透過建置視覺化界面 EDA工作流程控制系統，運行於在地端 (On-Premises) 雲平台，串聯整體EDA工作鏈，同時亦針對不同應用需求，佈局智動化EDA平台服務與試量產線的EDA工具，朝向建置全棧式EDA流程設計邁進，加值AI晶片、高效能運算 (HPC) 晶片、車用電子晶片等高值化產品應用。
abstract_en_plan:
In recent years, the trend in the advanced semiconductor packaging industry has been on the rise. With increasing complexity in IC design, many countries have actively supported the development of the Electronic Design Automation (EDA) industry. Currently, Taiwan's IC industry plays an one of the most important roles in the global semiconductor field. However, little investment in EDA software tool. In order to enhance the domestic EDA industry's competitiveness, this plan will develop three major EDA technologies of intelligent EDA design technologies (including, agile hardware design processes, AI-driven EDA technologies, and intelligent design platforms), heterogeneous packaging manufacturability design and 2.5D/3D chip interconnect testing. The development tools will assist domestic manufacturers in reducing chip design cycles and time to market, strategically promoting the development of the domestic IC design industry.

We will collaborate the technical energy with industry and academia to collectively develop cutting-edge EDA technology tools for advanced processes. Also, connect with the existing EDA ecosystems of international industry leaders. Additionally, this project will establish a visual interface EDA workflow control system that runs on an On-Premises cloud platform, linking the entire EDA workflow chain. For various applications, deploying intelligent EDA platform services in the chiplet pilot production line, moving towards building a full-stack EDA process design for the high-value applications in AI chips, high-performance computing (HPC) and  automotive electronic fields.

This project aims to connect the domestic industrial chain by providing solutions tailored to the chip and system integration design services required for business transformation. By strengthening the connection between supply and demand and reducing gaps, the project seeks to create a more balanced environment for industrial development.
In 2024, the project will conduct on-site visits to better understand the AI application needs of various industries. Early efforts will focus on building a simulation environment for architecture analysis, allowing user demands to be quickly transformed into AI system architectures and hardware-software specifications. This will accelerate companies' capabilities in AI system design and specification development. Additionally, the early establishment of a system verification platform will offer chip reference designs and FPGA verification environments for SMEs and startups, reducing their initial investment barriers and speeding up the validation of chip product concepts.
Finally, by establishing a collaborative industrial technology platform, the project will strengthen the integration of domestic supply chain resources, providing essential technical support to Taiwanese companies with growth potential but in need of transformation assistance. It will also support startups and small to medium-sized IC design service providers by integrating service platforms, offering access to more opportunities and enhancing the connection between supply and demand.

abstract_en_plan:
In the process of digital and intelligent transformation, smaller domestic enterprises face challenges due to limited supply chain services that struggle to meet low-volume, high-variety demands. This is a critical issue that the industry urgently needs to address. This project aims to link the domestic industrial chain and provide specific solutions for the chip and system integration design services required during the transformation process of enterprises. By enhancing supply-demand alignment, the project seeks to reduce the gap between suppliers and demanders, fostering a more balanced development of the industrial ecosystem.
The project will deliver end-to-end solutions, focusing on four key services: system specification formulation, customized software development, customized hardware design, and rapid prototyping services, to meet customized, low-volume, high-variety needs. Throughout the project, an AI system-level integration analysis platform will be established to bridge current technical gaps, comprehensively improve AI system architecture and specification formulation capabilities, and build a proprietary AI system software platform to enhance domestic AI chips. This will promote the development of Taiwan’s AI application ecosystem. To lower R&D barriers for startups and SMEs, a prototype verification platform will be set up, providing complete reference designs and linking industry resources to establish an AI system integration prototyping platform. This will facilitate rapid prototyping and functional verification of AI systems.
1.	System-Level Integration Technology and Automated Software Development
The project will explore system-level software-hardware collaborative design architecture in depth, emphasizing integrated consideration of cross-domain requirements to achieve optimal solutions for diverse industrial applications. This service will help cross-domain industries translate their needs into specific specifications. By establishing one-stop design services on the platform, constructing an AI and semiconductor-driven value-added framework and establishing a new AI application service model.
2.	AI Value-Added Applications and System Software Development
The project will focus on developing AI foundational system software and application frameworks, providing customized solutions for the specific needs of various industries. This foundational system software will include key modules such as AI model training and deployment, inference engines, data processing tools, and code generation, aiming to accelerate AI adoption across industries. The project promotes innovative application development in fields such as manufacturing, healthcare, finance, and smart cities.
3.	Prototype System Verification Platform and Reference Design
The project will establish an application-oriented system verification platform, providing reference designs for key core modules, which will serve as foundational technical support for companies' product development. This verification platform covers the full process from design to validation, with particular focus on prototype system testing and verification for AI and semiconductor applications, ensuring that technical solutions can be smoothly integrated into practical application scenarios. The reference design for key core modules provides enterprises with an efficient and reliable development reference, helping them accelerate product development and enhance overall market responsiveness.
4.	System-Level IC Manufacturing, Testing, and Verification/Computation Platform and Environment Setup
The project is committed to establishing an advanced chip packaging and trial production line. This platform will provide one-stop technical support from chip design to manufacturing, testing, and verification.

abstract_zh_plan:
無人機飛行系統國產自主關鍵技術開發計畫，主要發展無人機載具的關鍵零組件自主技術，與整機軟硬體整合的系統工程技術，包括自主動力系統技術、自主飛控系統技術、智慧飛行關鍵軟體技術、通訊與應用模組關鍵技術，主要透過兩款大型商用無人機的系統整合開發示範，並藉由創新應用的先期驗證來確認整機的功能規格，計畫架構概分為5個部分。
關鍵零組件中飛控相關的軟硬體，包括自主開發的3D封裝內建AI運算功能的核心飛控硬體，以及可以提供國內業者後續加值發展的飛控軟體，影像加速處理器的AI運算系統將同時規劃高規格的版本與中低規格的版本對應不同的應用需求，而動力系統相關的硬體及整合控制技術開發聚焦在任務導向的智慧動力模組，包括高功率密度的電源模組與其適應性匹配調校控制技術，以及高推力的電推模組技術。
這些技術將以兩類的酬載型無人機作為落實驗證與整合應用的載具，第一類是精準懸停作業的無人機，在FY113將延續FY112離線作業的基礎精進，於FY114進行礙子串 (161kV)規格清洗應用驗證準備工作，第二類是點對點飛行的高載重物流應用無人機，在FY113高載重物流原型機將先進行申請特種實體檢驗及低海拔驗證作業，FY114將規劃持續做POC驗證的中低海拔驗證場域，進行山區通訊、載重飛行可靠度的驗證，FY115進行海拔1,000公尺以上點到點驗證，與偏鄉物流50公斤酬載(空中廊道)應用。
以上的研發成果，除了優先滿足公部門的酬載任務試運行需求之外，將與國內業者一起建立無人機的自主供應鏈，分別導入業者與法人研發的機型，以3D空中物流及基礎設施智慧維運應用等應用，進行國內場域的先導驗證並以新創模式爭取與國際無人機系統商合作商機。
abstract_en_plan:
The domestic independent key technology development plan for UAV flight systems mainly develops autonomous technology for key components of UAV vehicles, and system engineering technology integrating software and hardware with the whole aircraft, including autonomous power system technology, autonomous flight control system technology, intelligent flight key software technology, communication and application module key technology. It mainly uses the system integration and development demonstration of two large commercial drones, and confirms the functional specifications of the whole aircraft through the preliminary verification of innovative applications. The project architecture is roughly divided into 5 parts.
The software and hardware related to flight control in key components include the core flight control hardware with built-in AI computing functions independently developed by 3D packages, as well as flight control software that can provide subsequent value-added development for domestic operators. The AI ​​computing system of the image acceleration processor will simultaneously plan high-spec versions and medium-sized versions to correspond to different application requirements. The hardware and integrated control technology development of power system-related hardware and integrated control technology focuses on task-oriented intelligent power modules, including high-power density power modules and their adaptive matching adjustment control technology, as well as high-thrust thrust thrust module technology.
These technologies will use two types of payload-type drones as vehicles for implementation and integration of applications. The first type is a drone with precise hovering operations. In FY113, it will continue the basic improvement of FY112 offline operations, and conduct verification preparations for the substring (161kV) specification cleaning application on FY114. The second type is a high-load logistics application drone for point-to-point flight. In FY113 high-load logistics prototype, it will first apply for special physical inspection and low-altitude verification operations. FY114 will plan a medium- and low-altitude verification field that continues to perform POC verification, conduct verification of mountain communication and load-load flight reliability. FY115 performs point-to-point verification above 1,000 meters, and is applied with 50 kg payload (air corridor) of Pianxiang logistics.
In addition to prioritizing the test operation needs of public sector remuneration tasks, the above R&D results will establish an independent supply chain of drones with domestic operators, introduce aircraft developed by operators and legal persons respectively, and carry out pilot verification of domestic fields through applications such as 3D air logistics and infrastructure intelligent maintenance and operation applications, and strive for business opportunities for cooperation with international drone systems through new models.

institution: 財團法人工業技術研究院資訊與通訊研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 無人機於國防及產業的應用日趨重要，然目前國內無人機關鍵零組件多採國外廠商方案，成本高且技術受限於人，甚至有紅色供應鏈的疑慮，一旦國際情勢發生劇變，可能危及國安，因此強化我國關鍵技術自主及協助業者加速降低成本及提升技術事關重要。本計畫提出開發全自主之無人機用之軟體定義無線電(Software Defined Radio, SDR)平台，支援飛行載具與地面終端，滿足多頻段、抗干擾之3D通訊需求，提供更靈活且效率的通訊解決方案，後續並將以SDR平台的開發成果，成立一家衍生新創公司，以推動無人機產業自主化發展。此外，本計畫亦將協助國內業者加速開發AI影像晶片及低成本飛行控制板，AI影像晶片可應用於國防軍事及產業應用之中高階無人機，將有助於國內業者技術升級；低成本飛行控制板具有國產化及高性價比優勢，有助國內業者降低成本及提高產能，可大量應用於教育及消費娛樂用途的初階無人機。
abstract_en_plan:
This project proposes the development of a fully autonomous Software Defined Radio (SDR) platform for drones, supporting both aerial vehicles and ground terminals. The platform will meet multi-band and anti-jamming 3D communication needs, providing a more flexible and efficient communication solution. Furthermore, the project plans to use the SDR platform's development results to establish a spinoff startup company, promoting the self-reliant development of Taiwan's drone industry.

In addition, the project will assist domestic companies in accelerating the development of AI image chips and low-cost flight control boards. The AI image chips can be applied to medium-to-high-end drones for both defense and industrial applications, facilitating technological upgrades for local companies. The low-cost flight control boards, with advantages in localization and cost-effectiveness, will help domestic companies reduce costs and increase production capacity. These boards can be widely used in entry-level drones for education and consumer entertainment purposes.

project_title: 千瓦級冷板式液冷元件開發(1/1)
project_title_en: Kilowatt-Level Cold Plate Liquid Cooling Technology(1/1)
institution: 財團法人工業技術研究院電子與光電系統研究所
abstract_zh_plan:
隨著生成式 AI 應用的蓬勃發展，各領域對於 AI 算力的需求急遽增加，這一現象不僅推動了高階晶片的持續升級，也使得晶片的功耗與發熱量快速攀升。目前市場上的高性能晶片，例如 Nvidia 的 B200 晶片，其發熱量已達到驚人的 1000W，而隨著技術的演進與算力需求的不斷提高，預計到 2026 年晶片的發熱量將進一步增長至 1500W，並在 2028 年可能出現 2000W 的高階 AI 晶片。這種千瓦級的功耗水平對於散熱技術提出了前所未有的挑戰，成為現今業界亟待解決的技術瓶頸之一。
針對這一挑戰，目前市場上主要採用兩種散熱方案：浸沒式冷卻與冷板式液冷。其中，浸沒式冷卻技術是通過將晶片直接浸泡在特殊的冷卻液中來達成高效熱交換，雖然其散熱效果優異，但在實際應用中存在技術門檻高、維護成本高以及安全性等方面的限制。而冷板式液冷作為另一種主流技術，已經逐漸市場化並實現商業落地。冷板液冷技術是利用冷卻液通過液冷板直接與晶片接觸來進行散熱，具備結構緊湊、可擴展性強等優勢。然而，由於該技術的發展歷史尚短，目前市場上冷板的架構設計僅有少數一兩種選擇，導致其散熱性能在面對未來更高發熱量的晶片時，仍略顯不足。此外，現有冷板技術普遍面臨冷卻液流動阻力過高的問題，這不僅可能影響系統的冷卻效率，還增加了漏液風險，進一步限制了其應用範圍。
目前市場對於冷板散熱性能的提升以及低壓阻設計的需求愈加迫切，因此開發更高效、更安全的冷板散熱元件已成為技術攻關的重點。本計畫將針對千瓦級晶片的散熱需求，專注於開發新一代冷板散熱元件，目標實現單一元件具備至少 2200W 的散熱能力，同時兼具低流阻性能。透過創新設計與技術突破，該冷板將在散熱能力上超越晶片發熱量至少兩年的領先裕度，以應對未來市場對散熱技術的高標準需求。這一研發方向不僅將解決現有技術瓶頸，還能為生成式 AI 的持續發展提供穩固的硬體支撐，助力相關產業邁向更高階的技術應用層次。
abstract_en_plan:
The rapid growth of generative AI has sharply increased demand for AI computing power, driving advancements in high-performance chips and escalating heat generation. Current chips, such as Nvidia's B200 GPU, generate up to 1000W, with projections reaching 1500W by 2026 and 2000W by 2028. This kilowatt-level power consumption poses significant challenges to electronics cooling technologies. 
Two main cooling techniques exist: immersion cooling and cold plate liquid cooling. While immersion cooling offers excellent performance, it faces challenges like high costs and safety concerns. Cold plate liquid cooling, which dissipates heat through cold plate in contact with chips, is more scalable but struggles with limited design options, high flow pressure drop, and insufficient performance for future high-power chips.
This project focuses on developing next-generation cold plate cooling components capable of dissipating at least 2000W with low flow pressure drop. Through innovative design, these components will address existing technical bottlenecks, meet future cooling demands, and provide essential hardware support for generative AI's ongoing evolution.

project_title: 整合式二維材料觸覺感測器與人工電子突觸記憶體於仿神經系統的應用
project_title_en: The Application of Integrated Touch Sensors and Artificial Synaptic Memories with 2-Dimensional Materials on Bionic Antennal Nerve System
institution: 長庚大學電子工程學系
abstract_zh_plan:
本計畫使用二維材料黑磷烯與石墨烯，分別應用到觸覺感測器與電阻式記憶體中，來研發仿觸覺
感測神經系統，利用施力於觸覺感測器產生電子，經由導線傳遞至電阻式記憶體，造成阻態的轉變，
來達成人工電子突觸的應用。將使用製程技術來提升觸覺感測器的電子產生效率並達成低功率操作電
阻式記憶體的需求，最後製作一個整合式二維材料仿觸覺感測神經系統結構原型。本計畫可分成以下
三個部分來實行：
1. 高電子產生效率之PVDF-TrFE/黑磷烯壓電式觸覺感測器開發。使用低損傷電漿改善PVDF-TrFE/
黑磷烯間的電子傳輸效率，並利用奈米晶點摻雜與溶劑退火增加PVDF-TrFE 壓電材料的電子產生
效率，提高壓電式觸覺感測器的效能以供電阻式記憶體轉態操作。
2. 低功率操作之全石墨烯電極電阻式記憶體開發。使用不同功函數的石墨烯當作電阻式記憶體的上
下電極並微縮元件面積來降低操作電壓，同時利用低損傷電漿來調整高低阻態電阻值，降低電阻
式記憶體的轉態功率以為觸覺感測器所操作。
3. 整合式二維材料仿觸覺感測神經系統開發。設計光罩並最佳化觸覺感測器與電阻式記憶體的製
程，以完成此仿觸覺感測神經系統結構的原型，利用施力於觸覺感測器來實現人工電子突觸電阻
式記憶體操作，以達成此整合式仿觸覺感測神經系統的開發。
abstract_en_plan:
The two-dimensional phosphorene and graphene sheets, applied in touch sensor and resistive random
access memory (RRAM) respectively, are studied in this project to develop a bionic antennal nerve system. A
force will be applied on the touch senor to generate electrons. The electrons will travel through the
conductive wire to RRAM, leading to the change of resistance states and achieving the artificial synaptic
operation for neural application. Some process technologies will be used to enhance the electron generation
efficiency of touch sensors and reduce the operation voltages of RRAMs to realize the low-power
requirement. Then, the prototype of bionic antennal nerve system with the integration of 2-dimensional
materials will be finished. The project can be divided into three parts:
1. The PVDF-TrFE/phosphorene touch sensors with highly-efficient electron generation will be developed.
The low-damage plasma treatment will be used to enhance the transfer of electrons between PVDF-TrFE
and phosphorene. In addition, the incorporation of nanocrystals and solvent annealing will be used to
increase the electron generation efficiency of PVDF-TrFE piezoelectric material, making the superior
characteristics of touch sensors for the operation of RRAMs possible.
2. The RRAMs with all graphene electrodes for low-power operation will be developed. The operation
voltages of RRAMs can be reduced by using the different work-functions of graphene as the top and
bottom electrodes and the reduction of device area. Furthermore, the resistances of high and low
resistance states can be adjusted by using the low-damage plasma treatment, reducing the resistive switching power of RRAMs to be operated by touch sensors.
3. The integrated 2-dimensional materials for the bionic antennal nerve system will be developed. The
masks will be designed and the processes of touch sensors and RRAMs will be optimized to realize the
prototype of bionic antennal nerve system. The force will be applied on the touch sensors to achieve the
operation of RRAMs, accomplishing the development of integrated bionic antennal nerve system.

project_title: 以環型共振腔進行人工智慧運算之研究
project_title_en: Artificial Intelligence Using Ring Resonator Array
institution: 國立中央大學光電科學與工程學系
abstract_zh_plan: 本計畫為延續2017年8月1日於物理學門所開始執行之” 奈米環型共振腔陣列之研究”計畫。擬使用本實驗室已開發之環型共振腔技術, 進一步建構環型共振腔所組成的陣列，利用此結構進行類神經網路人工智慧的計算。每一個環型共振腔可組成一個神經元。目前文獻僅研究均一環型共振腔所形成之方形矩陣，本計畫擬變化各式拓樸連接形態的環型共振腔矩陣，並變化其每個共振腔之設計，以優化其光學計算之特性。本計畫中，我們擬將元件製作於silicon-on-insulator(SOI)晶片上。並使用我們已研究的類神經網路應用，放入全光學人工智慧電腦中進行計算。以此類神經網路奈米晶片所進行之光學計算，在未來可提供大數據等課題一個體積小、速度快的計算平台。
abstract_en_plan: This project will follow the work of the project in MOST “Study of nano-ring resonator array”. We plan to use the ring resonators developed in our laboratory to study the ring resonator array. We will use the ring resonator array to build an artificial intelligence computer using neural networks. Each ring resonator can be regarded as a neuron. In literature, people use square ring resonator array to build the neural network. We will change the topology of the ring resonator array and the dimension of the ring resonators to optimize the characterization of the optical neural network computing. We will fabricate the device on silicon-on-insulator chip. We will apply the chip on the applications that we are investigating. This neural network ring resonator array could provide an ultra-fast computation platform to the applications of big data.

project_title_en: Technology Breakthrough by Ferroelectric Hfo2 for Ultralow Power Logic and Memory on Phase Sicience and Artificial Intellignece
institution: 財團法人國家實驗研究院奈米元件實驗室
abstract_zh_plan: 本計劃將進行三奈米技術節點以下低電壓功耗鍺通道元件的製作與compact model的建立。除了使用已開放的鰭式結構，本計劃亦已主計劃之閘極全包覆式奈米線平台製程，開發閘極全包覆式奈米片作為目標結構，以符合三奈米技術節點以下的要求。相較於傳統鰭式結構，閘極全包覆式的結構可完全包覆通道並提升閥極控制力與抑制漏電流。奈米片可晶藉由提升閘極通道寬度與高度比例，在傳統鰭式與奈米線之間取捨，如此可改善元件遷移率與將低元件所需之功耗。另外，本計劃亦引進本實驗室開發之air-gap spacer模組作為low-κ結構以降低元件寄生電容，並將傳統鰭式與新穎奈米片兩結構之high-κ介電層以鐵電材料替代，一來可改善元件的次臨界擺幅至60mV/dec以下，二來鐵電閘極層可與low-κspacer交互匹配造成通道之reverse DIBL效應來改善短通道效應，降低RC delay與增加元件的驅動電流。最後，本計劃將結合已發表的熱力學模型最佳化上述鐵電場效電晶體，編寫compact model(spice)，整合至線路軟體，設計反相器、靜態隨機存取記憶體與環形振盪器，對節能微控制器先行評估其效能。
abstract_en_plan: In this project, Fin/NanoSheet(NS) FETs with sub-60mV/dec. subthreshold swing for low voltage and power applications will be fabricated for coming 3nm technology node. In addition to conventional Fin structures, NDL GAA nanowire(NW) structures will be also referred to fabricate wide channel nanosheet structure to meet the requirements of 3nm technology node. Compared with other Fin/NW structures, sheet structures can perfectly relieve the ratio between channel widths to channel height for short channel immunity, which possess superior gate controllability and mobility trade-off between these device. Moreover, NDL air-gap spacer module will also be used as a low-κ structure to reduce parasitic capacitance, and the high-κ dielectric layer inside fin/NW is further replaced by a ferroelectric Hafnium-based material. Firstly, the sub-threshold swing of the device can be improved to below 60mV/dec. Secondly, the ferroelectric gate layer can be matched with the low-κ spacer to make the reverse DIBL effect, highly supress the short channel effect. Finally, the project will combine the published thermodynamic model to optimize the above-mentioned ferroelectric field effect transistor, and a physical verilog-A compact model will be developed. We can integrate this compact model into simple circult, such as inverters, SRAM and ring oscillators, and evaluate the performance of the energy-saving microcontroller first.

project_title: OpenVX編譯器框架支援與NNE/NNEF研究總計畫-總計畫暨子計畫一：OpenVX動態編譯器支援與NNE/NNEF最佳化
project_title_en: Openvx Runtime Support and Compiler Optimization with Nne/Nnef
institution: 國立清華大學資訊工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 本整合型計畫之目標，將以國際標準組織Khronos的程式語言OpenVX標準為主題，以程式語言及編譯器角度，提供OpenVX應用程式藉由最佳化技術平行運算執行於異質多核心平台並支援NNE/NNEF的OpenVX Compiler Framework解決方案，探討包含Runtime、Halide Computing、OpenCL Computing、及OpenVX Applications等最佳化技術。OpenVX可應用於自動車輔助駕駛、擴增/虛擬實境、影像圖形辨識等嵌入式與即時環境，且支援深度學習環境，執行平行語言運算於異質多核心平台，具高度效能及省電議題的研究空間。整合型計畫包含四個子計畫: 子計畫一，李政崑教授/邱瀞德教授:OpenVX Runtime Support and Compiler Optimization with NNE/NNEF，本子計畫之目標，以程式語言及編譯器角度探討如何在OpenVX中提供Runtime並支援NNE/NNEF深度學習環境；子計畫二，廖世偉副教授:Optimization on OpenVX Computing Framework with Halide，本子計畫將開發OpenVX with Halide來提供最佳化框架加以整合至總計畫中；子計畫三，游逸平副教授:Optimization on OpenVX Runtime Framework with OpenCL Computing，本子計畫將基於我們過去在OpenCL抽象化與資源管理的研究成果(VirtCL)，改善OpenCL的運作系統以提升OpenVX應用程式的執行效能；子計畫四，黃思皓助理教授/邱瀞德教授:Computer Vision Application Development based on Hybrid Deep Learning Techniques with OpenVX and NNEF Frameworks，本子計畫將開發混合式深度學習技術，並結合OpenVX及NNEF架構進行電腦視覺應用開發。
abstract_en_plan:
In this project, we propose to construct the OpenVX compiler framework support for NNE/NNEF computing. This proposal covers the group project and sub-projects contents as follows.
Sub-project 1 is led by Prof. Jen-Kuen Lee/Ching-Te Chiu. In this sub-project, we will develop OpenVX runtime and compiler optimization with NNE/NNEF. The key issues include: (1) Design and Optimization OpenVX Graph Fusion Framework, (2) Design and Optimization of Runtime and NNE/NNEF for OpenVX, (3) OpenVX with Reference Design for GPGPU-SIM/DLA, (4) Support OpenCL C++ Computation for OpenVX Optimization, (5) Sparse Matrix Optimization on OpenVX Runtime with NNE/NNEF, (6) Compiler and Use Case on Numerical Precision with OpenVX for GPGPU-SIM/DLA, (7) Compiler Optimization for SPIR-V with NNE/NNEF, (8) GPGPU-SIM Hardware Design Space Exploration Optimization, (9) Design and Optimization OpenVX Data Tiling, (10) Design and Optimization Compiler for New Types of RAM for OpenVX Computation.
Sub-project 2 is led by Prof. Shih-Wei Liao. This sub-project will will discuss about a framework built in OpenVX with Halide in computer vision and neural network implementation. Furthermore, this research will also develop synergistic computing framework, including the CPU and the GPU with Halide. A comparison is also made between naive OpenVX framework and proposed frameworks. This opens the possibility for computer vision algorithms and neural network algorithms available in the industry.
Sub-project 3 is led by Prof. Yi-Ping You. This sub-project we propose to optimize the OpenCX runtime system with OpenCL computing based on our previously developed work, called VirtCL—which is an OpenCL device abstraction and management framework. This project will focus on the design and implementation of four main topics (composing of nine issues): (1) Transparent and effective resource utilization of OpenCL devices in a cluster, which enables unmodified applications to be transparently distributed to computing resources in a cluster. (2) Enhancement of VirtCL’s scheduler for parallel workloads, which involves execution time prediction using machine learning and scheduling with OpenVX graphs. (3) Enabling prioritization of kernels for real-time applications, with compiler-directed temporal partitioning of kernels and runtime support for preemptive priority-based scheduling (4) Optimization on kernel execution, which is done by reducing redundant data transfers with compiler techniques and using reinforcement learning to explore better optimization combinations for kernels.
Sub-project 4 is led by Prof. Szu-Hao Huang/Prof. Ching-Te Chiu. This sub-project will develop hybrid deep learning techniques and combine openVX and NNEF framework for the development of computer vision applications. The goal of the first year is to develop a series deep learning methods for time-series modeling. Based on the semantic image segmentation techniques, the second year focuses on the parallel and continuous image and video segmentation systems. The research topics will cover stereo matching, disparity estimation, and iterative normalized-cuts segmentation. Finally, to accelerate the execution efficiency of this complex computer vision researches by OpenCL framework and parallel computation is another important issue. The main research direction of the third year is to utilize OpenVX NNE for real-time application development.
The innovations for the integrated multidirectional solutions will play an important role to meet future technology challenges.

project_title: OpenVX編譯器框架支援與NNE/NNEF研究總計畫-子計畫三：基於OpenCL運算之OpenVX運行架構優化研究
project_title_en: Optimization on Openvx Runtime Framework with Opencl Computing
institution: 國立交通大學資訊工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 在這個人工智慧的世代，人工智慧已經開始全面滲入到我們的生活中，例如汽車的主動式安全及手機的相機利用AI辨識場景。這些技術都仰賴大量的科學運算及電腦視覺運算，而目前的瓶頸是運算時間過長，導致研發時程冗長，因此我們提出此計畫希望能夠改善這個情況，並且讓過去購買的硬體設備能夠更被充分的利用。OpenVX是由Khronos Group所發布的一套高性能低能耗電腦視覺加速API，其架構可讓應用程式有效率地運作在不同平台，甚至提供神經網路擴充介面來支援各種深度學習架構之運算，而官方及大部分的開源實作都是基於OpenCL運算架構，因此子計畫將基於我們過去在OpenCL抽象化與資源管理的研究成果(VirtCL)，改善OpenCL的運作系統以提升OpenVX應用程式的執行效能。本計畫的研究內容包括四大技術(共九項子議題)的研究及實作，分別為：(1) 通透且有效率的使用叢集電腦中多個 OpenCL 裝置：讓原有應用程式不需要人工修改便可利用分散於叢集電腦群中的運算資源，不僅可降低開發人員的負擔，亦可提升硬體使用率；(2) 改良 VirtCL 平行化工作量排程器：透過機器學習方式預測裝置執行時間，並藉由OpenVX graph中所敘述的資料流，進而改善VirtCL中核心函式排程器的排程結果；(3) 為即時應用程式實現計算核心的優先性：透過編譯器技術分割核心函式，並提供支援優先性排程之 OpenCL 運行系統，讓原有不支援可間斷排程的OpenCL核心程式也能在指定的檢查點被中斷執行，以滿足即時處理應用的需求；(4) 核心程式之優化：透過編譯器技術減少核心程式間不必要的資料傳輸，並透過強化學習方法對於各種現存的優化技術做最佳化的選擇，以提升核心程式的執行效能。透過以上技術，我們預期能夠改善電腦視覺及機器學習相關的開發環境並提升其應用程式之效率，讓這些應用能夠有與眾不同的特性，促進台灣在系統軟體方面的發展。
abstract_en_plan: With the progress of technology, artificial intelligence has penetrated into our daily lives. Semi-autonomous driving system and neural network applications in smart phones are great examples. These technologies depend on extensive scientific computation and computer vision research. Although it seems that it progresses well, the truth is that the massive calculation heavily shrinks their steps. Therefore, we plan to turn this situation around by improving the hardware efficiency with system software. OpenVX is a universal and industrial computer vision API standard released by the Khronos Group. The official and many open-source implementations of OpenVX are based on the OpenCL runtime system. Therefore, in this project we propose to optimize the OpenCX runtime system with OpenCL computing based on our previously developed work, called VirtCL—which is an OpenCL device abstraction and management framework. This project will focus on the design and implementation of four main topics (composing of nine issues): (1) Transparent and effective resource utilization of OpenCL devices in a cluster, which enables unmodified applications to be transparently distributed to computing resources in a cluster. This technique not only reduces the programming burden but also increases hardware utilization. (2) Enhancement of VirtCL’s scheduler for parallel workloads, which involves execution time prediction using machine learning and scheduling with OpenVX graphs. (3) Enabling prioritization of kernels for real-time applications, with compiler-directed temporal partitioning of kernels and runtime support for preemptive priority-based scheduling. (4) Optimization on kernel execution, which is done by reducing redundant data transfers with compiler techniques and using reinforcement learning to explore better optimization combinations for kernels. With the aforementioned techniques, we expect that we can improve the developing environment and execution performance of computer vision and machine learning application, and to push the development of system software forward in Taiwan.

project_title: 基於人工智慧之衛星影像動態事件即時辨識與災害預測系統
project_title_en: The System of Satellite Images Recognition and Disaster Prediction Based on Artificial Intelligence
institution: 國立暨南國際大學電機工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan:
在太空科技發展，遙測衛星影像將朝高解析、即時性與智慧化，因此遙測衛星的影像資料處理搭配人工智慧功能於衛星上即可具有動態事件之即時辨識功能及預測功能，並將其系統化與自動化是本計畫的目標。本計畫將以深度學習在相關災害事件進行物件辨識。方法為以衛星上搭載之攝影機所擷取之多頻譜訊號建立感興趣區域所屬之訓練資料庫，再對連續影像分析導入與時序訓練相關之遞歸神經網絡( Recurrent Neural Network，RNN )，在FPGA上實現所有系統。除了辨識事件物件外，最終可到預測接下來發生的方位提出預警進行預防動作。
本計畫之衛星影像動態事件即時辨識與災害預測系統進行設計與研製，我們規劃將分三年進行；第一年我們將進行衛星或無人機上搭載之攝影機所擷取之多頻譜訊號（multi-spectrum images H, R, G, B)建立感興趣區域所屬之影像及建立訓練資料庫，並加入深度學習強化特殊物件的影像優化。第二年我們將在相關事件之物件辨識，導入以時序之機率圖對連續影像分析進行與時序訓練相關之遞歸神經網絡( Recurrent Neural Network，RNN )，以減少FPGA的資料處理負擔，並進行整個系統FPGA設計。第三年將發展除了辨識事件物件外，最終可到預測災害發生的方位提出預警進行預防動作。期望達到系統快速執行、體積最小化以及獨立運作等目的，進而發展出使用上的簡單性、輕便性以及擴充性；發展的技術除衛星應用外，亦可推廣於無人機應用。
abstract_en_plan:
For the future development trend of space science, remote sensing satellites will focus on the aspects of high resolution, real-time and intelligence. To achieve these goals, image data processing must be systematized and automated with the artificial intelligence knowledge to achieve real-time identification and prediction missions for the satellite. This project will use the depth learning method of artificial intelligence for the disaster events identification in which we will establish a training data base of regions of interest (ROI) using the multi-spectrum images (R, G, B) captured by the cameras on the satellite. Based on the ROI image database training, the proposed deep learning method can reduce the data processing on the FPGA. Because the recurrent neural network (RNN) associates with timing training on the continuous image analysis, this project will uses RNN to design the proposed algorithm to be implemented on FPGA. In addition to identify the event object, the prediction function will be designed also for giving early warning action. 
This project plans to design and develop the system for real-time identification and disaster prediction of dynamic events in satellite. There are three years plan in the following. In the first year, we will capture multi-spectrum signals from satellite cameras. Let us establish the image database of the ROI and use the deep learning network to enhance special objects. In the second year, we will apply RNN to analyze sequential images for reducing the data processing burden on FPGA and carrying out FPGA design. The third year will improve the identification algorithm to the eventual prediction for the coming up disaster location and give  early warning and for prevention. This project expects to achieve the following goals: rapid implementation, size minimization and independent operation, and further simplicity, portability and scalability of the system. It is believed that the developed technologies can also be applied to UAV applications.

project_title: 資料探勘與機器學習演算法於非揮發性記憶體／疊瓦式硬碟系統之設計與優化
project_title_en: Design and Optimization for Data Mining and Machine Learning Algorithms on Memory-Storage Systems with Nonvolatile Memories and Shingled Magnetic Recording Disks
institution: 國立臺北科技大學電子工程系
abstract_zh_plan:
人工智慧(AI)與機器智慧(MI)已在諸多領域廣為應用，如智慧運輸、智慧製造、智慧電網、乃至於自然語言處理等。身為AI/MI的關鍵技術，機器學習與資料探勘對於發掘巨量資料中的趨勢與制定聰明的決策而言，可謂不可或缺。然而，雖然既有的計算硬體如CPU、通用圖形處理器(GPGPU)、甚至張量處理器(TPU)能夠高度平行化的處理大量的機器學習運算工作，對巨量資料的存取卻往往成為系統的效能瓶頸，而使進一步改良計算硬體架構，以期提升機器學習或資料探勘工作性能的努力徒勞無功。有鑑於此，本計畫希望發展下個世代的AI/MI環境下的記憶體－儲存裝置基礎架構，藉以極大提升機器學習及資料探勘的效能。我們預計由以下方面著手：
(1) 我們考慮機器學習及資料探勘演算法的資料存取行為，藉以改良AI/MI環境下的記憶體－儲存裝置系統，並提出相關的記憶體、儲存裝置之管理策略。舉例而言，對於寫入顯較讀取緩慢之非揮發式記憶體與疊瓦式硬碟，我們希望能大幅減少寫入操作，藉以提升系統的性能。
(2) 我們重新設計既有之機器學習與資料探勘演算法，讓他們變的真正”聰明”，而可配合非揮發式記憶體/疊瓦式硬碟的特性與當前硬體/系統的狀態，對自身的演算法進行自動調變。我們的終極目標在於讓機器學習與資料探勘演算法不再僅針對目標題目用同樣的方法做出聰明的決策，而能夠讓自己真正”聰明的”配合不同硬體與系統環境的當前情況，快速、經濟的解決問題。
(3) 大多數既有之AI/MI環境都部署在高階運算系統，使AI/MI之應用受到限制。為進一步擴展AI/MI的應用到消費型電子產品、嵌入式系統及物聯網終端裝置等低階運算環境，本計畫也將開發能輕量化機器學習與資料探勘方法的技術、最小化運行時的記憶體空間需求與能耗、同時配合後端之高階AI/MI平台的運算能力，使這些低階裝置可具備基本的智慧。此外，我們也將解決資料在前後端系統間傳輸時，所造成的安全性與資料隱私性等問題。
整個來說，本計畫之目標在於提出次世代AI/MI環境下，基於非揮發式記憶體與疊瓦式硬碟等媒體之記憶體－儲存裝置之基礎架構與跨層設計。我們考慮之非揮發式記憶體，包含快閃記憶體、PCM、STT-RAM以及ReRAM等。本計畫之產出非但能顯著改善機器學習與資料探勘之速度、能耗以及準確度，還可弭平日益嚴重的計算能力與資料I/O之間的性能代溝，對系統與AI/MI領域學、業界均有相當價值。
abstract_en_plan:
Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine intelligence (MI) have found diversified application scenarios, such as intelligent commuting, intelligent manufacturing, smart power grids, and natural language processing. As the key technologies of AI and MI, machine learning and data mining are necessary for discovering the trends and knowledge behind gigantic volumes of data, and making smart decisions without human interventions. However, with the increasing degrees of computing parallelism of central processing units (CPUs), general-purpose graphical processing units (GPGPUs), and tensor processing units (TPUs), the I/Os of gigantic volumes of data become a primary bottleneck of system performance, and further increasing the degrees of parallelism becomes a futile effort for system performance optimization. Thus, this research project aims to develop the memory–storage infrastructure for next-generation AI and MI ecosystems, which significantly enhance the performance and energy efficiency from several perspectives: 
(1) We consider the data access behaviors of existing machine learning and data mining algorithms to renovate the architecture of memory–storage systems of AI/MI ecosystems. The accompanying management designs of modern memory/storage media, which include energy-efficient nonvolatile memories (NVMs) and shingled magnetic recording disks (SMRDs), are also proposed. For instance, due to the skewed write performance of NVMs and SMRDs, the write traffic shall be minimized for performance optimization.
(2) Moreover, we propose to redesign existing data mining and machine learning algorithms to make them really intelligent from the algorithm design perspective, so as to fit the intrinsic characteristics of NVMs and SMRDs, as well as the caches/buffers designs. Our objective is to develop really intelligent algorithms for data mining and machine learning, which can automatically adapt themselves to different known or unknown system conditions for performance optimization. 
(3) While current AI and MI platforms are typically realized in high-end computing environments, to further extend the application scenarios of AI and MI, it is urgent to enable AI or MI on low-end computing environments, such as consumer electronics, embedded systems, or IoT terminal devices. In this project, we aim to make the data mining and machine learning engines space-economic and energy-efficient, and exploit the limited communication bandwidth between high-end AI/MI platforms and low-end devices to provide essential intelligence on the devices. Furthermore, the data privacy and security issues due to the communication shall also be addressed.
Summarized, the objective of this project is to develop cross-layer designs of memory–storage infrastructure for next-generation AI and MI ecosystems. Specifically, we consider popular data mining and machine learning algorithms running with a gigantic volume of training data stored in modern NVMs, such as NAND flash memory, phase-change memory (PCM), spin-torque transfer random-access memory (STT-RAM), and resistive RAM (ReRAM). We believe that the proposed designs could not only remarkably improve the performance, energy-efficiency, and precision of machine learning, but also alleviate the increasing gap between computation and data I/Os. With the outcomes of this project, the missing piece between AI and MI algorithms and existing computing architecture could be filled up, which would be very valuable for both academic and industry fields.

institution: 中原大學電子工程學系
abstract_zh_plan: 近年來隨著人工智慧高速發展，人工智慧技術大大帶動影像處理領域的發展；以類神經網路為基礎所發展的機器學習是實現人工智慧的一種方式，為了滿足更快速機器學習的需求，許多類神經網路模組透過FPGA或矽晶片進行實現，如卷積神經網路(CNN)、深度卷積神經網路(DCNN)、隨機卷積神經網絡、深度學習卷積神經網路等，透過晶片具有高速運算、低功耗與微小特性，設計出許多高效能人工智慧晶片；由於機械學習的系統架構十分複雜，加上必須透過好幾層的神經網路學習才能達一定效果，因此這些高效能人工智慧晶片大多被建置在雲端伺服器中，顯少普及至消費性電子產品；有鑑於此，本計畫希望透過軟硬體共同設計，將部份階層神經網路設計進入影像處理器晶片中，以提升有機發光二極體OLED/Micro OLED顯示器趨動晶片之效能，透過OLED/Micro OLED顯示器出廠前的訓練與學習，提供消費者最佳影像品質，並在終端消費者使用顯示器時，進行反饋，讓人工智慧影像處理晶片再次學習，並反饋使用者資訊至生產端，以提升顯示器影像品質並更貼近消費者喜好。本計畫為一個三年期計畫，預計發展具有人工智慧與機器學習功能之影像處理晶片設計，主要應用於OLED/Micro OLED顯示器趨動晶片中，本晶片包含人工智慧與影像處理二大區塊，人工智慧區塊電路主要用於顯示器出廠時透過影像感測器進行訓練，並於銷售後透過使用者依個人喜好進行訓練並反饋回製造端的雲端伺服器中；影像處理電路區塊主要接收人工智慧電路所傳送的資訊，並提供OLED/Micro OLED顯示器以下智慧化影像處理能力：(1)色彩最佳化、(2)對比增強、(3)亮度調整、(4)適應性功率調整與(5)顯示畫面解析度調整；在計畫執行上，第一年將完成人工智慧演算法與電路設計，並同時發展適合OLED/Micro OLED顯示器之色彩最佳化與對比增強影像處理演算法與電路設計；第二年將完成人工智慧與色彩最佳化與對比增強晶片下線，並發展適合OLED/Micro OLED顯示器亮度調整、適應性功率調整與顯示畫面解析度調整影像處理演算法與電路設計；第三年將完成OLED/Micro OLED顯示器亮度調整、適應性功率調整與顯示畫面解析度調整晶片下線，並將人工智慧晶片與多項影像處理器進行整合，組成一個具有人工智慧與多影像處理功能結合雲端伺服器系統之OLED/Micro OLE影像處理系統單晶片。
abstract_en_plan: Recently, the technique of artificial intelligence (AI) is developing rapidly. By using AI technique, the development of image processing fields can be promoted efficiently. The neural-based machine learning method is one kind of realization methods for AI. In order to satisfy the demand of high performance for machine learning, many machine learning modules were realized by using FPGAs and silicon chips, such as convolutional neural network (CNN), deep convolutional neural network (DCNN), deep learning neural network (DCNN), deep learning convolutional neural network etc.. Since very large scaled integrated circuits (VLSI) have benefits of low-power-consumption, high-performance and tiny, many AI chips with high-performance were developed. Since the system organization of machine learning is complex, it is necessary to use multiple layers of neural network layers for learning to achieve high efficiency. Because such kinds of high-performance AI chips are built in cloud servers, just a few AI chips are applied in consumer electronic products. In this proposal, we will use software hardware co-design methodology to realize several levels of neural network in image processor chips, which will advance the performance of driving chips for organic light-emitting diode (OLED) and micro OLED. By training the learning module in OLED and Micro OLED displays in fabricating step, the displays will provide the best displaying image quality for users. In addition, the proposed AI image processor chip will be trained and learning one more time when the users feedback information to the AI module in the image processor chip and cloud server in the factory, which promote the displaying image quality and more close to the users’ eyes.  The proposed proposal is a three years project which will develop and image processor chip including AI and machine learning functions and apply in the driving IC of OLED and micro OLED displays. There are two main parts in this chip. The first part is an AI circuit which is used to train the machine learning module by using a CMOS image camera in factory and store the favorites of users to cloud server through Internet. The other part is image processor circuit which receives information from the AI circuit and provides five image processing functions, (1) color optimization, (2) contrast enhancement, (3) luminance adjustment, (4) adaptive power control, and (5) frame resolution adjustment. The first year of the proposed project will develop hardware-oriented AI, color optimization and contrast enhancement algorithms for OLED and micro OLED displays. The second year of the proposed project will develop silicon chips of AI, color optimization and contrast enhancement for OLED and micro OLED displays. In the same time, the hardware-oriented algorithms of luminance adjustment, adaptive power control and frame resolution adjustment will be developed. The third year of the proposed project will develop silicon chips of hardware-oriented luminance adjustment, adaptive power control and frame resolution adjustment algorithms, and integrate the AI and image processors developed in the first two years.  Finally, an AI and multi-function OLED displaying image processor SoC chip and cloud server system will be realized.

project_title: 基於二硫化鉬的銅導電橋式交叉點電阻切換記憶體利用鈦/鉬界面工程的神經型態分析運用在人工智慧上(I)
project_title_en: Neuromorphic Analysis by Using Ti/Mo Interface Engineering in Mos2 Based Cu Conductive Bridging Cross-Point Resistive Switching Memories for Artificial Intelligence
institution: 長庚大學電子工程學系
abstract_zh_plan: 理想中具人類智能的機器使我們能夠探索人工智慧（AI），為將來失能/正常的人們的日常生活提供便利。新興的電阻式交叉點記憶體裝置的問世引起了研究人員對基於硬體方式的神經形態應用的關注。在人工神經網路的幫助下，人工智慧都已深入各個方面的應用，例如語音識別，影像處理，義肢及大腦模擬等。早期基於互補金屬氧化物半導體（CMOS）的神經元和突觸已被用於製造基於硬體的人工神經網絡，並用於影像處理和模式識別。 　　CBRAM和其它的電阻式記憶體具有電導調變性和非揮發性的獨特性質，這對於仿生物突觸中的學習和記憶是不可少的。另一方面，則是由於它們具有易於製造、尺寸小、可高速運作、功耗低、數據保存長久等優點。這些功能對於建立低功耗和高速突觸點至為重要。我們選用基於銅/二硫化鉬的CBRAM作為突觸使用。選擇二硫化鉬作為開關材料是因為它是二維的材料，除了具有一些獨特的電學性質，並且具有熱和化學穩定性，因此這對於未來的奈米電子裝置製造是具有前景的。　　我們對基於銅/二硫化鉬的憶阻裝置的研究，揭示了該裝置可以作為突觸來操作。而這種結構從未被用於記憶體和突觸應用。我們想要製造基於銅/(鈦/鉬)/二硫化鉬/氮化鈦的交叉點突觸運用於影像處理。這裡我們以鈦或鉬作為緩衝層來控制銅的遷移以增加突觸的電導調變狀態。然後，建立一個隨機權重變化（RWC）學習規則，並將64×64交叉點與外部神經元芯片和RWC硬體電路整合在一起。在此系統的幫助下可以用做影像處理和模式識別。以下是未來三年的工作時間表。第一年：1.銅/緩衝層/二硫化鉬/W，具有5至10μm條寬的單交叉點存儲器製造。2.驗證評估符合小於100μA及SET / RESET電壓為1 V / -0.2 V的單交叉點，其壽命為1010次，速度為100 ns，耐溫85°C，並且儲存時間為10年，並評估裝置的故障率。3.透過測量I-V切換、LTP、LTD、STDP和狀態保留，驗證評估突觸9×9交叉點記憶突觸。4.製做64×64交叉點，並優化緩衝層厚度和幾何形狀。第二年：1.用銅/(鈦/鉬)/二硫化鉬/W結構驗證評估64×64交叉點與晶體或解碼器的集成。2.驗證評估交叉點陣列的突觸利用測試裝置的電導率調變、LTP、LTD、STDP和電導率狀態的保留特性。第三年： 驗證評估完整功能的64×64憶阻陣列用於影像處理和模式識別。
abstract_en_plan: The idea of enabling machines with human intelligence has led us to explore the Artificial Intelligence (AI) for future unable/able persons’ smooth daily life. Advent of new emerging resistive memory cross-point devices have attracted the attention of researchers to hardware based neuromorphic applications. There are various aspects of introducing AI with help of ANNs such as speech recognition, image processing, prosthetic limbs, brain mimic, etc. Earlier complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) based neurons and synapses have been used to fabricate hardware based ANN system for image processing and pattern recognition. The CBRAM and other resistive memory have the unique properties of conductivity modulation and non-volatility which are essential for learning and memory in bio-inspired synapses. On the other hand they are easy to fabricate, small feature size, good for high-speed operation and consume low power with robust data retention. These features are essential to build low power and high speed synaptic points. We prefer Cu/MoS2 based CBRAM to work as synapse. To choose MoS2 as a switching material because it is 2D material which has some unique electrical properties and it is stable thermally as well as chemically, and therefore this is promising for fabricating future nano-electronic devices. Our studies on Cu/MoS2 based memristive devices have revealed that the device can operate as a synapse. This structure has never been explored for memory as well as synaptic applications. We want to fabricate Cu/(Ti/Mo)/MoS2/TiN based cross-point synapses for image processing. Here we have considered Ti or Mo as the buffer layer to control Cu migration for increasing the conductivity modulation states during synaptic evaluation.  Then we want to build a Random Weight Change (RWC) learning rule and integrate the 64 × 64 cross-points with external neuron chip and the RWC hardware circuit. With the help of the system image processing and pattern recognition will be carried out. Following is the year-wise work schedules for next three years.    First year:1. Single cross-point memory fabrication with Cu/buffer layer/MoS2/W with 5 to 10 m bar width.2. Evaluation of single cross-points with compliance of less than 100 A, SET/RESET voltage of 1 V/-0.2 V, programming endurance of 1010 cycles with 100 ns programming speed, high temperature (85 °C) retention for 10 years and determination of failure rate of devices. 3. Synaptic evaluation of 9×9 cross-points for memristive synapse by measuring I-V switching, LTP, LTD, STDP, state retention.4. Fabrication of 64 × 64 cross-points with optimized buffer layer thickness and geometry.Second year:1. Evaluation of 64 × 64 cross-points with Cu/(Ti/Mo)/MoS2/TiN structure and integration with transistor or decoder. 2. Synaptic evaluation of the cross-point array by testing the devices for conductivity modulation, LTP, LTD, STDP and retention property of the conductivity states.Third year:   Pattern and image evaluation with the fully functional 64×64 memristor arrays.

project_title: 適用於聲音情境分析之深層類神經網路硬體加速器設計及其應用之節能平台(I)

institution: 國立中正大學資訊工程學系
abstract_zh_plan: 近年來隨著語音識別、自然語言理解等技術的進展，相關的研究，也變成熱門的研究議題。同時為適應高齡化社會的來臨，與智慧語音處理相關的應用，聽覺輔具(助聽器)也成為值得關注的研究議題。然而傳統的聽覺輔具，容易受到不同聲音場景影響到聽覺補償效果，因此需要進行深度學習，並進行長時間聲音特徵擷取及辨識，以提供客製化之聽覺補償規劃及處方。為此，本計畫將針對建立高效能、低功耗之聲訊處理與辨識平台所需之低功耗深度學習之類神經網路(DNN)硬體進行開發。然而眾所周知，深度學習需要極高的運算資源，因此無法使用嵌入式系統的 CPU 進行運算，而加上 GPU 的輔助則是會有功率消耗太大的問題。因此在考量輸入訊號到輸出訊號的 Group Delay 要求，以及聲音場景變化速率的條件下，本計畫將開發合適的低功耗類神經網路架構硬體電路，並特別針對聲音訊號處理而開發，其首要之設計重點，將是節省電路成本和降低功耗。最後，考量到本計畫所建立的聲訊處理與辨識平台之實用性，我們亦規劃了本平台與手機(Gateway)間的溝通方式，將採用具有極低 Energy/bit效果的人體通道傳輸技術，直接透過人體通道，將資料傳輸至手機上。為此，本計畫也將會開發出無須參考時脈的資料回復電路供人體通道傳輸使用。
abstract_en_plan: In recent years, with the progress of speech recognition, natural language understanding technologies, intelligent acoustic signal analysis become a popular research topic. At the same time, due to the aging of the society, the hearing aids related applications has also become a research topic worthy of attention. However, traditional hearing aids are easily affected by different auditory scenes. Therefore, it is necessary to use deep learning for a long time sound features capture and identification to provide customized hearing compensation prescription. Thus, we will develop a low-power neural network hardware accelerator for the proposed high-performance low-power audio processing and identification platform. However, deep learning requires very high computing resources, it can not use the CPU in the embedded system for computing, and GPUs have high power consumption. Therefore, in consideration of the group delay and the rate of change of the auditory scenes, in this project, we will develop a suitable low-power hardware architecture for the deep neural network specifically for acoustic signal processing. The primary design requirements will be to save area cost and reduce power consumption. Finally, considering the practicality of the proposed audio processing and identification platform, we also plan the communication between the platform and the mobile phone (gateway). We will adopt the human body channel communication which has extremely low energy/bit performance, and we will develop a reference-less clock and data recovery circuit for the human body channel communication.

project_title: 高效能低功耗負電容負電阻電阻式記憶體與薄膜電晶體元件技術開發
project_title_en: Development of High-Performance and Low-Power Consumption Negative Capacitance Negative Resistance Resistive Memories and Thin Film Transistors
institution: 國立雲林科技大學工程科技研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 此計畫係將鐵電材料中之極化現象與新穎之負電容、負電阻效應同時應用於電阻式記憶體(RRAM)及氧化物薄膜電晶體(TFT)元件，並整合製作1T1R記憶體單元，最後完成高效能、高操作速度、低功耗之記憶體陣列。本團隊已發現於極化現象伴隨著負電阻效應特性下，RRAM元件可擁有極低之高電阻阻態電流與操作電壓。此外，近年來發現，材料極化方向改變過程中會擁有一暫態負電容效應產生，此效應已證明可應用於突破電晶體之次臨界擺幅極限。本團隊推測此效應具有改善RRAM特性之潛力，其可提升高低電阻阻態電流之下降與上升速度，可再降低操作電壓並大幅增大記憶窗口。此外目前亦近乎無將負電容效應應用於氧化物薄膜電晶體之研究(請見計劃書說明)，因為將負電容應用於元件特性改善前，必須先解決電容匹配問題，負電容與氧化物半導體薄膜之電容匹配完全不同於一般具有塊材半導體之電晶體，具有相當之困難度。本計畫將整合理論研究與元件開發，解決薄膜電晶體負電容匹配問題並詳細探討其物理機制。最後將上述效應利用同一製程同時導入並完成TFT與RRAM元件及memory array製作。計畫內容包含負電容材料開發研究、電容匹配問題解決、NC-TFT、NC-RRAM、NC 1T1R記憶體單元與陣列開發、電阻轉換及載子傳輸等物理機制研究。
abstract_en_plan: In this project, polarization, negative capacitance (NC) effect, and negative resistance (NR) effect will be applied to resistive random access memory (RRAM) and thin-film transistor (TFT) devices. A one transistor one resistor (1T1R)cell  and a high-performance, high operation speed, and low-power consumption memory array will be fabricated. We have found that polarization along with the negative resistance effect can lower the high-resistance state (HRS) current and the operation voltage of an RRAM device. Recently, negative capacitance effect has been used to reduce sub-threshold swings of field effect transistors. We deduce that the NC effect can improve the current decrease/increase speed in high-resistance state/low-resistance state of the RRAM device. Besides, the NC effect has not been thoroughly investigated for TFT applications because compared with the FET with a bulk semiconductor, capacitance matching issue between the NC material and the thin oxide semiconductor in a TFT device is difficult to be addressed. This project will solve the capacitance matching issue and study the corresponding physical mechanisms. The effects mentioned above will be integrated to fabricate RRAMs, TFTs, and a memory array in the same process flow. Research of NC materials, capacitance matching, NC-TFT, NC-RRAM, 1T1R cell, memory array, resistive switching mechanism, and carrier transport mechanism will be included.
