project_title: 積層型三維智慧物連網晶片之研究(I)
project_title_en: Study of Monolithic 3d+ Intelligent Iots Chip
institution: 財團法人國家實驗研究院奈米元件實驗室
abstract_zh_plan: 近年來，物聯網及人工智慧所需之智能終端元件需滿足低成本及高能源效率之條件,而將TSV-free積層型三維積體電路應用於人工智慧晶片擁有著許多優點，其中包含(1)低製造成本(2)高頻寬及高晶片面積使用效率(3)因導入三維垂直的金屬導線而降低寄生附載效應。另外，記憶體內運算的架構可以大幅提升運算速度，但其最大的缺點就是將電晶體與記憶體同時製作會占據相當大的面積，所以透過積層型3DIC的方式恰好是最適合用來製作記憶體內運算晶片的方法。然而，由於積層型3DIC晶片製程的過程中，需避免熱效應(thermal impact)導致底層元件的劣化，故積層型3DIC晶片的製作需完全符合後段製程的溫度要求。在本計畫中，我們提出以國家奈米元件實驗室獨創之具低成本異質整合的積層型3DIC技術為基礎，導入更為先進之半導體技術及更高實用性之多層電路製作能力，用於開發於具智慧化之物聯網晶片。本團隊於2012年逐步發展了多項低熱預算製造技術，包括可堆疊雷射結晶矽通道及雷射活化技術，並應用於實現異質整合積層型3DIC，在單晶片式三維積體線路領域技術，領先全球。相關研究成果包括發表10篇以上之積層型3DIC 為主軸國際電子元件會議文章(International Electron Devices Meeting，IEDM)，其內容涵蓋以50nm超薄通道電晶體為核心之邏輯線路、積層型靜態隨機存取記憶體(SRAM)、等)。其中兩篇更被選為IEDM之公開宣傳資料。 此三年期計畫的目標，是藉由開發多項前瞻低熱預算技術來實現單晶片上具多層電路之積層型3DIC技術，提供學界在記憶體內運算、三維物聯網智慧晶片之技術開發。目標包括:第一年， (1)導入電漿薄膜及雷射製程技術，控制製程溫度低於450oC，完成10 奈米可堆疊鰭式電晶體之開發；於第二年開發先進HK/Metal gate技術，提升P- N- FinFETs Vth對稱性，並驗證至6T SRAM；第三年則開發無雷射損傷之金屬化製程技術，及雙層以上電路之金屬導線串連技術，提供並開放積層型3DIC製程服務平台用於驗證多層記憶體內運算技術，以具智能化之三維物連網晶片之概念研究。
abstract_en_plan: In recent years, intelligent terminal devices used in IoT and artificial intelligence need to meet the conditions of low cost and high energy efficiency, however, the TSV-free monolithic 3DIC applied to artificial intelligence chip has many advantages, including (1) Low manufacturing cost (2) High bandwidth and high chip area efficiency (3) Reduced parasitic loading due to the introduction of three-dimensional vertical interconnect.The Von Neumann architecture used in traditional computer operations slows the overall speed of operation because of the large number of signals that must be transferred between the CPU and memory. The computing in-memory, also known as non-Von Neumann architecture, is seen as a solution to this problem. Although the architecture of memory operation can greatly improve the speed of operation, but its biggest drawback is that the transistor and memory integrated in same chip will occupy a large area, and in today's circuit design, increase the area is to increase the cost, so TSV-free monolithic 3DIC seems exactly the most suitable process for the fabrication of computing in-memory chips. However, how to manage the thermal impact of the multi-tiered processes, such as dopant activation, source/drain silicidation, and channel formation, and to avoid the degradation of the pre-existing devices/circuit become key challenges. In this project, we propose a low cost hetero-integrated monolithic 3DIC technology for the applications of devices of Internet of Things. The proposed key low thermal budget technologies are included (1) developing a highly gate controlled stackable FinFET structure by introducing low thermal budget plasma-enhanced deposition thin film and laser-assisted FinFET structure, (2) improving the threshold voltage symmetry of stackable FinFET by band gap engineering, (3) carrying out a monolithic 3D IoTs chips in in-memory computing application by integrating multilayer interconnect circuits technology. Our team reported several leading low thermal budget manufacturing including stackable laser crystallized Si channel and hetero-integration technologies for monolithic 3D+IC in the last six years. We published more than 10 conference papers in International Electron Device Meeting (IEDM) covering 50nm UTB based stackable inverter, logic circuits, SRAM, non-volatile memory and energy harvesting technology. Two of the paper were selected as IEDM publicity materials.The target of three-year project is the construction of prototype monolithic 3D+IC IoTs chip by several advanced thermal budget technologies. The specifications of target in the first year include (1) developing a 10nm stackable FinFET by introducing low thermal budget process (below 450oC) including plasma-enhanced deposition thin film and laser-assisted FinFET structure. The specifications of target in the second year include improving the threshold voltage symmetry of stackable FinFET by band gap engineering to realize a 6T SRAM circuits. The third year target is to develop laser-harmless metallization technology and more than two layers interconnect technology. A monolithic 3DIC fabrication platform to verify in-memory computing will be established in NDL using several key technologies developed by this project to improve IoTs research in Taiwan.

project_title: 利用氧化石墨烯電阻記憶體製備電子突觸元件
project_title_en: An Electronic Synapse Device Based on Graphene-Oxide Resistive Switching Memory
institution: 國立高雄科技大學電資學院電子工程系
abstract_zh_plan: 近年來由於人工智慧和大數據的蓬勃發展將造成未來所需的計算量大幅增長。而傳統的Von-Neumann架構在計算上有其限制，對於沒有定義好的輸入訊號無法有效率地處理。因此，神經形態元件被用來製作神經網路模擬大腦的計算功能，而電子突觸是其中最重要的元件。電阻式記憶體為二端式元件，可被整合成三維結構，且其元件內部的離子遷移和突觸的機制相當類似，是目前最適合發展成電子突觸的元件。本計畫將利用氧化石墨烯(GO)電阻記憶體製備電子突觸元件。相較於電阻記憶體所需的突然電阻變化，電子突觸元件需要類比電阻轉態特性以模擬突觸受訊號造成的連續強化和抑制作用。此計畫分為四個部分: 第一部分先製備GO電阻記憶體，並進行相關的界面與電流傳導機制探討；第二部分利用不同電極材料和控制GO內部氧化量來控制界面狀態，形成類比電阻轉態；第三部分利用增加操作電壓和堆疊結構降低電子突觸操作所需的能量，以期達到小於1 pJ；第四部份是整合前面的部分，製備並確認電子突觸元件是否為非絲狀路徑元件。
abstract_en_plan: Following the development of artificial intelligence and big data, the required amount of computation will increase dramatically in the future. However, the conventional Von-Neumann architecture has the limitations and can not efficiently process undefined input signals. However, human brain can process these signals efficiently. Therefore, neuromorphic computing is designed to simulate the computational functions of the human brain. Among all neuromorphic devices, the electronic synapse is the most important one. Resistive random access memory (RRAM) with a 2-terminal simple structure can be integrated into a 3D structure. In addition, the ion migration mechanism in RRAM is similar to the synaptic function. Currently, RRAM device is the most promising candidate for electronic synaptic applications. This project will fabricate graphene oxide (GO) RRAM as electronic synaptic devices. However, in contrast to the sudden resistance changes required by RRAM, electronic synaptic devices require an analog resistance-switching property to simulate the continuous potentiation and depression of synaptic signals. This project is divided into four parts: the first part prepares the GO RRAM and discusses the related interface and the conduction mechanism; the second part uses different electrode materials and different oxidation amounts of GO layers to optimize the interface status to form the analog resistance switching; the third part utilizes higher operating voltage and stacked structure to reduce the synaptic operating energy (< 1 pJ); the fourth part is to integrate the previous sections to fabricate a non-filamentary electronic synaptic device.

project_title: 應用於2.5/3 維異質晶片系統整合之智慧導向設計自動化( I )
project_title_en: Intelligent Design Automation for 2.5/3d Heterogeneous Soc Integration( I )
institution: 國立臺灣大學電子工程學研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 隨著現代電路設計中設計複雜度的急劇增加，2.5/3 維晶片/封裝/電路板整合已成為系統性能和功耗優化的有效解決方案。在這些2.5/3維的技術中，晶圓級集成扇出（InFO）堆疊式封裝 （PoP）已成為重要的先進封裝技術，且已被台積電等主要公司採用，以實現高密度、高性能、低成本的封裝技術。由於沒有襯底和倒裝凸塊，InFO-PoP的平均高度比其他PoP設計平均降低20％。除了厚度減少之外，InFO-PoP在散熱、可靠性、電遷移和異質系統整合的兼容性方面也優於其他PoP技術。 隨著當代電路系統設計中對大頻寬、高性能和低功率傳輸的增長需求，單以電路連線可能無法滿足設計要求，因此基於奈米光子元件的光通信技術，由於其大頻寬、低連線延遲和低功耗等特性，在最近引起很多關注。因此，英特爾和台積電等半導體巨頭正在積極探索在現代2.5/3維異質系統中整合光電信號互連的技術。為了實現高品質的2.5/3維異質整合系統設計，我們將研究晶片、封裝和電路板協同設計的方法，使用InFO-PoP和光通信等高級封裝技術，並探討在實體設計、時序、電氣效應和測試等設計程序下的相關主題。	實體設計：2.5/3維異質整合設計的現有擺置繞線演算法可能會因為InFO-PoP和光通信衍生設計條件和異質架構下的限制，導致整體解決方案品質不佳。因此，發展全新用於異質系統整合設計的靈活、穩健且具垂直整合的實體設計流程是十分必要的。 	時序分析：現有學界的時序分析器是基於非線性延遲模型所開發的，但由於高電阻互連、非線性驅動特性、長尾信號和不可忽略的米勒電容，非線性延遲模型對於當代電路系統的時序分析是不準確的。因此，我們需要發展基於較佳電流源模型的靜態時序分析方法，同時考慮晶片和封裝整合時序分析，來提供較快速而準確的電路波形模擬。	電氣分析：我們將提出跨越晶片/封裝/電路板不同階層的寄生電路萃取、模型簡化和訊號完整性的整合分析方法。我們更將利用現有的人工智慧引擎來加速包含 InFO 封裝的系統層級電路分析。	測試：由於掃描測試模式與功能模式的差異，部分較不明顯的錯誤在量產測試時可能沒有被正確地測試。我們將發展以機器學習為基礎的近似功能測試產生技術，以確保待測系統在近似於功能模式的環境下可以被有效地測試。封閉迴路的學習策略與平行技術將被使用來提升建模效率，並降低測試產生時間。
abstract_en_plan: As the design complexity grows dramatically in modern circuit designs, 2.5D/3D chip/package/board integration has become effective for optimizing system performance and power consumption. Among the explored technologies, the wafer-level integrated fan-out (InFO) package-on-package (PoP) has been adopted by major companies such as TSMC to achieve high-density, high-performance, low-cost packaging.         With the increasing demands for large bandwidth, high performance, and low-power transmission in modern system designs, electrical wires alone might not meet the design requirements well, and optical communication with nanophotonic devices and interconnections has attracted much attention recently, due to its large bandwidth, low interconnection delay, and low power consumption.  Consequently, semiconductor giants like Intel and TSMC are actively exploring the technologies for integrating electrical and optical interconnections in modern systems.To achieve a high-quality 2.5D/3D heterogeneous integration system, therefore, we shall study in this 3-year project the chip, package, and board codesign methodology with advanced packages like InFO-PoPs and optical communication considering essential issues on physical design, timing, electrical effects, and testing.• Physical design: Existing placement and routing algorithms for 2.5D/3D heterogeneous system could lead to solution quality degradation under new constraints and heterogeneous architectures, especially with InFO-PoPs and optical communication. Therefore, it is desirable to develop a flexible, robust, and vertically integrated physical design flow for such heterogeneous integration design.• Timing analysis: Existing academic timers for chip-level analysis are developed based on nonlinear delay model (NLDM). Nevertheless, NLDM is inaccurate for timing analysis for modern designs because of highly resistive interconnect, nonlinear driver characteristics, signal with long tail, and unignorable Miller capacitance. Therefore, new static timing analysis (STA) approaches based on current source models (CSM) are desired to deliver fast and accurate waveform propagation. Furthermore, a new methodology is also desired for chip-package timing co-analysis.• Electrical analysis: Existing design methodology and flows to design chips and packages may not be effective with unexpected noise not only from the homogeneous monolithic layers, but also possibly the most complicated heterogeneous architectures.  Furthermore, non-Manhattan routing in a 2.5D or even a 3D structure imposes even more difficulties to already hard magnetic coupling issues. Therefore, traditional electrical analysis and algorithms require immediate renovations and possibly resurrections. We propose to integrate the parasitics extraction, model reduction, and signal integrity analysis cross over the three levels of a complete heterogeneous non-rectilinear routing system. We also intend to use widely available AI engines to speed up the system-level electrical analysis with InFO packages.• Testing: Due to the discrepancy between the scan-test mode and the functional mode, some subtle timing defects are either not tested or not properly tested. We propose to develop a machine learning assisted pseudo-functional test generation technique to ensure that the system is tested in a functional-like environment. Close-loop learning strategies and parallelism are employed in the test generator to improve the model efficiency and reduce CPU times. Aiming at the addressed big challenges, this project intends to explore key techniques for the EDA flow and develop a complete tool chain to handle the emerging challenges with 2.5D/3D heterogeneous system-on-chip integration.

project_title: 針對考慮效能與能源最佳化的終端人工智慧運算的設計及設計自動化的研究( I )
project_title_en: Design and Design Automation for Edge Ai Computation Considering Performance and Energy Optimization( I )
institution: 國立清華大學資訊工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 為了將服務分散化，打破雲端計算(cloud computing)的限制，改採用fog/edge computing的概念取代，讓AI無論是在裝置和服務面上，皆可以遍佈各處。由於終端元件通常只有有限的資源且電源供應不是很充裕，減少計算量及功率消耗就變得非常重要。同時誤差容忍及回復精確性的要求也是必須要考量的。因此在本計畫中，我們將研究有考量到效能及功耗優化的AI終端計算的架構和演算法。分項一: 二值化神經網路之近似計算與優化: 將二值化神經網路應用於移動平台的終端元件上，可以提升能源效率及減少模型的大小。在模型推論時，運用近似計算及優化的技術，在滿足正確性的限制下，來減少計算量及硬體的需求。分項二: 考慮積極性能優化人工智慧晶片之高效自適應神經網絡: 本分項計畫考量兩種人工智慧晶片產生運算錯誤情形。第一種為考慮硬體的運算資源，使用激進的時序或功耗最佳化下所產生的運算錯誤，第二種為使用低功耗的記憶體內運算時，因環境條件所產生的運算變異錯誤，本分項計畫將分析運算錯誤與功率消耗考量的關係，接著提出高效自適應神經網絡，在符合功率優化考量下同時維持神經網路於人工智慧晶片上的應用準確度。分項三: 神經網路分層量化技術之軟硬體設計與整合平台: 針對AI計算於終端裝置的節能需求，提出一個基於分層量化技術之優化平台，其中包括分層量化軟體的開發、強化分層量化之節能效果所需的硬體設計、以及整合前述軟硬體所需的工具鏈。
abstract_en_plan: To de-centralize the service from AI server, we need to solve the key issue of high volume computation and high power demand in the AI applications. Edge computing paradigm is a possible solution to this issue, which use edge devices to collect and process input data for de-centralization. Since edge devices usually have limited resources and are battery constrained, reducing computation and power consumption is quite important. Also, error tolerance or accuracy recovery in the edge devices also have to take into account. Thus, in this project, we are going to study the architecture, and algorithms for AI edge computation considering performance and power optimization.Sub-Project I: Approximate Computing and Optimization for Binarized Neural Network: Applying BNN to the edge devices on mobile platforms can elevate the energy efficiency and reduce model size. In the model inference, we use approximate computing and optimization techniques to reduce the operation count and hardware resource requirement under the accuracy constraint.Sub-Project II: Efficient Adaptive Neural Network for AI Chip Considering Aggressive Performance Optimization: This project will consider two types of errors: 1. Errors caused by aggressive timing or power optimization 2. Errors caused by variations in Computation-In-Memory (CIM). This project will analyze the relationship between computation errors and power consumption. Meanwhile, propose an efficient adaptive NN that maintains the accuracy of it while meeting power optimization.Sub-Project III: Design, Automation and Methodology for Energy-efficient Edge AI Computation based on Quantized Neural Networks: We propose to, based on layer-wise quantization, explicitly address DNN’s energy efficiency problem from the software, hardware, and integration perspectives.

project_title: 針對內建人工智慧之車用晶片且以【零故障】為目標之智慧型測試方法( I )
project_title_en: Test-For-Zero: Smart Test Methodology towards Zero Failure Rate for Ai-Inside Automotive Chips( I )
institution: 國立清華大學電機工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 近年來，AI-inside汽車電子（本計畫中縮寫為AA晶片）是IC技術的主要驅動力之一。現代汽車內部可以輕易擁有數十個甚至超過100個晶片。這些晶片中有可能不僅要求“高性能”而且要求“高可靠性”，因而帶來許多技術上的挑戰。例如，它們應該能夠在極端惡劣的操作環境下正常工作（例如，-40°C-150°C的溫度範圍和輻射環境下）。此外，它們需要能夠應對基於AI的高性能計算（例如顯著溫度變化，以及電源電壓瞬間下降等）引起的晶片內部的顯著干擾。此外，它們需要滿足嚴格的功能安全要求，在10到15年的使用壽命期間幾乎達到零故障率。由於這些挑戰，高質量的設計和測試方法（不僅涉及測試，還涉及可靠性和長壽命設計）已成為這類AA將片能否成功的關鍵因素之一。在這個整合計畫中，我們的目標是在三年內執行高端的科學技術研究，以建立統一而完整的智能測試方法，以實現AI-Inside汽車晶片的零失效率。整合計畫由4個子項目組成，包括以下三個主要特徵：（1）我們涵蓋所有測試階段，從測試晶片驗證，晶圓級測試，製造測試，到在線測試。（2）所有階段產生的測試數據將被集中利用並轉化為精細分辨率的測試功能，稱為TestDNA，並從中進行智能測試決策，旨在捕獲難以檢測的微小瑕疵或瞬態缺陷，以增強整體測試質量，同時實現幾乎零故障率。（3）將特別研究由軟錯誤和/或PVTA效應（製程，電壓變化，溫度變化，和老化效應）引起的功能安全危害的在線測試和監控方法，以確保目標AA晶片運行的長壽命的可靠性。每個子項目的主題概述如下。（子計畫-1）：用於智能汽車晶片的新型 TestDNA 為基礎的晶圓缺陷簽名分析，以用於診斷和提高產量品質。（子計畫-2）：軟錯誤率分析的數據導向建模方法，和在線老化監測機制。（子計畫-3）：高性能邏輯電路的在線安全危害和老化檢測。（子計畫-4）：AI硬件加速器的大數據驅動在線測試，重新配置和可靠性增強方法。
abstract_en_plan: In recent years, AI-inside Automotive electronics (abbreviated as AA-chip in the sequel) are major drivers of IC technology. A modern car can easily have dozens or even more than one hundred ICs inside. Most of these ICs demand not only "high performance" but also "high reliability", leading to many technical challenges. For example, they should be able to operate normally under extremely harsh operating environments (e.g., -40C–150C temperature range and radiation). Besides, they need to be able to cope with significant disturbances inside the chip induced by the AI-based high-performance computing such as significant temperature and/or IR-drop. Furthermore, they need to satisfy the stringent functional safety requirement of almost zero failure rate throughout a lifetime of 10 to 15 years. Due to these challenges, high-quality design and test methodology (involving not only testing but also design for reliability and long lifetime) has become one of the key factors to the success of this type of AA-chips.In this group project, we aim to conduct advanced integrated research in three years to establish a unified Smart Test Methodology Towards Zero Failure Rate for AI-Inside Automotive Chips (nicknamed Test-for-Zero Project). This group project, consisting of 4 subprojects, includes the following three key features:(1)	We cover all test phases, from test chip validation, wafer level test, manufacturing test, to online test.(2)	Test data produced at all phases will be intensively exploited and turned into fine-resolution test features, called TestDNA, and from which smart test decisions aimed at capturing hard-to-detect small and/or transient defects are made to enhance the overall test quality, while achieving almost zero failure rate.(3)	Online test and monitoring methods for functional safety hazards induced by soft errors and/or PVTA effects (Process, Voltage, Temperature, and Aging) will be particularly investigated to ensure the reliability over a long lifetime for a target AA-chip operating in the field.The topics of each subproject are outlined below.(Subproject-1): Novel TestDNA Wafer Defect Signature for Diagnosis and Yield Improvement in Smart Manufacturing AI-Inside Automotive Chips.(Subproject-2): Data-oriented Modeling of Soft-Error-Rate Analysis and Mechanism of Online Aging Monitoring.(Subproject-3): Online Safety Hazards and Aging Detection for High-Performance Logic Circuits(Subproject-4): Big-Data Driven Online Testing, Reconfiguration, and Reliability Enhancement for AI Hardware Accelerators.

project_title: 以記憶體為中心的人工智慧邊緣產品EDA方案: 具重新配置能力的系統評估與實作( I )
project_title_en: Eda Solutions for Memory-Centric Ai Edge: System Evaluation and Implementation for Reconfigurability( I )
institution: 國立交通大學電子研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 傳統的人工智慧大多在雲端上進行資料分析與處理，對伺服器及網路傳輸的負載都相當大，在邊緣/終端裝置上內建人工智慧，讓每個裝置都具備基本的運算能力，被認為是目前最好的解決方案，但在遇到各種不同應用時，往往因為種種的限制，無法快速變更硬體的配置，造成設計成本的浪費。此外，人工智慧的實現需仰賴大量的資料運算，常會造成嚴重的記憶體存取頻寬問題，因此，在記憶體中內建基本的運算能力來減少資料搬移，就成了近來熱門的研究方向，若再搭配新興記憶體的體積小、速度快的特性，將可大幅提升AI終端裝置的效能並降低成本。然而，面對這些全新的架構及元件，從演算法、架構到電路與元件都要重新發展一套設計方法，從各個層面同時最佳化，才能完成最佳的設計。本計畫提出的EDA解決方案，就是針對記憶體運算的應用，希望能提供快速重組的能力，針對不同應用提供最適合的硬體設計。在計畫的第一部份，我們會從記憶體架構分析開始，針對DRAM/SRAM/ReRAM等不同的特性，提供混合記憶體電路與架構的設計、分析與最佳化技術，協助使用者找出最適合目前應用的架構；在計畫的第二部分，則會根據架構分析的結果，利用電路合成技術快速地完成整個記憶體的電路調整，並自動生成準確的記憶體行為模型，以便與數位電路一起進行模擬驗證；在計畫的第三部分，則是著重在IC的實體設計，根據電路設計的結果，快速地完成整個記憶體系統的佈局規畫與繞線，並提供所需的標準元件庫。特別值得一提的是，為了避免紙上談兵的疑慮，本計畫特別邀請了電路設計團隊共同參與，並得到半導體廠的奧援，讓我們有機會用真實的IC來測試所提出的EDA方案。最後的產出除了以記憶體為中心的AI晶片，可因任務改變配置的運算架構系統，還可提供對應的完整EDA解決方案，這是目前EDA公司都還未開發出來的重要設計工具，應可對產業界發揮非常大的貢獻。
abstract_en_plan: Conventional AI mostly performs data analysis and process on the cloud, this will add very heavy burden on the servers, data centers and network communication. Currently the best solutions for this configuration is to have basic neural network computing capability at the edge devices. However when we need different applications such as massive IoT environment or 5G communications, due to various constraints, it is not possible to rapidly change the hardware configuration, thus causing the waste of the design cost. On the other hand, AI algorithm needs a lot of computing units to implement a neural network. In order to reduce the power consumption and huge area, recently many researchers replace the fully digital computing unit to mixed memory computing unit. The advantage of in-memory computing is parallelizing computing, small device size, high speed, and embedded computing ability which can resolve the bottleneck of current AI design. For different edge-AI applications, there are different kinds of requirements and specifications which increase the design period of time. In order to reduce this developing time, we have to implement a new EDA methodology for the edge-AI design flow.This EDA proposal is specifically for the in-memory computing application to support the optimal solution of the reconfigurable ability for different edge-AI hardware design. First, we will analyze the memory circuits and architectures, which include DRAM, SRAM, and ReRAM. Based on those different mixed-mode memory architectures, we will analyze and optimize the solutions for designers to choose the best suitable architectures for their hardware. The second part of this proposal, following on the first part, we will implement the new technology to synthesize and optimize the whole memory circuitry, and automatically generate the accurate behavior models of the memory to co-simulate with the digital part of circuit. The third part will focus on physical implementation. According to the design pre-layout simulation result, the EDA tools can complete the auto place and route in very short turn-around time. There are different design groups, which include EDA teams, circuit design teams, and foundry, involved in this project. Thus we can implement a real edge-AI chip based on this methodology and verify the final outcome. Our goal is to propose the best suitable EDA tool for the edge-AI applications, which is not seen in current EDA vendor solutions.

project_title: 智慧電子系統之高效能電子設計自動化流程-總計畫暨子計畫五：智慧電子系統之高效能測試診斷流程
project_title_en: High-Performance Test and Diagnosis Techniques for Intelligent Electronic System Designs
institution: 國立臺灣大學電子工程學研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 未來人工智慧(AI)晶片將使用在重要任務上─例如自駕車─必須非常可靠，可測試性可靠性對AI晶片是重要的關鍵。本子計畫將研究「人工智慧高效能測試，診斷，ECO技術」。第一年，此計畫提出「AI增強的高效能壓縮自動圖樣生產技術(ATPG)」。利用機器學習從過往版本電路ATPG找出最佳壓縮的錯誤排列方法，這將會改善未來改版電路的測試圖樣壓縮率。儘管新電路有一點點不同，但大部分錯誤仍維持不變。如此AI增強的ATPG將會更聰明，可以從過去經驗學習，在更短的時間內達到更好的壓縮率。第二年提出「AI增強的高效能電壓降分析與工程變更命令技術」。晶片上有大量的元件，我們可以利用少數的元件訓練機器學習模型並用來預測其他元件電壓衰退，透過這種方法就能減少功率與電壓衰退的分析時間。接著，依據上述的模型打造一個AI增強的自動ECO工具修復電壓衰退問題，再利用上述模型預測修復後電壓降。藉此，可以大幅減少ECO反覆電壓降分析的過程。第三年，此計畫將建「AI增強的高準確度多重缺陷診斷工具」。此工具擅長電壓衰退造成的群聚多重延遲缺陷，並使用非監督式學習診斷這些多重缺陷。本工具能找出IR電壓降的熱區，對改善良率十分有用。
abstract_en_plan:
For mission critical applications, such as autonomous driving, we want our AI chips to be very reliable.  Testability and reliability are the most important features for the future AI chips.  Therefore, this subproject will work on the topic: AI-enhanced High Performance ATPG, Diagnosis, and ECO Techniques.
In the first year of this subproject, we will propose an AI-enhanced ATPG for high-performance Test compression.  We propose to use machine learning to learn from the past ATPG so that we know what are the best fault order to be compressed.  This learning helps to improve our test compression in the future ATPG for the revised circuits.  Even though these circuit revisions are slightly different, most of the faults remain the same.  This AI-enhanced ATPG is smart to learn from the past experience.  It can compress our test pattern better in a shorter time.
In the second year of this subproject, we propose AI-enhanced high-performance IR-drop analysis and ECO techniques.  Since there are many cells in the chip, we can actually train the machine learning model based on a small number of sampled cells, and predict the power and IR drop of the other cells.  In this way, we may be able to shorten the power/IR drop analysis time at a small cost of insignificant error.  Based on this IR-drop prediction model, we will build an AI-enhance automatic ECO tool to help to fix IR-drop violations.  Then we will use this model to predict new IR drop values after the cell move.  In this way, we can significantly shorten simulation time and automate the ECO process.
In the third year, we will build an AI-enhance high-accuracy diagnosis for multiple defects.  This tool is especially good at clustered multiple delay faults induced by IR-drop.  We propose to use unsupervised machine learning to diagnose multiple defects.  This diagnosis tool is very useful to identify IR-drop hotspots to improve the yield.

project_title: 智慧電子系統之高效能電子設計自動化流程-子計畫一：高效能智慧系統合成技術
project_title_en: Ai-Enhanced High Performance Synthesis of Intelligent Systems
institution: 國立臺灣大學電子工程學研究所
abstract_zh_plan:
機器學習技術的最新進展使人工智慧(AI)成為科技焦點。AI系統於各領域的應用正如火如荼地發展中。在AI時代的開端，要使AI廣泛被運用的主要技術挑戰之一是在AI系統的硬體部署，特別是在終端元件上的深層神經網路（NN）。這些終端元件受其工作條件和硬體實施成本的強烈約束。終端元件通常需要低功耗，能實時反應，有時以永久在線模式運行，不能用特殊的熱管理解決方案。這些要求形成了很大的設計挑戰。另一方面，NN的拓撲和參數可能需要隨時間更新。因此，可重構的硬體架構是極有必要的。

在此計畫，我們將探究以下主題，將NN編譯至可重構硬體架構的系統晶片。
1.  NN benchmark研究與功能單元定義（第1年）：
通過對各種應用中代表性NN的基準研究，我們打算識別和定義潛在硬體加速的基本功能單元。
2.  NN硬體/軟體協同實作與編譯流程建構（第1年）：
我們將探索不同的中間表示式（IR），用以優化NN的規格和編譯效率。然後，我們將構建一個用於將NN映射到可重構SoC的編譯器。
3.  硬體感知之NN再訓練和優化（第2年）：
為了使NN在硬體加速器上具有高計算效率與低面積成本，我們將研究和修改NN訓練過程，以使NN滿足預期的硬體實現優勢。
4.  量化和位寬縮減技術（第2年）：
在保持NN目標精確度的條件下，浮點運算應以定點運算來代替以增進硬體實現優勢。我們將研究量化和位寬減少的技術以及保持NN精確度的方法。
5.  NN電路高階與邏輯合成（第3年）：
NN層可以分為計算密集層和記憶密集層。我們將在同時性，延遲和面積之間的不同權衡下對功耗進行優化。此外，我們將在邏輯閘層級開發基於閾值邏輯合成的NN電路優化技術。我們將開發邏輯優化方法以簡化實體設計。
6.  NN電路實現的計算典範探索（第3年）：
我們計劃探索不同的計算典範，例如，基於異質系統的計算，隨機計算和基於RRAM的計算等。

基於上述計劃的工作項目，我們將能培育年輕研究人員對AI系統技術的掌握，並對AI系統硬體部署的實現做出貢獻。
abstract_en_plan:
The recent advancements of machine learning (ML) techniques have brought artificial intelligence (AI) into the spotlight. AI systems are under active development in various industrial sectors, such as transportation, energy, manufacturing, medication, finance, and defense. At the dawn of the AI era, one of the main technical challenges to making AI accessible and ubiquitous is in the hardware deployment of AI systems, in particular, deep neural networks (NNs) on edge devices, which are strongly constrained by their working conditions and hardware implementation costs. An edge device may often need to be low power, require no special thermal management solutions, react in real time, and sometimes operate in an always-on mode. These requirements impose great design challenges. On the other hand, the topologies and parameters of NNs under deployment may need to be updated over time. Therefore, reconfigurable hardware architectures are desirable.

In this project, we will investigate the following subjects to compile NNs into reconfigurable hardware architectures. 
1. NN benchmark study and function unit definition (1st year):
Through the benchmark study of representative NNs in various applications, we intend to identify and define essential function units for potential hardware acceleration.
2. NN specification and compilation for hardware/software co-implementation (1st year):
We will explore different intermediate representations (IRs) to maximize efficiency of NN specification and compilation. We will then construct a compilation framework for mapping NNs into reconfigurable SoCs.
3. Hardware-aware NN retraining and optimization (2nd year):
To make NNs computationally efficient on hardware accelerators, we will investigate and modify the NN training procedure to make NNs adequate for the intended hardware implementation.
4. Quantization and bit-width reduction techniques (2nd year):
Whenever the target accuracy can be maintained, floating-point computations should be replaced with fixed-point computations. We will study techniques for quantization and bit-width reduction as well as methods to retain NN accuracy.
5. High-level and logic synthesis of NN circuits (3rd year):
NN layers can be classified into computation-bound layers and memory-bound layers. We will optimize them in terms of power consumption under different tradeoffs among concurrency, latency, and area. Also we will develop techniques at the logic gate level for NN circuit optimization based on threshold logic synthesis. We will develop logic optimization methods to ease physical design.
6. Computation paradigm exploration for NN circuit implementation (3rd year): 

We plan to explore computation paradigms, e.g., heterogeneous computation, stochastic computation, and RRAM-based computation.
With this project, we will train and educate young researchers to tackle the challenges and make practical contributions to hardware deployment of AI systems.

project_title: 人造神經模擬人類感覺神經的運作
project_title_en: Artificial Neurons Emulate Workings of Human Sensory Nerve
institution: 國立成功大學電機工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 在工業4.0的革命下，人工智慧領域的產品將持續受到市場關注。為了提供人工智慧產品的終端應用，仿生人腦的人造神經網路建構，是未來發展的重要方向。然而，與生物大腦相比，人造神經網路系統在處理大量資料運算時，需要耗費大量的功率。因此模仿神經行為的低耗能高密度電子元件是未來能否真正發展出人腦晶片最重要的關鍵之一。本計畫利用三維電阻式記憶體陣列結構結合互補式金屬氧化物半導體元件，製作出低耗能混合型的電子突觸，模仿生物神經元突觸行為，除了能有效解決因漏電流路徑所造成的讀取錯誤之問題，提升線性精準度和突觸權重外，亦可在持續幾百個波形操作增益及抑制特性過程中維持穩定之變化範圍。此外，在計畫第三年，將整合振盪器和感測器製作人造神經系統，透過振盪器和混合型電子突觸，將溫度感測器收集到的訊息轉換成電位，模擬生物體感系統的溫度信息處理和感覺神經的功能，為發展仿生神經系統之關鍵。本研究計畫將與台灣半導體研究中心合作，創建低耗能、可並行處理、具容錯性和自適應性之人造感測器網路，因應未來新興人工智慧的產業需求，並能在未來嵌入人工智慧機器人的類皮膚中。
abstract_en_plan: Under the revolution of Industry 4.0, products associated with artificial intelligence will achieve the ultimate market attention. In order to provide the wide application of artificial intelligence products, the artificial neural network construction of the bionic human brain is the most important direction for future development. However, artificial neural network systems require a huge amount of power to deal with large amount of data operations compared to biological brains. Therefore, low-energy, high-density electronic components that can mimic neuro-behavior are one of the most important keys for practical development of human brain chips in the future. The project consists of three-dimensional resistive memory array structure combined with a complementary metal oxide semiconductor device to produce a low-energy hybrid electronic synapse that mimics the synaptic behavior of biological neurons, in addition to effectively solving the leakage current path. The main limitations like, reading errors, improving linearity accuracy and synaptic weight, can also be maintained during the process of sustaining hundreds of waveform operation gains and suppression characteristics by the input waveform modulation gain and suppression range as well as the stability variation can be controlled easily. In addition, in the third year of the project, the hybrid artificial electronic synapse integrated oscillator and sensor, convert the information through the oscillator and the hybrid electronic synapse and collected by the temperature sensor into a potential leading to simulation and proper design of robot like creature. abstract_zh_plan:
深度神經網路是一廣泛被使用的人工智慧技術，在人工智慧終端裝置應用上，深度神經網路引擎需要符合低耗能、高彈性、及短的端至端等待時間。因此本總計畫『應用於人體姿勢辨識與機器人之可重組深度神經網路引擎』將開發一應用於人體姿勢辨識與機器人之可重組深度神經網路引擎來符合這些要求。所開發之可重組深度神經網路引擎具有以下創新性：1）可支援監督式及強化式學習之深度神經網路；2）可支援不同深度神經網路模型之推論；3）使用混合數位與類比運算單元來降低耗能；4）利用姿勢與行為辨識系統以驗證此引擎之效能。

此子計畫『應用於監督式學習之可重組深度神經網路技術』將開發應用於監督式學習深度神經網路之可重組技術。所開發之可重組技術具有以下創新性：1）固定端至端等待時間之可重組技術；2）可支援不同模型之可重組技術；3）可用於混合數位與類比運算單元之可重組技術。
abstract_en_plan:
Deep neural network (DNN) is one widely used artificial intelligence (AI) technique. The DNN engine in edge devices for the AI applications should meet the requirements of low energy, high flexibility, and short end-to-end latency. Therefore, we attempt to develop a reconfigurable DNN (RDNN) engine for the applications of human posture recognition and robotics to meet the requirements under the grand project entitled “Reconfigurable Deep Neural Network Engine for human posture recognition and robotics”. The innovations of the developed RDNN include: 1) support the supervised and reinforcement learning algorithms; 2) support various DNN models including compressed models; 3) use hybrid digital and analog computing units to minimize energy consumption; and 4) using posture and behavior recognition system to verify the performance of RDNN engine.

This subproject entitled “Reconfigurable Deep Neural Network Techniques for Supervised Learning” attempts to develop reconfigurable design techniques for DNN with supervised learning. The innovations of this subproject include: 1) reconfigurable technique for CNNs under the constraint of end-to-end latency; 2) reconfigurable technique for various CNN models; 3) reconfigurable technique for hybrid digital and analog computing units.

abstract_zh_plan: 近年來由於人工智慧技術的發展加上行動運算日漸普及，因此終端裝置上支援神經網路運算功能的加速器逐漸成為配備選項之一。本整合型計畫將開發用於終端裝置的人工智慧運算加速器—可重組深度神經網路引擎，預計運用可重組設計來面對不同應用情境所需採用的運算模型；並搭配監督式學習與強化式學習的神經網路，可根據應用來轉換學習能力以提高智慧終端的應用範圍；同時結合類比神經網路與數位神經網路，依據資料精度與網路複雜度需求調配所使用的神經網路型態，以降低功耗。而本子計畫將發展『應用於強化式學習之可重組深度神經網路技術』，強化式學習近來因為在圍棋對弈中屢次擊敗人類的頂尖棋士而大放異彩，透過機械自身的經驗來強化決策的最佳性，因此強化式學習可探索人類專家未知的領域，可用於電腦科學、神經科學、心理學、經濟學、數學與工程等，是未來人工智慧發展不可或缺的一項利器。我們預計研究強化式學習下之基於深度Q網路演算法以及特性，並研究深度Q神經網路的架構以及優先經驗回放記憶體的存取設計技術，針對Q值運算、損失函數後向傳播運算、經驗回放記憶體的存取等技術進行開發，使訓練階段可以達到有效率的經驗記憶體使用方式，並針對以上模組開發可重組式的彈性架構設計。預計從硬體實作的角度來考量演算法的創新設計並評估整合於深度Q網路的可行性或必要性。最後將分析探討關於有限精度效應的影響，考慮正向傳遞與反向傳遞兼容於硬體加速器內，考量強化式學習之推論與學習皆在端點運算的可行性，預計設計一高產出率的強化式學習之可重組深度神經網路，最終將整合於一系統晶片中，實現高效能低功耗的運算引擎。
abstract_en_plan: Recently because of the development of artificial intelligence techniques and prevailing mobile computing, incorporating a neural network computing acceleration unit becomes one of the features in the edge devices. This integrated project aims to realize the artificial intelligent computing accelerator, reconfigurable deep neural network engine, for edge devices so that the computing models can be adapted according to the different application scenarios. Both supervised learning and reinforcement learning processing elements are included. Thus, the learning capabilities can be changed and programmed to extend the possible applications. In addition, the combination of analog neuromorphic computing and digital neural processing elements offers the flexibility to alter the computation styles regarding the requirements of precision and network complexity to reduce the power consumption. This sub-project will design and develop the reconfigurable deep neural network techniques for reinforcement learning. Reinforcement learning plays an important role in recent AlphaGo games. It also offers the driving strength to enhance the self-learning capability of artificial intelligent devices. Many important techniques have been proposed and examined in Atari games. We aim to study the deep Q network algorithm and its related properties for reinforcement learning. Also, recent improvements, including double Q network, prioritized experience replay, and actor-critic techniques, will be evaluated to see the necessity and possibility to insert them into the hardware implementation. The read and write access to the experience replay memory will be studied so that the content in the replay memory of a constrained size can be utilized efficiently. A reconfigurable architecture will be designed to support applications with different models. Furthermore, the impact of finite precision effect of the deep Q network will be analyzed and discussed. The forward propagation and backward propagation are also considered in the accelerator to support the feasibility of training and inference in the edge devices. We target at designing a high-throughput reconfigurable deep neural network for reinforcement learning and integrate it in the system on chip so that a high-efficiency and low-power computing engine can be realized.

project_title: 應用智慧模組之毫米波陣列天線預編碼與混合波束成形智慧技術之數位基頻電路與系統開發

institution: 國立交通大學電子研究所
abstract_zh_plan:
(總計畫)
此計畫針對新世代5G行動通訊5G+(2022年)Mid-band (1GHz—6GHz)到毫米波(mmWave)24GHz以上行動通訊系統架構著手發展未來可能之關鍵模組。期望在提高資料傳輸速率(總量10Gbps以上)之同時，亦提出可重組之傳收機架構與創新技術。其中幾個可行的創新系統技術中包含：利用陣列天線的混合式波束成形增進系統效能與容量及行動式毫米波系統的創新快速連線及智慧訊號接收理論法則與電路架構;可自我重組架構之基頻處理架構; 自我學習，記憶體內運算與 analog FFT based DCNN 技術；多重接取FFT/適應性濾波模組等。此外，將AI運算及其相對之動態重組織架構融入波束成形、追踪、通道估測及參數動態調整，以使Tx/Rx在複雜及動態的環境下仍能高速傳輸資料。各子計畫將基於毫米波頻段陣列天線行動通訊蜂巢式系統及無線系統，針對上述所提之關鍵技術合作共同開發具可接受複雜度且保有高性能之演算法、系統架構、硬體、晶片實作及雛型建構與實測。

(子計畫)
為了達到更高的資料傳輸速率、同時可服務多使用者、提升傳輸通道多樣性以及擁有更可靠的傳輸品質，在mmW band採用MIMO與Beamforming是增加頻譜使用效率、訊號強化與多重接取的關鍵技術。然而多天線傳輸之自相干擾會造成效能大幅降低與接收端解調不易，因此預編碼與解碼演算法是MIMO系統實現之重要技術。次世代的無線通訊傳接機，必須提供更智能及更高效率的動態重組架構。尤其當環境變得更複雜，為了保持傳輸的穩定性，在設計時必須考慮不同的環境與通道變數、系統的同步不確定性及增大之類比與RF模組在mmW band的不理想效應，此時理想的切片器(slicer)無法應付這樣多變的環境，因此發展一個智慧型切片器對於次世代通訊有很大的助益。預編碼與解碼演算法與智慧型切片器及其它使用人工智慧技術所產生的大量運算，可以使用卷積神經網路並於記憶體內運算來完成以降低功率。卷積神經網路的權重因子可預先處存於記憶體內，再藉由記憶體內運算優異的高度平行運算能力來完成計算。本計畫所建立的預編碼、Beamforming、智慧型切片器、記憶體內運算之卷積神經網路和先前所建立的基於802.11ad/ay的60 GHz傳收機系統整合建立次世代智慧型無線通訊天線陣列訊號處理電路與系統，來增大系統效能(10 Gbps)與降低功率消耗。
abstract_en_plan:
(總計畫)
The project is geared towards the development of key modules for a new generation 5G+ (202X) Mid-band (1GHz-6GHz) to millimeter wave band mobile communication system. It is expected to increase the data transmission rate (over 10 Gbps), and at the same time propose a reconfigurable transceiver architecture with innovative technology. Several of the possible innovative system technologies include: hybrid beamforming with array antennas to enhance system performance and capacity, and innovative fast connection and intelligent signal reception theory and circuit architecture for mobile millimeter wave systems; self-organization baseband processing architecture; self-learning in-memory and analog FFT based DCNN technology; multiple access FFT/adaptive filter modules. In addition, AI operations and their dynamic reorganization architecture are fused into beamforming, tracking, channel and system parameters estimation and are dynamically adjusted so that Tx/Rx can transfer data at high speed even in a complex and dynamic environment. 
Each sub-project will be based on the millimeter-wave array antenna mobile communication cellular and wireless system, and jointly develop acceptable complexity and high performance algorithms, system architecture, hardware and chip for the key technologies mentioned above, implementation and prototype construction and actual measurement.

(子計畫)
In order to achieve higher data transmission rate, serve multi-user, increase channel diversity, and have more reliability transmission quality, using mmW band with Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) and beamforming are currently the key techniques for increasing bandwidth efficiency, strengthening signal, and multi access. However, the interference among multi-antenna transmission cause receiver difficult to do demodulation and degrade system performance. Therefore, the precoding and decoding methods are important techniques to implement MIMO system. In next generation wireless communication, it shall provide more intelligent and efficient method to organize architecture of network. In order to maintain stability of transmission in more complicated environment, it is necessary to consider different environmental variables, system uncertainties, and non-ideal effects of analog front-end and RF modules when designing the system. For example, it is great advancement for next generation wireless communication to develop an intelligent slicer. Convolution neural network (CNN) and in-memory computing can solve the increased computation complexity of using AI in these techniques. The weighted factors of CNN can be stored in memory in advance. After that, the calculation can be completed by the highly parallel computing in-memory to reduce power consumption. This project will employee the precoding, beamforming, intelligent slicer, and in-memory computing for CNN to design the intelligent antenna array signal processing circuits and systems for next generation wireless communications. The key modules of this project will be integrated with our previous 60 GHz transceiver system based on 802.11ay/ad standard, and become a new transceiver for next generation wireless communication.

institution: 國立高雄大學電機工程學系
abstract_zh_plan:
固定位置小區域的屏下(On-display)光學式指紋感測器是目前在具製作可行性條件下，最為先進的一種低成本指紋感測器。但它的指紋圖形成像品質極差，使得指紋辨識必須重新開發新的演算法。本計畫擬引用深度學習(Deep Learning)理論，整合兩種GAN(Generative Adversarial Network)網路，亦即CGAN(Conditional GAN)與DCGAN(Deep Convolution GAN)，提出創新性C-DCGAN屏下模糊指紋清晰化深度學習演算法，以提升指紋辨識準確率。未來3-5年內，傳統晶圓晶片式(Wafer Chip)指紋感測器將快速為屏下感測器所取代，並逐步發展為全螢幕(On-full-display)均具有感測指紋的功能，稱為全屏指紋感測器。屆時多根手指可同時被採集片段(Partial)或全(Full)指紋並進行即時辨識。由於是多根手指即時辨識，其辨識率將大幅揚升，促使指紋辨識在金融安全技術(Financial Security Technology)的應用價值全面提升。
本計畫第一年將進行屏下光學指紋感測器擷取裝置模組設計，並將品質極模糊指紋圖像以人為專家標註(Labelling)為清晰的標準理想指紋圖像(Ground Truth)提供給深度學習網路訓練使用。另引入氣孔、方向圖、細線圖進行C-DCGAN生成清晰指紋圖像的模型架構設計。第二年擬提出創新性C-DCGAN清晰化與Faster RCNN氣孔分類萃取演算法，採用Python與Tensorflow結合部分C語言完成模糊片段與多手指指紋進行清晰化深度學習的訓練程式設計。並以GPU於Nvidia GeForce GTX TITAN X顯示卡加速程式運行。第三年擬使用Zedboard ARM/FPGA嵌入式平台進行CNN氣孔分類萃取與方向圖演算法硬體化的FPGA架構與電路設計。最後完成整體屏下C-DCGAN Generator的大量測試，驗證清晰化指紋經過氣孔與方向場引導加強後的指紋辨識系統，獲得FAR/FRR與ROC辨識率。
abstract_en_plan:
The fingerprint on-display optical (FOD) sensor, which holds a fixed small area position, is currently the most advanced low-cost fingerprint sensor under the condition of production feasibility. However, its fingerprint image quality is very poor, so that the fingerprint recognition algorithm must be re-developed. The project proposes to refer to the deep learning theory and integrate two generative adversarial networks (GANs), namely conditional GAN (CGAN) and deep convolution GAN (DCGAN), to achieve an innovative C-DCGAN algorithm to enhence the poor image quality of FOD sensor so that the fingerprint recognition rate will be improved. In the next 3-5 years, the traditional wafer chip fingerprint sensor will gradually be replaced by FOD t sensor, and will develop into on-full-display all have the function of sensing fingerprint, known as fingerprint on-full-display sensor. Multiple fingers can then be collected partial fingerprints or full fingerprints at the same time and verified in real time. Moreover, due to it is a multi-finger, its recognition rate will be greatly increased, prompting the application value of fingerprint verification in financial security to ascend in an all-round way.
The first year of the project will be the FOD capture device module design, as well as its blurred and very much not clear fingerprint image will be labeled as a clear standard ideal fingerprint image, called Ground Truth(GT), by artificial experts for the use of deep learning training. In addition, it is proposed to use innovative modified C-DCGAN to design a model architecture for the generation of clear and good quality fingerprint images, and to introduce an attempt to enhance C-DCGAN model training with Faster RCNN based pore extraction, orientation map and thinned diagram. The second year is proposed to formally propose an innovative C-DCGAN deep learning algorithm, using Python and TensorFlow combined with C language in part to complete the deep learning training and testing program design for blurred partial fingerprints and multi-finger fingerprints. Also, the accelerating platform validation test will run with the GPU in the nvidia GeForce GTX TITAN X display adater card. In the third year, it is intended to use Zedboard ARM/FPGA embedded platform to carry out hardware FPGA circuit design for the algorithms of CNN pore extraction and orientation field generation, respectively, to achieve the fingerprint recognition based on hardware accelerators of CNN pore location and orientation map. Finally, a large number of tests output from the C-DAGAN generator using fingerprint on-display/on-full-display sensor will be acoomplished, and the FAR/FRR and ROC recognition curves are verified.

abstract_zh_plan: 本計畫為三年期計畫，研究目的為針對半導體製程所發展應用於3奈米以下世代元件可能用到鐵電磁性材料與目前的鰭式場效電晶體整合成負電容鰭式電晶體(Negative Capacitance(NC) FinFET)。藉由與國家實驗室奈米實驗室(NDL)與晶片中心(CIC)的合作開發NC-FinFET，研究囊括現今製程的材料鐵電探討與分析(鐵電薄膜材料分析與電、磁滯現象測試)。更可用更低操作電壓達到相同的操作電流以降低元件功耗，另外將選擇與NC-FinFET種磁性材料之電阻式隨機存取記憶體(RRAM)，作為整合型記憶體(integrated Memory)結構製程。本計畫針對半導體製程可能用到單一磁性材料完成NC-FinFET與RRAM之設計與製作，計畫由元件設計、製作到分析量測，最後將完成NC-FinFET+ RRAM 1T1R cell結構，並嘗試設計出可行之應用電路，晶圓完成後建立相關量測技術與測試平台，進行量測分析，完成矽體厚度效應、量子效應、磁滯現象、變異性等元件電性測試以及特性變異分析，並對NC-FinFET與RRAM 以及1T1R cell進行相關可靠性研究與磁滯現象對界面缺陷以及元件特性以及可靠性之影響，最後將設計出應用於人工智慧之深度學習之晶片。預期本計畫之執行，累積3nm以下奈米元件技術，將可協助厚植台灣在相關領域的研發實力，以及應用於新人工智慧所需之深度學習晶片設計相關經驗，並可強化國家實驗室奈米實驗室與晶片中心的能量，為學界打造一條龍的研究環境，成果將提供給產業界參考找出可行之技術與應用。
abstract_en_plan:
In this work, we try to develop an Bulk-Si Based Negative Capacitance high-k/Metal Tri-gate FinFET (NC-FinFET) in three years for 3nm and beyond technology node, including inspecting the hysteresis effect in NC-Fin body thickness effect、screening effect、quantum mechanical effects and reliability check. By the way, we also propose a Resistive RAM (RRAM) to integrate with NC-FinFET as a 1T1R cell for advance integrated memory circuit is considered as one of the most promising device candidate for AI-edge application for sub-3nm technology node application.  
In three years, we will cooperate with National Nano Device Laboratories (NDL) and Chip Implementation Center (CIC) to develop and fabricate a prototype NC-FinFET as well as RRAM in bulk Si substrate, and also demo a 1T1R cell. In first year, we will focus on setting up the process flow and evaluate relate parameter to optimize the integration of tri-gate NC-FinFET, especially combining high-k/metal-gate with tri-gate NC-FinFET technology. Furthermore, hysteresis effect and quantum effect will be investigated; further related device’s characteristic variance will be also inspected including basic device’s electrical characteristic and reliability. We will also develop unique measurement tool and high temperature platform to analyze variance (DC, noise and RTN) and reliability (hot carrier effect, N/PTBI etc. ) of tri-gate NC-FinFET. In the second year, we will fabricate RRAM. We will set up a process flow and evaluate relate parameter to optimize the integration of RRAM. Related hysteresis effect induced interface defect inspection and reliability check will be developed.  In the third year, 1T(NC-FinFET) 1R (RRAM) cell will be proposed to demo an integrated memory real circuit to prove possible structure in AI related SOC chip. These results will be provided as a reference to the semiconductor foundry. With the development of this three years project, we believe it is a good opportunity to help student and researcher learning and build up knowledge of advance semiconductor physic and materials science for NC-FinFET, RRAM, and related integrated memory chip. Moreover, professionals can be also trained well at sub 3nm device including simulation, design, fabrication, measurement and reliability check, which is very helpful to promote the level of research in university and further enhancing our semiconductor industry’s competitiveness.

institution: 國立交通大學電子研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 中樞運動神經基底核(basal ganglia)的主要功能為調控自主運動的訊息，當黑質核(substantia nigra)的多巴胺神經元(dopaminergic neurons)開始退化後，造成基底核的平衡狀態破壞，導致帕金森氏病(Parkinson's disease)的運動障礙症狀；深腦刺激器(Deep brain stimulation)的電極植入標的為視丘下核(subthalamic nucleus)或內側蒼白球(internal globus pallidus)，透過高頻的電刺激可抑制過度活躍的神經活性，改善晚期帕金森病人的動作困難症狀；帕金森病人植入深腦刺激電極時，在視丘下核記錄局部場電位(local field potential)，會有異常的低頻β共振，此共振可作為帕金森氏病症狀的疾病生物特徵，本計畫以此獨特的β共振作為電刺激回饋控制的訊號，為可適性深腦刺激(adaptive deep brain stimulation)。本計畫旨在探索深腦電位病理訊號之產生機轉，針對深腦電位訊號與運動障礙症狀進行關連性分析，並深入研究深腦刺激訊號，包括刺激波形、刺激頻率等參數，對帕金森氏病的作用機制，經機器學習(machine learning)與醫生標記的資料相互比對正確性，透過人工智慧(Artificial Intelligence)調整刺激閾值，來達到最佳的治療效果，由工程與醫療界的跨領域團隊合作，開發信號放大、濾波、類比/數位轉換、以及電刺激產生模組，加入數位信號處理單元進行系統單晶片(System-On-Chip)設計，整合成智慧型可適性深腦刺激系統。本計畫預期可發展單晶片體外機可適性深腦刺激系統，以供醫師在病人身上永久植入深腦刺激器前，能夠做為參數調校之最佳化設定與療效觀察，並進行臨床病理症狀、動物及人體實驗研究，本計畫團隊所開發之智慧型可適性深腦刺激系統將可大幅降低刺激器的電能消耗，也可避免不必要的電刺激所帶給患者多餘的風險與神經損傷，本計畫將申請系統臨床人體試驗，並期望能在第一期計畫之後，爭取到後續第二期4年的長期計畫來完成植入式智慧型可適性深腦刺激系統產品開發與驗證。
abstract_en_plan: The basal ganglia are associated with multiple functions, including motor control of voluntary movement. When the dopaminergic neurons of the substantia nigra degenerated, the balance between the direct and indirect pathways of the basal ganglia is disrupted, leading to symptoms of Parkinson's disease (PD). Deep brain stimulation (DBS) uses high frequency electrical stimulation to inhibit hyperactive neuronal activities by implanting electrodes in the subthalamic nucleus and internal globus pallidus, which can improve movement disorder symptoms of advanced PD patients. Local field potential (LFP) can be recorded by the DBS electrode. The abnormal low-frequency β band oscillation of LFPs from the subthalamic nucleus and internal globus pallidus of PD patients are correlated with the severity of symptoms. Therefore, β band oscillation can be used as a disease biomarker of PD for feedback control. This project is to study β band oscillation in PD patients and develop adaptive DBS system. The purpose of this project is to explore the mechanism of pathological signals in deep brain potential, to analyze the correlation between deep brain potential signals and movement disorder symptoms, and to study the therapeutic effects of different deep brain stimulation waves, including parameters such as stimulation waveforms and frequencies. The project uses machine learning and doctor-labeled data to find pathological signals and intelligently adjust the stimulation threshold. The project develops signal amplification, filtering, analog/digital conversion, electrical stimulation generation, and digital signal processing modules for System-On-Chip design. Work with an interdisciplinary team of engineering and medical to integrate into an intelligent adaptive DBS system. The project is expected to develop a single-chip external machine for adaptive DBS system. Our system can set optimal parameters and observe the effects and symptoms before permanently implanting the deep brain stimulator in patient. The project will also conduct animal and human experiments to evaluate safety and efficacy and apply for clinical trial. The intelligent adaptive DBS system can reduce the power consumption of the stimulator and avoid unnecessary nerve damage. The long-term goal of this project is to commercialize our intelligent adaptive DBS system in the 2nd-pahse of next 4-year long-term plan.

abstract_zh_plan: 蝦類及文蛤為臺灣主要水產養殖物種，然而受疾病與養殖池水質不良的影響，近年來均遭遇產量銳減之苦：蝦子近年產量銳減超過87%以上；文蛤近三年發生大量死亡事件，死亡率高達五到九成。雖然目前商業上已有許多水質監測設備可以檢測養殖池，但仍有兩大問題：(1)水質狀況並不等於水產之生長狀況。它們為底棲性生物，多生活在池底，水質混濁不易觀測，無法即時了解其覓食、健康及生長狀況；(2) 一般養殖戶無足夠之專業以解讀生長、水質及環境數據並採取對應措施。為了解決前述問題，本整合型計畫結合了電子資訊(子計畫一、四、五)及水產養殖(子計畫二、三)專長的團隊，開發一個具基於物聯網、影像處理及人工智慧等軟硬體科技的底棲性水產養殖之智慧化影像觀測暨管理監控系統：子計畫一負責團隊之協調及整合，建置監控系統之軟硬體及雲端之中控環境平台，建立水質、環境量測及水下影像之巨量資料庫，藉由人工智慧深度學習等處理，進行蝦子及文蛤行為、成長及疾病之特徵分析，並進一步結合水質/環境/餵食/成長等資料及專家經驗建立相關因素模式及智慧化決策。子計畫二及三具海洋生物及水質專長，分別負責規劃蝦子及文蛤養殖場域之建置及操作、養殖管理及觀測、定義系統需求、協助解讀水下水產影像(行為、成長及疾病)及水質/環境資料、建立餌料使用率、成長速率、育成率、生物量等數值及環境劣化、疾病等之預警策略、建立與民間養殖戶之合作關係、實驗、評估與改善。子計畫四負責邊緣端之物聯網裝置，主要為水下影像優化及辨認的特殊用途硬體電路並將其與攝影機整合為一嵌入式系統。該系統採用人工智慧之深度神經網路運算架構以克服水質混濁與低能見度的挑戰，並根據辨認結果動態調整影像品質以優化網路頻寬、儲存空間與電力消耗，降低整體建置及操作成本。子計畫五開發在雲端伺服器之自動化影像處理方法，以取代低效率之人力監控。將水下攝影機傳回之影像，利用機器學習及影像處理的方法，自動偵測出水產數量、活動力等生長狀況、餌料狀況及生長環境的重要因子，作為智慧養殖管理機制決策依據，以提高養殖之效率。本計畫利用台灣極富國際競爭力的電資領域技術，藉由物聯網及人工智慧技術實現影像自動分析及排汙/餵食/能源之管理，改善蝦子及文蛤養殖所遭遇諸如成長、除汙、飼料轉換率等問題，預期可改善育成率30%、人力成本30%以上，可進行技術移轉或新創事業，促進台灣養殖智之慧化與自動化轉型，成為世界之標竿。
abstract_en_plan: Shrimp and clam are important aquaculture farming species in Taiwan. However, both face significant production decreases in recent years due to diseases and poor water quality. Although commercial water quality monitoring devices have been available, there are still two issues: (1) water quality is not equivalent to their health/growth conditions. They live in turbid water and muddy waterbed where real-time feeding, growing, and health conditions are difficult to observe. (2) Traditional farmers don’t have enough professionalism to interpret the water quality data and animal behavior/activity to take appropriate actions.To solve these issues, we establish a multidisciplinary team consisting of experts from aquacultures (sub-projects 2, 3) and electronics and computers (sub-projects 1, 4, 5) areas to develop automated monitoring and management system with artificial intelligence capability for shrimp and clam farming. Sub-project 1 is responsible to coordinate and integrate efforts of all sub-projects. It is tasked with the integration, including building the software, hardware, and cloud environment of the monitoring system, establishing big data database of water quality, environmental parameters, and shrimps’/clams’ underwater images and behavior analytics. Data correlation and decision strategy will be established when incorporating expert experience with the water quality/environment/feeding/behavior database.Sub-project 1 is responsible to coordinate and integrate efforts of all sub-projects, including building the smart monitoring and control center consisting of hardware and software modules, constructing the database of shrimps’ and clams’ underwater images and information about their behavior/growth/disease, analyzing water quality and environmental data, integrating farmers’ experiences, establishing feed conversion ratio/growth rate/livability/biomass standards and early warning strategies based on artificial intelligence related techniques such as deep learning.  Sub-projects 2 and 3 are responsible for defining the needs of underwater observation for shrimps and calms, respectively. They then implement the smart shrimp/clam farms, interpret the underwater images for behavior, growth, and diseases, etc., analyze water quality and environmental data, establish feed conversion ratio/growth rate/livability/biomass standards and early warning strategies, and conduct collaboration with commercial farmers.Sub-project 4 develops electronics circuits for underwater imagery recognition and optimization, then integrates them into an embedded system, as an IoT device deployed in the aquaculture farm. It adopts AI’s deep neural network computation architecture to overcome the low visibility in turbid water, then dynamically adjusts the image rate/quality to optimize network bandwidth, storage space and power consumption, reducing overall cost. Sub-project 5 develops automatic image analysis techniques for the cloud servers in order to overcome the inefficiency of manual observation. It utilizes machine learning and image processing techniques to enhance the underwater images, analyze the quantity/activity/health of shrimps/clams, feed status, environment situations, etc. Such analytics are provided to the smart monitoring and control center for further processing.In conclusion, we combine Taiwan’s renowned electronic and information technologies with AI to solve the issues faced by the shrimp/clam farming industry, aiming to transform Taiwan’s aquaculture farming into a intelligent business, and having great potential to become the world’s leader.

abstract_zh_plan: 本計畫以新興 RISC 架構之 RISC-V ISA為主題，針對客製化擴編指令特性，在未來 AI 運算中，能夠提供 LLVM 編譯器最佳化，本計畫將在李政崑教授帶領下，探討如何在AI計算環境下提供RISC-V Packed-SIMD Extension並結合LLVM intrinsic support最佳化來提升效能，主要目的為利用TVM的主要功用為將AI模型編譯成LLVM IR，透過LLVM IR將AI模型編譯成RISC-V的執行程式。而TVM，為主要用於CPU，GPU和專用AI加速器的開放式原始碼深度學習編譯器stack，主要目標是在縮小以productivity為重點的深度學習框架，與效能或效率導向的硬體後端之間的差距。RISC-V，由RISC-V Foundation主持，起始於加州柏克萊分校，David Patterson教授亦是協助設計RISC-V的作者之一。因為RISC-V所具備高度客製化指令的架構特性，可以因應未來AI環境的多樣性功能需求，在系統軟體層級有著相當大的研究發展空間。計畫主持人清大李政崑教授，李教授曾經擔任三期經濟部學界科專計畫總主持人。2012年至2015年擔任經濟部學界開發產業技術計畫「嵌入式編譯器與繪圖軟體基礎技術研發三年計畫」總主持人，領導團隊開發嵌入式編譯器及應用技術。此計畫和聯發科、資策會以及工研院合作為台灣嵌入式GPUs and HSA GPUs開發編譯器工具(with OpenCL)。李教授任教至今培育16 位博士人才，其中4 位取得教職，包含台灣師大、中正、交大。另外12 位於產業界，包含7 位任職於聯發科技、1位任職於晶心科技、1位任職於瑞昱以及1位任職於美國uber open source 總監。此外李教授也有多項專利以及技術移轉，成功完成技術移轉案達29 件，技術授權金及權利金累計達NT$15,467,250元，技術授權部分包括多項編譯器技術授權與晶心科技，協助建立自主技術。李教授並於科技部大聯盟計畫「前瞻下世代行動通訊終端關鍵技術研究」支援聯發科參與Khronos 國際產業標準OpenCL Next 制定。此外，近幾年也結合TVM、LLVM及RISC-V等技術之相關研究，積極參與RISC-V Workshop發表相關RISC-V編譯器技術的papers (2018 Barcelona, 2019 Hsinchu)
abstract_en_plan: Based on the RISC-V ISA of the emerging RISC architecture, this project aims to optimize the LLVM compiler with RISC-V Packed-SIMD Extension instruction sets for future AI operations. Because RISC-V has the architectural characteristics of highly customized instructions, it can have considerable research and development space at the system software level in response to the diverse functional requirements of the future AI environment. Using the main function of TVM compile the AI model to LLVM IR. We can continue to compile the AI model into the RISC-V executable through LLVM IR. In this project, the major items include: 1)TVM lowering with fixed point 2)AI model and validation 3)LLVM intrinsic support for 32/64bit subword SIMD 4)LLVM intrinsic support for 32/64bit subword SIMD saturation. TVM, the open source deep learning compiler stack for CPU, GPU and dedicated AI accelerators, aims to narrow down the product-focused deep learning framework with performance or efficiency-oriented hardware back-ends. RISC-V, hosted by the RISC-V Foundation, began at Berkeley. Because RISC-V has the architectural characteristics of highly customized instructions, it can have considerable research and development space at the system software level in response to the diverse functional requirements of the future AI environment. This project explores how to provide RISC-V Packed-SIMD Extension in AI computing environment and optimize performance with LLVM intrinsic support optimization. The innovations for the solutions will play an important role to meet future technology challenges.Professor Jenq Kuen Lee was a recipient of the most original paper award in ICPP '97 with the paper entitled "Data Distribution Analysis and Optimization for Pointer-Based Distributed Programs". In 2005, he received Taiwan MOEA funding to lead a research team to develop compilers for PAC VLIW DSP processors with distributed register files by collaborating with ITRI STC.  He is also a recipient of Google Research Award (Mountain View), 2009. He was also a director for Taiwan MOE ESW (embedded system software) consortium 2008-2013. project_title: 應力型負電容電晶體技術發展與其電性可靠度探討
project_title_en: Process Technology, Electrical Analysis and Reliability Study of Stressed-Type Negative Capacitance Field Effect Transistor
institution: 國立臺灣師範大學機電工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 為因應物聯網和AI人工智慧晶片發展，開發具備低漏電流和低功耗操作的電晶體元件已是半導體產業研發重點，而負電容電晶體技術(Negative Capacitance FET)更是關鍵技術之一。然而，最新研究結果顯示，摻雜之氧化鉿鐵電層在微縮等效氧化層厚度時可能面臨許多挑戰，如摻雜比例調變困難、氧化層介面劣化、多重鐵電域、以及鐵電域介面釘札等問題。且當負電容電晶體出現高漏電流時，將改變鐵電元件動態切換行為，使得負電容操作不再穩定，甚至導致電容匹配無法最佳化，最終將影響負電容電晶體動態響應以及電性可靠度。因此，如何在超薄厚度下維持鐵電特性，並有效抑制元件漏電流特性，以及穩定負電容動態切換行為，是負電容電晶體應用於次5奈米節點技術首要面臨的議題。今年我們於2018 VLSI國際會議中，提出了高微縮性且可低功耗操作的無摻雜氧化鉿負電容電晶體，透過實驗結果我們證明了結合應變閘極工程和厚度控制，可以在沒有摻雜的情況下實現鐵電特性，並將無摻雜鐵電氧化鉿應用在負電容電晶體中。而氮電漿鈍化製程可進一步改善負電電晶體關閉漏電流，以及與漏電流習習相關的負電容匹配問題。此低功耗負電容電晶體實現了超陡峭35mV/dec次臨界擺幅、近七個數量級的開關電流比、以及超低1pA/m關閉電流等開關性能。為了更進一步開發符合低功耗物聯網與先進邏輯元件需求的電晶體技術，本研究計畫提出兩年期實驗規畫與相對應解決方案，具體研究方向包含5nm以下N-/P-type HfO2 NCFET，並搭配介面工程和最佳化之應力型閘極，達到3nm以下之超薄鐵電層厚度。我們近三年鐵電負電容元件研發成果，已發表於全球指標型國際會議IEEE VLSI, IEDM, IRPS上，包含2016 VLSI、2016 IRPS、2017 IEDM、2018 IRPS、2018 VLSI，足以說明我們深耕鐵電負電技術多年，已具備研究能力執行此一多年期計畫。本計畫也將同步採用TCAD電性模擬和第一原理計算模擬，探討鐵電材料結構、負電容操作機制、負電容電晶體元件電性可靠度，以期能在理論與實務兼顧下，成功開發出符合下世代需求之低功耗負電容電晶體。
abstract_en_plan: In order to support the development of internet of things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI) chips, the semiconductor industries give the priority to the technology research on the next-generation transistor featuring ultralow leakage current and low-power operation. The ferroelectric negative capacitance field effect transistor (NCFET) is a promising candidate owing to its steep turn-on switch property under an ultralow gate overdrive. However, the latest research reported that the doped HfO2 ferroelectric thin film will face a severe challenge, such as the poor dopant tunability and interface quality degradation, multi-domain switching, and ferroelectric domain interface pinning. Besides, the ferroelectric dynamic response behavior of ferroelectric negative capacitance transistor is easily influenced by high gate leakage caused by a scaled interface layer. The high leakage current can affect negative capacitance matching and thereby lead to an unstable ferroelectric dynamic response and poor device reliability. Therefore, the big challenge of NCFET for logic sub-5nm technology node is to maintain the ferroelectricity in ultra-thin oxide and further improve off-state leakage related to the NC dynamic response. In this year, we proposed and reported a highly-scalable NCFET with excellent switch property in 2018 VLSI. We successfully introduced dopant-free HfO2 into NCFET, for the reason that the ferroelectricity of the HfO2 without any dopant can be evoked stably due to the synergy effect of gate stress and thickness scaling. Moreover, the plasma nitridation process can simultaneously improve the issues of off-state leakage and leakage-induced negative capacitance mismatching. The ferroelectric negative capacitance FET using gate strain and dopant-free HfO2 can realize a nearly hysteresis-free forward/reverse swing of <35 mV/dec for symmetric switch, a very high Ion/Ioff ratio of 107 and an ultralow off-state leakage of 1 pA/m, and. To further develop the NC transistor technology to meet the requirement for ultralow IoT and sub-5nm-node logic devices, we will propose a 2-year project to further achieve energy-efficient transistor switching. The researches revealed in this project includes highly-scaled N-/P-type HfO2 NCFETs with interface engineering and optimized strained gate for logic sub-5nm node. From our previous researches published in 2016 IRPS、2016 VLSI、2017 IEDM、2018 IRPS、2018 VLSI, we have demonstrated ferroelectric negative capacitance effect in energy-efficient fast-speed memory and ultralow-leakage transistor. These impressive research throughout prove that we have enough research capability of executing this 2-year project. The ferroelectric material structure, negative capacitance operation mechanism and device reliability of NCFETs will also be investigated by TCAD simulation, first principal calculation. Theses experimental and theoretical investigations are very important for developing reliable and low-power NCFET technology.

abstract_zh_plan: 人工智慧是人類邁向智慧生活的重要技術，而驅動此技術能持續發展的關鍵之一即為高效能記憶體。由於鐵電記憶體其效能極具前瞻性，也受到相當矚目。本三年期計畫將以Si或Ge/GeSn等半導體為基板，HfZrOx為鐵電材質，針對目前FeFET與FTJ的挑戰，提出創新的研究方向，其中第一年將進行鐵電材質之微波/雷射回火製程、Ec調變工程與表面處理技術。第二年則開發各種形式FeFET並以非對稱電極及堆疊介電層實現高自我整流且高ON/OFF比例之FTJ。同時鐵電層漸變式金屬比例於高溫/輻射環境下的可靠度以及元件在電子突觸元件之應用亦將深入分析。第三年則將FeFET與FTJ延伸至三維柱狀結構。FeFET的目標為操作電壓在5 V以下，10 ns之寫入/抹除條件下擁有2 V之記憶窗，每個位元耗能低於1 fJ並實現MLC操作。在可靠度上則要求在85 oC下其資料能保持10年並達到1E10次之耐久性。仿神經型態電路中突觸元件之應用可達32種權重並實現準確率達90 %之辨識成效。FTJ的目標則更進一步將電壓降至2 V以下。總體而言，本計畫結合了鐵電層成長、元件設計、製程整合，預期將開啟綠能記憶體的嶄新技術平台。
abstract_en_plan:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is one of the essential technologies that drive human beings toward smart life and high-performance semiconductor memory is one of the prerequisites to make continuous progress of AI technologies. Among the promising memory technologies, ferroelectric memory devices including FeFET and FTJ have recently drawn intensive attention since HfO2-based dielectric has been found to have ferroelectricity and can be fully integrated with incumbent VLSI technology. 
     By employing semiconductor Si, Ge or GeSn as substrate and HfZrOx as ferroelectric material, the 3-year project will focus on the challenges of developing FeFET and FTJ memory devices and propose innovation research directions in process and material to greatly advance the performance. In the 1st year, microwave and laser annealed HfZrOx will be developed to achieve thinner ferroelectric film with higher quality. Modulation of coercive field (Ec) to meet the requirement of various kinds of products will be also studied in detail. In addition, surface treatment of the semiconductor surface to suppress interfacial layer while enhancing interfacial quality will be investigated as well. In the 2nd year, optimal process conditions of ferroelectric HfZrOx will be applied to FeFET and FTJ devices. For FeFET, inversion- junctionless-, tunnel FET-type devices will be fabricated to explore how device structure influences memory performance. For FTJ devices, asymmetrical electrode material and dielectric/ferroelectric stack will be proposed to obtain high ON/OFF ratio with self-rectifying characteristics to suppress sneak current issue. Furthermore, some common research directions for FeFET and FTJ devices will be carried out including (a) modulating the metal composition to form the graded ferroelectric material for reduced depolarization field, (b) reliability characterization under the environment of high temperature and radiation and (c) synapse performance analysis for neuromorphic applications. In the 3rd year, planar FeFET and FTJ will be extended into the 3D form by using vertical pillar structure to increase device density. 
       The objectives of FeFET memory in the project are memory window of 2 V by applying voltage at less than 5 V for 10 ns, energy consumption lower than 1 fJ for per bit operation with the capability of multi level per cell, memory window larger than 1.8 V after 10-year retention at 85 oC and endurance more than 1E10 operation cycles. For neuromorphic applications, FeFET-based synapse, the pattern recognition accuracy is expected to reach 90 % with the measured 32 synaptic weight state levels. The objectives of FTJ memory are lower operation voltage of 2 V with similar performance of FeFET. In a word, this project brings together teams working on ferroelectric material growth, device design, process development/integration and electrical/physical characterization with an overall aim to pave the way for the fulfillment of high-performance green memory devices. Through the scrupulous experiment plan of this project, close teamwork and strong execution, we firmly believe that the low-power and high-speed ferroelectric memory devices with VLSI-compatible process for the next generation nano-electronic circuits and AI application will be realized.

project_title: 具高可靠度之人工智慧終端影音辨識運算晶片之重新設計、測試、錯誤消除與整合技術研發

abstract_zh_plan:
人工智慧系統已逐漸廣泛應用於智慧製造、機器人與車用電子等應用中。當中影音辨識扮演了相當關鍵的角色，許多機器學習演算法與終端運算電路也不斷演化，以提高辨識準確率以及運算效能。然而，隨著電晶體尺寸的不斷微縮，這些電路也變得對軟性錯誤及老化效應愈來愈敏感，產生愈來愈多可靠度上的巨大威脅。
本計畫之目標在於針對影音辨識終端晶片提供一兼具高可靠度與高效能之整合方案，包含對於終端晶片之資料儲存與辨識運算電路開發一系列重新設計、線上測試、錯誤消除、可靠度評估與所需測試資料自動產生技術。
本計畫主要研究內容列舉如下：
1.	影音輸入資料錯誤可接受度之分析技術開發。
2.	影音辨識運算晶片線上測試技術開發。
3.	大量且多樣化影音錯誤自動產生技術開發。
4.	影音修復技術開發。
5.	因應不同錯誤可接受度之系統重組技術開發。
6.	線上測試與影音修復硬體開發。
7.	影音辨識運算晶片內部錯誤可接受度之分析技術開發。
8.	因應錯誤可接受度之電路重新設計技術開發。
9.	因應錯誤可接受度之影音辨識訓練演算法最佳化技術開發。
10.	影音辨識運算晶片支援錯誤容忍之關鍵電路架構探討與開發。
11.	可高度容忍錯誤之影音辨識運算晶片架構設計技術開發。
12.	結合線上測試、修復與錯誤容忍架構之整合方案開發。
abstract_en_plan:
Artificial intelligence systems has been increasingly applied to smart manufacturing, robotics and automotive electronics. In these application, recognition of images, videos and audios is very crucial. Many innovative machine learning algorithms and edge computing electronics have been evolved to enhance the recognition rate and computation performance. However, with the feature size shrinking of transistors, these electronics also become more sensitive to soft errors and aging effects, inducing more and more significant reliability threats.
The main objective of this project is to provide image/video/audio recognition edge computing chips with an integrated reliability and performance enhancement solution. A set of re-design, on-line testing, error elimination, reliability evaluation, and automatic generation of test data for reliability evaluation techniques are developed to protect data processing and storage components in edge computing chips.
The involved research topics of this project are listed below.
1.	Development of acceptability analysis techniques for errors in image/video/audio data
2.	Development of on-line test techniques for image/video/audio recognition chips
3.	Development of automatic generation techniques of numerous diverse erroneous image/video/audio test data
4.	Development of repair techniques for image/video/audio
5.	Development of system reconfiguration techniques to deal with various acceptability of errors
6.	Hardware implementation of the developed on-line test and image/video/audio repair techniques
7.	Development of acceptability analysis for errors inside image/video/audio recognition chips
8.	Development of re-design techniques to deal with various acceptability of errors
9.	Development of training optimization techniques for image/video/audio recognition chips
10.	Investigation and development of critical hardware schemes to support error-tolerance for image/video/audio recognition chips
11.	Development of design techniques for highly error-tolerant image/video/audio recognition chips
12.	Integration of on-line test, repair and error-tolerance design techniques

abstract_zh_plan: 總計畫：AIAugSurgery: 輔助外科手術之人工智慧電子系統本整合型研究計畫之全名為「AIAugSurgery：輔助外科手術之人工智慧電子系統」，其目的為完成新一代可提昇可視性的智慧輔助手術系統。隨著電腦視覺、人工智慧及擴增實境技術的進步，我們認為有可能可以協助外科醫師做手術的影像導航，將事前拍攝好的三維的醫學影像即時顯示在一頭戴式顯示器中，且和醫師看到的現場影像直接做疊合，並依據人體的動態模型做及時的更新，如此一來醫生可以即時知道手術目標周圍的血管、神經等重要組織的深度和相關位置，以及預先規劃的下刀路徑和切除範圍，對於避免傷害這些重要組織會有很大的助益，也能提高手術成功度以及減少後遺症。這項跨領域的計畫將讓頂尖的人工智慧、電腦視覺與電子系統設計技術走進醫學領域，進而提升手術醫療的效率與品質。本計畫包含了五個子計畫，提供了輔助外科手術應用情境的主要核心技術。子計畫一將基於深度學習的影像辨識技術應用到醫學資料上，提供像素層級影像辨識，並將深度學習得到的特徵值用以進行姿態估計及追蹤，並發展相關的加速硬體；子計畫二將發展人工智慧處理器之架構與晶片設計，以執行及時的深度學習影像處理；子計畫三將發展低功率類神經網路電路技術，包括處理器、記憶體、神經處理單元，以輔助外科手術資訊處理；子計畫四將發展用於內視鏡之擴增實境即時導航技術；而子計畫五使用三維模型重建技術與生物力學，將斷層掃描影像轉換成可以依據手術動作變動的人體動態模型，以支援手術時即時的模型更新。子計畫一：用於手術擴增實境系統之姿態估計及影像分析技術在本計畫中，我們將設計一套完整的擴增實境系統來輔助外科手術團隊判斷目標物的位置，包括各類型特徵的抽取、姿態估測、姿態追蹤等技術之實作。本系統預計以配有色彩感測器與深度感測器的相機作為輸入裝置，將得到的影像資訊轉換為目標物的姿態資訊，根據此姿態資訊將虛擬三維模型渲染在頭戴式顯示器上，輔助醫師判斷目標器官的確切位置。為了減輕此項系統對於手術過程的干擾，此頭戴裝置必須以無線的形式呈現，如此一來整套系統的電力來源便全依靠在頭戴裝置上的電池，故此系統必須能達到一定程度的低功耗表現，才能夠持續運作一段合理的時間長度。因此在系統的實現上，除了特殊的姿態估計加速硬體外，我們也會考慮這些系統在運算量上的負擔，找出一個最佳的準確度與運算量的平衡點。
abstract_en_plan: Main ProjectAIAugSurgery: Artificial Intelligent Electronic System for Surgical AuxiliaryThis group project is entitled “AIAugSurgery: Artificial Intelligent Electronic System for Surgical Auxiliary.” The purpose of this project is to accomplish a new-generation intelligent surgical auxiliary system which provides indirect surgical visualization with artificial intelligence and augmented reality techniques. With advances in artificial intelligence, computer vision and augmented reality technologies, we believe that it is possible to assist the surgeon with image guided surgery. The proposed system will display the 3D medical image instantly in a head-mounted device and overlay the image seen directly by the surgeon. This allows the surgeon to immediately know the depth and relative location of important tissues such as blood vessels and nerves around the target, as well as the planned knife path and the resection range. This can be of great help to avoid harming these important tissues. And it also improves the success of surgery while reducing sequelae. This cross-disciplined project will bring state-of-the-art artificial intelligence, computer vision and electronic system design technologies into the medical field, thereby increasing the efficiency and quality of surgery.This group project consists of five sub-projects that provide the core technology for assisting surgical applications. Sub-project 1 will develop pose estimation/tracking and image segmentation techniques. The associated hardware accelerator will also be developed. Sub-project 2 will develop hardware architecture and chip design for artificial intelligent processor. It can support image processing tasks in the system. Sub-project 3 will develop low-power circuits for the whole system, including processors, memory, and neural processing elements. Sub-project 4 will develop the real-time navigation technique for endoscopic surgery. Sub-project 5 uses 3D model reconstruction techniques and biomechanics to convert tomographic images into a dynamic human model that can be varied according to surgical movements.  Sub-project 1Pose Estimation and Image Analysis for Augmented Reality Surgery SystemsIn this project, we plan to design an augmented reality (AR) system to assist the surgical team in determining the location of the target organ by implementing techniques such as various kinds of features extraction, pose estimation, pose tracking within a head-mounted device. We will use color and depth images as the input data in the proposed system. The target pose is computed according to the input frames and the dynamic models of tissues and organs captured from other medical imaging devices, such as computed tomography (CT), and then the virtual 3D model of the target is rendered onto a head-mounted display, which can assist the surgeons to determine the exact location of the target organ or tissue. In order to mitigate the interference of the system to the surgical procedure, the headset must be presented in a wireless one. Therefore, the battery on the headset would be the only source of the system's power. Consequently, the proposed system must be designed to fit the requirement of low power consumption for operating for a longer period. To realize such a system, we will find out the optimal solution and hardware architecture design.

abstract_zh_plan: 結合擴增實境系統之外科手術的執行過程中，目標器官之原始影像與擴增實境之虛擬影像之結合，提供即時、高解析度影像為訊號處理與計算平台之一大挑戰。在本子計畫中，我們將設計與實現相關影像處理之高效能深度學習晶片，實現所需之超高解析度成像(super-resolution imaging)、影像分離(semantic segmentation)、去模糊化(deburring)等影像處理所需之深度學習加速器。所需之運算主要針對深度學習使用之卷積神經網路(convolutional neural network, CNN)，包括卷積層(convolutional neural network, CNN)和完全連接層(fully-connected layer)設計與實現高效能處理晶片。由於系統將採用無線之頭戴裝置，故此系統必須能達到低功耗表現。所開發之AI加速器針對外部記憶體存取進行優化，結合內嵌式處理器之異質整合平台，可透過載入控制指令改變其運算功能，具有可程式化以及高能量效率的優點。本計畫所開發之加速器將與其他子計畫所開發之演算法以及超低功耗電路整合形成用於擴增實境外科手術系統之完整系統晶片。
abstract_en_plan: Surgical Auxiliary requires the fusion of the original image and the virtual image created by the augmented reality. Building a high-performance platform for realtime, high-resolution image provide is essential, but challenging, for such as system. In this project, we will design and implement processors with deep-learning functionality to realize the required image processing tasks, super-resolution imagine, semantic segmentation, and deblurring. The computations for deep learning are associated with convolutional neural network (CNN), including convolutional layer and fully-connected layer. Since the surgical auxiliary system is a wireless wearable device, low power dissipation is necessary. The developed deep-learning processor is optimized to minimize the external memory access. An embedded processor will be included to build a heterogeneous computing platform. The system-on-chip is programmable by loading instructions while maintain the high energy efficiency. The ultimate goal is this project is to integrate the deep-learning processors with low power digital building blocks, developed by other sub-projects, to build an energy-efficient integrated platform for surgical auxiliary with augmented reality.

abstract_zh_plan: 本計畫將針對輔助外科手術資訊處理之低功率類神經網路電路技術進行開發與實作。應用於外科手術之無線穿戴式裝置將同時支援即時導航、影像辨識、姿態估測與追蹤、及擴增實境等應用，如何在有限的電力來源進行大量高維度之資訊處理將是一大挑戰。於裝置端搭配具有機器學習分析功能之類神經網路電路系統，將可有效地提升資訊處理的效率及正確性。然而，目前類神經網路電路大多需消耗極大的功耗而不適合應用於裝置端；因此，本計畫將針對輔助外科手術資訊處理所必需之類神經網路系統，進行低功率電路技術開發。本計畫將採用低功率數位電路設計技巧，進一步降低整體系統電壓以增進整體能源效率，以實現低功率類神經網路系統所需之關鍵電路元件。本計畫已於第一期開發出適用於智慧終端裝置之低功率電路及節能處理器架構，於第二期將結合所開發出低功率電路元件，搭配記憶體內計算電路技巧，進一步實現可輔助外科手術資訊處理之低功率記憶體內計算類神經網路加速器。本計畫所開發之類神經網路關鍵電路技術及元件將整合應用於其他子計畫所開發之人工智慧處理器及特殊應用加速器，以達到輔助外科手術資訊處理智慧終端所需之效能及功耗目標。
abstract_en_plan: This research project will investigate and implement low-power neural network circuits for surgical information proceeding. The wireless wearable devices for clinical surgery must support applications such as real-time navigation, image and video recognition, pose estimation and tracking, and augmented reality. It is very challenging to process this huge amount of information under an energy-constrained device. Incorporating neural network circuits and systems with the capability of performing machine-learning analysis in edge devices can effectively enhance the efficiency and correctness of information processing. However, most of neural network circuits nowadays consume too much power to be implemented in edge devices. As a result, this project will explore low-power neural network circuit design techniques for surgical information proceeding. This project will employ low-power digital design techniques to implement key circuit IPs of low-power neural network system, and enhance overall energy efficiency by lowering system supply voltage. This research project has already designed and implemented low-power circuits and an energy-efficient processor architecture for intelligent edge devices in the first phase. In the future, this project will further implement a low-power computation-in-memory neural network accelerator for surgical information processing by combining the low-power circuit IPs with computation-in-memory circuit design techniques. The neural network circuit design techniques and key IPs this project develops will be incorporated and implemented in AI processors and ASICs of other sub-projects to achieve the power and performance requirements of intelligent edge devices for surgical information processing.

institution: 國立臺灣大學台積電-臺灣大學聯合研發中心
abstract_zh_plan: 本計畫著重開發滿足智慧終端需求之下世代技術節點的材料、製程、元件及電路熱模擬之關鍵技術。業界對先進製程節點存在PPACR(performance, power, area, cost, reliability)的要求，本計畫將製作具備純鍺通道之多層疊環繞式電晶體並開發模組技術：磊晶成長及品質管控、高品質高介電常數閘極堆疊成長、多層疊通道之犧牲層蝕刻、原子層選擇性沉積/蝕刻及小於10奈米微影技術以呼應Performance及Area需求，提高元件效能以利於未來智慧自駕車晶片應用；本計畫亦將研究並製作鐵電記憶體及相關模組技術、開發適用於類神經網路運算之鐵電材質憶阻器及進行嵌入式記憶體與元件之共模擬以應對智慧終端對Power的限縮；Cost部分，本計畫將開發成長低磊晶缺陷之鍺於矽基板上、研究磊晶成長速率，在提高良率的同時使生產率上升，降低製作成本；於電路運算時，元件之自發熱效應無法避免且已造成暗矽晶及可靠度問題，將同時影響電路表現及智慧終端單元之正常功能，因此本計畫將開發電路層級之熱/電共模擬SPICE模型，以求能同時監控晶片溫度及電性表現，做為電路設計及可靠度評估之依據，滿足reliability之限制。本計畫由三個子計畫組成，將分別就高遷移率材料、製程、多層疊元件及熱電路模型、鐵電鉿基氧化物之負電容特性研究及相關應用及先進原子層材料與模組技術進行開發與協力合作。
abstract_en_plan: The enabling material, process, device, and circuit technologies for advanced node for AI edge device are the focus. This project is to meet the requirements of Performance, Power, Area, Cost, and Reliability (PPACR) of the advanced technology node. High mobility Ge channel stacked gate-all-around transistors and the modules including (1) the epitaxy growth of Ge on Si, (2) high quality high-k gate stack formation, (3) sacrificial layer etching process to release stacked channel with good uniformity, (4) atomic layer selective deposition and atomic layer etching, and (5) lithography below 10nm will be developed to have high performance devices with the promising area saving. High performance devices are beneficial and advantageous to the application of artificial intelligence self-driving car in the future. The power reduction will be achieved with the fabrication of FeRAM, corresponding module development, ferroelectric tunneling memristor for neuromorphic computing, and the co-simulation between embedded memory and devices. Lowering the defect density with the acceptable growth rate of the epitaxy layer can help to have high yield and high throughput simultaneously to reduce the cost. The self-heating effect poisons the reliability and increases the dark silicon. Circuit level thermal-electrical SPICE modeling will be developed and can provide the junction temperature and the temperature distribution in the metal lines for reliability prediction. This project consists of High MobilityMaterials, Process, Stacked Channels, and Thermal Circuit Simulation (subproject 1), Ferroelectric X:HfO2 for Negative Capacitance and POC (Proof-ofConcept) Applications (sub-project 2), and the Atomic Layer Technologies for Advanced Materials and Modules (sub-project 3).
