project_title: 類比式電阻轉換記憶體研發及其電子傳輸行為研究
project_title_en: Investigation on the Analog Resistive Switching Memory and Its Electron Transport Mechanism
institution: 國立成功大學材料科學及工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 電阻式記憶體若能展現類比式電阻轉換，將可作為未來仿神經型態運算人工智慧晶片中，能夠反覆且即時調整權重的突觸元件。本計畫將針對氧化物電阻式記憶體元件，進行材料選擇與界面調控研究，探討類比式電阻轉換特性的基本關鍵參數，及電子傳輸行為，以應用於未來仿神經型態運算硬體架構。計畫預定以三年執行，第一年將針對WOx/TaOx記憶體元件之堆疊結構進行設計，以調整疊層界面的位置，改變其電阻轉換行為；同時進行電子傳輸特性與阻抗分析，搭配同步輻射X光吸收光譜，解析氧原子電子結構形態與電阻變化相關性。第二年將對主動層材料選擇進行探討，主要選擇準則為氧化物生成自由能大小，以確認生成自由能與氧原子(或是氧空缺)界面交換及電阻變化相關性；同時，也將以第一原理計算異質接面之氧空缺生成能，以解析氧原子在界面的交換行為。第三年則針對類比式電阻轉換性的阻態持久性進行探討，利用奈米結構來規範接觸界面，並同時改變疊層材料，目標為將氧空缺分佈成多通道(細燈絲)，以增進阻態持久性，使突觸元件的權重調整更具穩定性。
abstract_en_plan: The oxide resistive switching memory which exhibits analog switching characteristics can be a synaptic device implemented in the future neuromorphic computation AI chips because it will be feasible to repeatedly and instantly adjust the synaptic weight. This project will explore the key parameters of analog resistive switching and the electron transport behavior in oxide resistive switching memory based on the material selection and interface regulation, which will be applied to the future neuromorphic computing hardware architecture.The project is scheduled to be implemented in three years. In the first year, the stacking structure of the active layer in the WOx/TaOx memory device will be modified, resulting in different interface positions. The electron transport characteristics and impedance analysis are carried out, combined with synchronous radiation X-ray absorption spectroscopy, to analyze the electronic structure of oxygen atoms and correlate it to resistance changes. In the second year, the selection of active layer materials will be explored. The main selection criterion is the free energy of formation for oxides to confirm the exchange of the oxygen atoms (or oxygen vacancies) at interface and its correlation to resistance change. At the same time, the oxygen vacancy formation energy at the heterojunctions will also be calculated using the first principles calculations to analyze the exchange behavior of oxygen atoms at the interface. In the third year, the retention of resistance state during analog resistance switching is investigated. A nanostructure is used to regulate the contact interface, and the layered materials are changed at the same time. The goal was to localized oxygen vacancies into multiple channels (thin filaments) to improve retention of resistive state and to make the synaptic weight adjustment more stable.
keywords: 電阻式記憶體；類比式轉換；氧化物；電子傳輸
keywords_en: resistance memory； analog switching； oxide； electron transport
reasoning: Analog oxide RRAM synapse for neuromorphic computing

project_title: 應用於仿神經運算之光電多重輸入電晶體突觸元件
project_title_en: Multi-Input Photoelectric Synaptic Transistors for Neuromorphic Computation Applications
institution: 國立成功大學材料科學及工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 透過模仿生物體神經網路，人工神經網路軟體架構可讓電腦在接受訊息時進行學習，再經由學習經驗做出類似生物思考、判斷行為。因應巨量資料處理，需有新型的硬體架構來執行仿神經型態運算，始能進行更快速且即時的圖形/語言辨識。本計畫主要目標在於研發新型薄膜電晶體突觸元件，使其具有高狀態數並實現多重輸入，以作為人工神經網路運算的硬體元件。    計畫預定以三年執行，第一年針對氧化鋅錫薄膜電晶體的光突觸效應，利用染料敏化表面，拓展光反應性至~500 nm，以執行多波長光脈衝刺激，提高突觸權重的變化範圍。第二年針對電脈衝突觸效應，將閘極介電層進行改質，以引發半導體層內載子的延遲累積/空乏效應，使閘極電壓脈衝能成功產生殘留電流累加現象，造成所需增益或抑制型突觸電流訊號。第三年則結合光脈衝與電脈衝，探討兩種刺激所引發的電流訊號交互作用情況，與突觸權重的變化，實現多重輸入並研究其空間性加成，以進行更複雜的仿神經型態運算，使得此突觸元件更具前瞻功能。
abstract_en_plan: By imitating biological neural networks, the artificial neural network software architecture allows computers to learn when they receive information, and then use the learning experience to make biological-like thinking and judgment behaviors. Due to the huge amount of data processing, a new type of hardware architecture is needed to perform neuromorphic computations, which enables faster and real-time graphics/language recognition. The main goal of this project is to develop a new type of thin film transistor synaptic device with a high number of states and multiple inputs as a hardware for artificial neural network operations.The project is scheduled to be implemented in three years. In the first year, the photo-synaptic effect of zinc-tin-oxide thin-film transistors will be extended by using dye-sensitized surfaces to expand the photo-response to ~ 500 nm to perform multi-wavelength light pulse stimulation to improve the range of synapse weight changes. In the second year, the gate dielectric layer will be modified for the electrical pulse synaptic effect to induce the delayed accumulation / depletion effect of the carriers in the semiconductor layer, so that the gate voltage pulse can successfully generate the residual current accumulation, causing the potentiation or depression in synaptic current. In the third year, the combination of light pulses and electrical pulses is used to explore the interaction of current signals caused by the two stimuli, and the changes in synaptic weights. This is aiming to achieve multiple inputs and to study their spatial summation for more complex neuromorphic computation.
keywords: 仿神經型態運算；薄膜電晶體；多重輸入突觸元件
keywords_en: neuromorphic computation； thin-film transistor； multi-input synaptic device
reasoning: Photoelectric TFT synaptic device for neuromorphic

project_title: 基於機器學習所解析架構之可重組態邊緣
project_title_en: Reconfigurable Edge via Machine Learning Based Analytics Architecture
institution: 國立成功大學電機工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 隨著高精準度的人工智慧 (AI) 演算法變得極其複雜，邊緣裝置及物聯網 所產生的資料越來越大，具備彈性的可重新組態處理在卷積神經網路中對於設計低功率的高效智能邊緣系統是至關重要的，故此上述可重新組態設計將介紹於本提案中。在人工智慧中，解析演算法通常用於分析語音、聲音、圖像影音等。在本跨層級設計方法論中，不同的演算法實現將透過資料流圖 (dataflow graphs, DFG) 的形式來分析，加以提升效率及彈性以建構解析架構。擁有了演算法行為與架構資訊（包含軟體和硬體）， 本提案所引入的資料流圖提供了一種數學表達式，透過機器學習演算法，包含了譜圖理論及主成分分析，藉以同時探索演算法及架構之共同設計空間，透過擴增智慧以提高探索效率。此外，與傳統系統設計的線性差分方程式相比，資料流圖可以更好地描述運算邊緣平台以利系統性的分析，進而利用人工智慧提供彈性且有效率的運算資源管理。
abstract_en_plan: As artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms requiring high accuracy become exceedingly more complex and Edge/IoT generated data becomes increasingly bigger, flexible reconfigurable processing in convolution neural network is crucial in the design of efficient intelligent edge systems requiring low power and is introduced in this proposal.  In AI, analytics algorithms are typically used to analyze speech, audio, image video data, etc. In current proposed cross-level system design methodology, different algorithmic realizations are analyzed in the form of dataflow graphs (DFG) to further increase efficiency and flexibility in constituting “analytics architecture”. Consisting both algorithmic behavior and architectural information, including software and hardware, the DFG so proposed provides a mathematical formalism with which machine learning algorithms, including spectral graph theory and principal component analysis, is proposed to jointly explore the algorithm/architecture co-design space in serving as augmented intelligence for enhancing exploration efficiency.  In addition, as opposed to linear traditional difference equations traditional systems design, this DFG better models the underlying computational edge platform for systematic analysis thus providing flexible and efficient management of the computational resources via AI.
keywords: 機器學習； 解析架構； 資料流圖； 卷積神經網路； 譜圖理論； 主成分分析
keywords_en: machine learning； analytics architecture； dataflow graph； convolution neural network； spectral graph theory； principal component analysis
reasoning: ML-based dataflow analytics for reconfigurable edge CNN

project_title: 二維半導體電晶體研製與應用
project_title_en: Developments and Applications of 2d-Semiconductor Transistors
institution: 國立清華大學電子工程研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 傳統的矽電晶體逐漸到達物理微縮極限，二維材料具備高導電、高導熱特性，有希望取代矽元件通道來突破物理微縮極限，成為下世代電晶體元件。而二維材料具備物理、化學、電子和光學特性及各種材料應用發展潛力，將為未來世代半導體產業的發展契機。。此研究計畫之目標是進行以二維半導體材料通道架構，實現二維半導體電晶體元件的研究發展工作。進行相關的材料製備分析，元件製作量測，探討二維半導體電晶體特性及機制，並將相關技術應用於記憶體元件製作，實現類神經元的元件開發。相關研究，主要有三大重點項目︰(1)將深入探討具二維半導體材料與金屬源極與汲極的蕭特基能障行為，以降低二維半導體材料之接觸電阻；(2)製作二維半導體電晶體並結合鐵電材料的負電容特性來優化二維半導體電晶體性能；(3)發展出以二維半導體材料做為記憶體架構，以及做為神經形態突觸的應用。
abstract_en_plan: Traditional Si-based transistors have gradually reached their physical scaling limit. Two-dimensional (2D) materials are drawing great attention from semiconductor industry because of its potential to have excellent electrical, optical, and thermal characteristics, serving a promising candidate for use in future semiconductor devices.The objectives of this project is to develop the 2D-Semiconductor transistors and apply them in AI memories. The development of this three-year project is focused on three key research items: (1) to reduce the contact resistance of source/drain between 2D materials and semiconductors for increasing the current levels of 2D-Semiconductor devices. (2) to fabricate 2D-Semiconductor transistors and integrate with the negative capacitance ferroelectric materials for performance optimization. (3) to develop 2D-Semiconductor memories for neuromorphic synapse application.

project_title: 智慧安全記憶體電路之探索
project_title_en: Exploration of Security-Aware Smart Memory Circuits
institution: 國立清華大學電機工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 隨著IoT、無線傳輸系統、智能卡、射頻識別（Radio Frequency Identification , RFID）等等物理實體廣泛的應用，如何對這些物理實體實施有效認證，進而達到確保系統安全的目的，成為近年來關注的問題。傳統密碼學在應用以及認證的方式存在著很大的障礙，當前普遍使用的人體唯一特徵個人認證，像是指紋、虹膜等，基於物理實體內在的物理構造來唯一的標識單個物理實體達到有效認證的方法，提出了物理不可複製函数（Physical Unclonable Function , PUF）的概念。最基本的PUF應用是利用實體的唯一標識來實現實體的認證，近年來，PUF發展至更廣的領域，應用在系統認證、密鑰生成等等，成為安全領域的一個熱門話題。此計畫主要是以非揮發性磁阻式記憶體STT-MRAM、揮發性記憶體SRAM為記憶體胞的基礎，搭配近記憶體運算的架構實現PUF的功能，PUF可以利用製程上的差異在記憶體內形成0、1的隨機分佈，然後當成金鑰來使用，並搭配其他周邊的加密電路如AES (Advanced Encryption Standards)、邏輯加密等等以達到資料加密的需求， 進一步使整個智慧記憶體加密流程更加完整。而使用近記憶體運算的架構，可以提供一個加密流程更加快速且低能源消耗的平台，使得一些在IoT、區塊鏈等等的終端元件可以延長待機時間，且搭配硬體加密的功能可以讓資料在傳輸時可以更加安全。
abstract_en_plan: In recent years, how to effectively verify physical entities to ensure the system safety has drawn people’s attention, as Internet of Things(IoT), wireless transmission systems, smart cards, Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) and other physical entities have been wildly used. Many problems exist in the appliance and verification of traditional cryptology. The concept of Physical Unclonable Function (PUF) is based on the idea of using a certain physical structure within the entity to recognize a single subject and achieve an effective hardware verification. Such commonly used recognition technologies include fingerprint and iris, which are unique characteristics of the human body. The most fundamental appliance of PUF is to verify an entity through its unique identification. Over the past few years, PUF has been popular among the encryption field, while it also expanded into wider usages, including system authentication and the secret key generation.This project is mainly utilizing nonvolatile memory MRAM and volatile memory SRAM as memory cell to realize PUF features by taking advantages of near memory computation architecture. The PUF code can be used as key, and is achieved by process variation of semiconductor, which can generate random 0 and 1 distribution in memory array. We can realize encoding the data with the accompany of peripheral encoding circuit such as Advanced Encryption Standards (AES) and logic locking. By these auxiliary hardware implementations, we can make the security-aware smart memory even powerful. Nevertheless, near memory computing scheme is able to lower the power consumption as well as raise the encryption speed. This allows some IoT and block chain device to extend standby time. Also, the combination of PUF code and hardware encryption can make it safer while transferring the data.

keywords_en: MRAM； SRAM； non-volatile memory； volatile memory； sense amplifier； physical unclonable function； AES； logic locking.
reasoning: MRAM/SRAM near-memory PUF/AES smart memory for IoT security

project_title: 具學習能力之突波式遞迴神經網路晶片系統設計
project_title_en: Design of Spiking Recurrent Neural Network System on a Chip with Learning Capability
institution: 國立清華大學電子工程研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 隨著深度學習演算的發展自動化了大數據的探勘，人工智慧開始被廣泛應用於各個領域，包含自駕車、機器人等的自動控制。許多系統控制常常須對多變的環境做即時的反應，因此，將人工智慧演算法實現客製化低功耗的積體電路系統日趨重要。然而，大部分的類神經網路晶片系統僅著重在加速資料分類或推論時所需的前饋(feedforward)運算，較少著墨於實現網路的參數學習演算法於同一晶片，以利網路隨時調變保持最佳的運作狀態。另一方面，遞迴式神經網路(recurrent neural network)具有迴授的架構，自然比前饋式神經網路更適合學習時變訊號(如語言認知、影像追蹤、動態預測等)，但其迴授的架構也相對使得電路實現跟參數調變演算法都變得相對複雜。有鑑於此，本計畫主要目標為探索以突波式仿神經運算元實現機率型遞迴神經網路的可行性，並將其參數學習演算法實現於同一晶片。將遞迴神經網路以突波式運算元實現的最大優點是，兩個運算元間連結權重的調變只跟這兩個運算元產生的突波相關，使得參數調變演算法適合實現於積體電路;另一方面，所有訊息皆以數位式突波傳遞，確保系統運作穩健而不受干擾。因此，本計畫主要的創新性在於 (a) 以突波式仿神經運算元實現機率型、具學習能力之遞迴神經網路單晶片系統 (b) 突波式運算元所需的隨機性乃由電晶體自身雜訊誘發，且雜訊大小可調 (c) 突觸連結權重採用與標準製程相容之非揮發性類比記憶體儲存且可進行線上學習調變 (d) 可連結多個晶片構成深度學習遞迴式網路，應用於學習辨識或預測更複雜的高維時變訊號。本計畫研發的晶片成果預期可應用於機器人、自駕車、及各式IoT感測器與制動器的自動控制與訊號判讀。
abstract_en_plan: Following the development of deep-learning neural networks (DNN) able to extract the features of raw data automatically, artificial intelligence (AI) becomes widely applied to data mining and reasoning, as well as to automatic control on systems like self-driving vehicles or robots. In many system-control applications, it is crucial to respond to environmental changes or stimuli in real time. This demand makes essential the implementation of AI algorithms as customized, low-power microsystems. However, most integrated-circuit designs for a neural network focus only on accelerating the network’s feedforward inference. Efficient implementation of learning algorithms for adapting network parameters “on-line” is seldom addressed. On the other hand, the recurrent neural network (RNN) is inherently more suitable for modelling time-variant data (e.g. language translation, video tracking, etc.), while novel hardware implementation of RNNs is seldom proposed. This is mainly because the recurrent structure makes both learning algorithms and hardware implementation more complicated. Nevertheless, this project investigates the feasibility of realizing probabilistic RNNs, such as the Boltzmann Machine and its variants, in VLSI based on spiking neuron circuits. Representing RNNs as networks of spiking neurons provides the advantage that the learning algorithm is hardware-friendly, because adaptation of each synaptic weight only depends on the spiking events generated the two neurons connected by the synapse. Moreover, signals between neurons and synapses are all transmitted as digital pulses(spikes), which are inherently robust against interference. Therefore, the novelty of this project lies in : (a) Exploring the feasibility of implementing a spiking, recurrent neural networks in VLSI with on-chip learning capability (b) The probabilistic behavior required by spiking neurons is induced by incorporating the intrinsic noise of transistors, and the noise is easily-adaptable (c) The synaptic weight is stored on non-volatile analog memory arrays not only adaptable on-line but also compatible with the standard CMOS technology. (d)Exploiting the multi-chip connections to realize deep-learning RNNs. The microsystem design in this project is expected to be useful for embedding artificial intelligence in robots, self-driving vehicles, or many IoT sensors/actuators.

abstract_zh_plan: 目前有關深度學習神經網路引擎之電路實現的研究可以分兩大類：數位電路實現及超低功耗類比電路實現 (譬如: 仿神經型態運算)。為了尋求達到更多耗能之下降，也有一些研究提出以新興技術來實現DNN的作法，參考文獻顯示，於物體辨識應用時其能源效率比RISC軟體實現的能源效率高約十幾萬倍以上，比CMOS數位電路實現方式的能源效率高百倍以上，且所需面積僅是CMOS數位電路實現方式約0.16倍。隨著電子設備尺寸的不斷縮小，最新的計算技術進步使得可穿戴設備的設計可以實現長期連續監測的任務，並有可能促進及時的醫療措施進行治療和護理，這就是可穿戴設備吸引了該領域科學家廣泛關注的原因。在生醫訊號中，醫生經常會採用心電圖(Electrocardiogram, ECG或EKG)與心音圖(Phonocardiogram, PCG)作為判斷心臟疾病的參考。此外，隨著近年來科技的演進，系統能處理更大量的運算使人工智慧(Artificial Intelligence, AI)再度成為研究熱門。將人工智慧應用於語音處理，透過以Deep Neural Network (DNN)為基底的應用，使自動語音辨識(Automatic Speech Recognition, ASR)更廣更精準的進步。本計畫主要研究方向是針對仿神經型態運算技術開發高能源效率可重組架構及晶片電路，將分年著重基本神經元相關電路架構設計及規格釐訂、仿神經型態運算架構及模組開發、可擴充及可重組架構開發，並且於每一階段皆將進行晶片設計與試製來加以驗證。本計畫將提出一個神經細胞(Neuron Cell)模型，組成樹突神經模型(Dendritic Neuron Model, DNM)架構並以粒子群最佳化演算法(Particle Swarm Optimization, PSO)，實現深度學習用於ECG/PCG辨識及語音辨識系統，以上述應用作為測試檢驗平台來展示研發成果。
abstract_en_plan: The current research on the circuit implementation of deep learning neural network engines can be divided into two categories: digital circuit implementation and ultra-low-power analog circuit implementation (ex., neuromorphic computing). In order to achieve more reduction in energy consumption, some studies have also proposed the use of emerging technologies to implement DNNs. The literature shows that the energy efficiency of analog neuromorphic computing for object recognition applications is about 100,000 times higher than that achieved by RISC software. The energy efficiency of analog neuromorphic computing is more than a hundred times higher than that of the CMOS digital circuit implementation, and the required area is only about 0.16 times that of the CMOS digital circuit implementation.The computer can process more complicated system due to the evolution of science and technology in recent years, and it also making the Artificial Intelligence (AI) get a second wind. As electronic devices continue to shrink in size, the latest advances in computing technology have enabled the design of wearable devices to achieve long-term continuous monitoring tasks, and have the potential to promote timely medical measures for treatment and care. In the biomedical signal, doctors often use Electrocardiogram (ECG) and Phonocardiogram (PCG) as the reference for judging heart disease. In addition, with the evolution of science and technology in recent years, the system can handle a larger number of operations, making Artificial Intelligence (AI) once again a research hotspot. Applying artificial intelligence to speech processing includes significantly reducing the Word Error Rate (WER) of speech recognition. It will improve automatic speech recognition (ASR) for more accurate and wide range by the applications through the Deep Neural Network (DNN).The main research direction of this project is to develop high-energy-efficient reconfigurable architecture and chip circuits for neuromorphic computing technology. It will focus on the design and specifications of basic neuron-related circuit architecture, neuromorphic computing architecture and modules. This project will propose a neuron cell model, which will form a Dendritic Neuron Model (DNM) architecture and use Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to implement deep learning for ECG/PCG recognition and speech recognition system, using the above-mentioned applications as a test and inspection platform to show the results of research and development.

project_title: 超低能耗記憶體內運算技術–從關鍵元件開發到仿生晶片設計之跨層級優化
project_title_en: Ultralow-Energy Computing-In-Memory Technology– a Cross-Layer Optimization from Key Device Development to Neuromorphic Chip Design
institution: 國立交通大學電子研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 即時且遍在的終端人工智慧預期將徹底改變人類的生活樣貌，其中最關鍵的技術為超低能耗的運算加速晶片。過去我們致力於使用電阻式記憶體，搭配運算儲存一體的記憶體內運算架構，結合物理、材料、元件、電路、演算法、系統等跨層級研究，打造深層神經網路運算晶片，為國內乃至世界最有成果的團隊之一。放眼未來，新一期的三年計畫中我們將專注於更低能耗的元件、演算法與晶片系統開發，探討以更仿生的方式處理資訊，將超低能耗的終端人工智慧運算技術推進至全新境界。為克服電阻式記憶體在電流微縮與變異性上的物理限制，我們將應用可於邏輯製程中整合的鐵電與鐵磁材料，開發新型態鐵電穿隧接面記憶體(FTJ)與磁阻式記憶體(MRAM)，並驗證其在低能耗、低電流神經突觸應用之潛力。這兩種新興技術也很有機會同時實現微小化的脈衝神經元，整合為全電偶極矩或全自旋神經網路硬體。我們也將研究基於電化學金屬化機制的臨界切換選擇器，利於與記憶體元件整合成高密度交錯式神經突觸陣列，上述關鍵元件的開發將為脈衝神經網路硬體化創造有利的條件。脈衝神經網路是一種被認為更加符合大腦運作原理的第三世代神經網路，是現有第二代深層神經網路未來重要的延伸方向，脈衝神經網路具有稀疏資訊與事件驅動的特性，非常適合應用於超低能耗的終端人工智慧運算。我們將分別開發具STDP以及後傳遞學習規則的深層脈衝神經網路演算法，整合上述高密度突觸陣列、微小化脈衝神經元電路、邏輯/類比周邊電路，開發全世界第一顆以全記憶體技術為核心的低能耗 (< 50 uW)深層脈衝神經網路加速晶片，執行複雜彩色圖像辨識。本計畫於技術面上將以成為國際間第三代神經網路硬體加速研究上最頂尖的團隊為目標，同時培育新一代具尖端仿生運算跨層級設計能力的優秀研究生，最終希望整合台灣產學研的豐沛研究能量，提升台灣整體人工智慧晶片技術的競爭力。
abstract_en_plan: Real-time and ubiquitous edge artificial intelligence (edge AI) is expected to revolutionize the entire landscape of how human beings live. The most critical technology is ultra-low energy computing hardware accelerators. In the past, we have mastered the resistive memory (RRAM) and computing-in-memory (CIM) architecture to develop deep neural network (DNN) hardware accelerator through a cross-layer optimization methodology that combines physics, materials, devices, circuits, algorithms, and systems. We are the one of the most prominent teams in the research field of CIM and neuromorphic computing in Taiwan as well as in the world. Looking forward to advancing the Edge AI to a unprecedented level, we will focus on even lower-energy devices, algorithms, and chip designs to exploit the full advantages of neuromorphic computing in this new three-year proposal. To overcome the physical limitations of RRAM on current scaling and high variability, we will explore the newly available capability of integrating ferroelectric and ferromagnetic materials in CMOS and develop new ferroelectric tunneling junction memory (FTJ) and magnetoresistive memory (MRAM) as a low-energy, low-current electronic synapse. They also have the unique opportunity of realizing compact neuron circuits simultaneously and enable an all-electric dipole or all-spin hardware neural network. We will also study the threshold-switching selector based on the electrochemical mechanism, which will facilitate the integration of a high-density synaptic crossbar array. The development of the above key devices will lay a solid foundation for the spiking neural network (SNN) hardware. SNN is a third-generation neural network that better resembles the operating principle of the biological brain. Its high sparsity in information and event-driven characteristics are highly desirable for ultralow-energy Edge AI. We will develop deep SNN algorithms with both STDP and back-propagation learning rules and integrate with the above high-density synaptic arrays and compact spiking neuron circuits. Combining with the necessary digital/analog peripheral circuits, we will develop the world's first memory-based low-power (<50 uW) deep spiking neural network accelerator for complex color image recognition tasks. We aim to become the leading research team of the third-generation neural network hardware in the world, while cultivating the new generation of outstanding young talents with cutting-edge cross-layer design capabilities in neuromorphic computing. Finally, we will leverage the rich research talent and capability in Taiwan's universities, research institutes, and industry to facilitate Taiwan's excellence in future AI chips.

project_title: 三維積體電路與異質整合關鍵技術之低溫快速異質銅接合技術研究與平台開發
project_title_en: Low-Temperature Short-Duration Cu Hybrid Bonding Technology for 3d Ic and Heterogeneous Integration
institution: 國立交通大學電子工程學系
abstract_zh_plan: 本計畫將研究三維積體電路(3D IC)的銅接合關鍵技術，目標以實現 (1) 異質接合 (hybrid bonding)、(2) 低溫 (100~150 ℃)、(3) 短時間 (1 min)、(4) 大氣環境接合等目前電子產業對於半導體晶片使用三維積體電路與異質整合以拓展高階與下世代產品的最急切要求，預期除了可以符合大部分電子晶片的熱預算需求外，透過異質整合可以實現輕薄短小與高密度的AI晶片與各式通訊與感測晶片，而短時間於大氣環境下的低溫接合技術更能夠跨越異質整合平台的少量多樣製作瓶頸。本計畫的研究內容涵蓋晶圓級與晶片級接合，從製程開發起，另將包括結構設計、機制與物理模型討論、電性量測、可靠度測試、材料分析、接合機械強度測試，除了技術開發外，預期將會有完整的學理驗證，最後並透過業界所提供的晶片進行測試。本計畫的研究與技術開發完成後，將結合其他已開發的三維積體電路技術進行實體驗證，並提供國內學界在前段元件製作完成後，可以進行後續堆疊整合的製程平台，亦將提供設計領域研究人員，在晶片設計完成並取得後，可以進行後續的異質整合之高可靠度平台，期待協助國內在微電子領域各項研究的創新發展。
abstract_en_plan: This research project will develop a hybrid Cu bonding technology for 3D IC and heterogeneous integration applications. The key technology specifications, currently most important for semiconductor chips in next-generation advanced products, include (1) hybrid bonding, (2) low temperature (100~150 ℃), (3) short duration (1 min), and (4) atmosphere bonding. The bottleneck of low thermal budget for most advanced high density and high performance chips stacking can be overcome. Through the demonstration of hybrid bonding, the realization of small-form-factor and high-density AI chips, 5G chips, and various sensor chips will become feasible. In addition, the short-duration low-temperature Cu bonding at atmosphere environment can fulfill the small-volume large-variety production demand for heterogeneous integration platform. The research scopes will include wafer level and chip level bonding technology, starting from the fundamental process development with parameter explorations, followed by structural design, mechanism development and physics model discussion, electrical characteristics, reliability evaluation, material characterization, mechanical strength measurement. In addition to research and development, a complete model construction is expected, as well as the demonstration with real dies and the qualification based on the industry standard. With the low-temperature short-duration Cu hybrid bonding technology development from this research project, combining other key 3D IC technologies, a process platform will be provided to other researchers in Taiwan for further 3D IC fabrication and integration after their devices are completed. The IC-design-related researchers can also utilize this reliable heterogeneous integration platform after their chips are tapped out. We believe the achievements of this research project will assist the development and keep the leadership in advanced semiconductor and IC technologies in Taiwan.

project_title: 利用堆疊型閘極全環繞技術結合鉿基鐵電材料開發應用於以人工神經網路為基礎之邊緣運算低功耗元件
project_title_en: Development of Low-Power Consumption Devices by Using the Combination of Vertically Stacked Gate-All-Around and  Hf-Based Ferroelectric Material for Edge Computing Based on Artificial Neural Network
institution: 國立交通大學電子物理學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 近年來，物聯網（IoT）開始在半導體工業佔有舉足輕重的地位，終端設備和數據的數量隨著IoT系統的發展快速增加。如此一來，大量的數據會降低系統的效能，尤其是車用電子的即時運算系統。因此，為了克服該問題進而提出了邊緣計算—終端設備先將數據處理過並將必要的數據發回到系統中心。透過隱藏次要的資訊，把重點著重在必要的訊息上來避免數據中心處理非必要資訊，並提高數據處理效率。另一方面，在人工神經網絡（ANN）中，透過可調整和持續修改的權重值來實現高效能運算。且對於IoT和ANN而言，基本的要求為低功耗和高性能。再者，針對已儲存電荷為基礎的非揮發性記憶體元件（NVM）已被研究了很長時間，但是，NVM相對來說較不適合現今微縮的趨勢，因為隨著元件的縮小，電荷的儲存量亦會隨之減少。此外，對於機器學習而言，可以運用NVM可調整權重值的特性來構建ANN系統。因此，在這項計畫中，我們計劃將使用和CMOS技術可相互兼容的材料以及以鐵電極化方式為基礎的材料開發應用於ANN系統的元件。本項目可以分為四個不同的主題，包括應用於e-NVM的(a)次5-nm的鐵電記憶體、(b)多級的鐵電UTB NVM、(c)權重可調的次5-nm GAA FE-FET以及(d)應用於ANN的金屬-鐵電-金屬結構的穿隧式元件。最後，透過施加各種不同脈衝於第一及第二子題之鐵電記憶體，來針對第三以及第四個子項目進行研究，並探討利用傳輸電導（Gm）或穿隧電阻（TER）的差異來展現應用於ANN系統中的權重可調整性。
abstract_en_plan: In recent years, the internet of things (IoTs) has begun to shape the future of the semiconductor industry. The terminal devices and the quantity of data rapidly increase with the development of the IoT system. In this manner, the large size of data retards the system performance; it is undesirable for the real-time response system such as the automotive electronics in IoT. Therefore, edge computing is proposed to overcome this issue. It is based on the procedure that terminal devices would process the data first and send the necessary one to the data center. Moreover, it hinders the secondary data and focuses on the primary ones. Edge computing can also prevent data processing efficiency from performance degradation. On the other hand, the artificial neural network (ANN) computing can contribute a further improvement in performance thanks to tunable and continuously modified weight value, which is a kind of machine learning. For the IoTs and ANN, low power operation and high performance are the essential requirements. The charge-based non-volatile memory (NVM) has been widely investigated for a long time. However, it is unsuitable for the scaling trend because the storage charge would decrease with scaling the device down. Besides, for machine learning, the NVMs are suggested to construct the ANN system owing to weight value tuning. Therefore, in this project, we plan to fabricate the polarization-based memory with the CMOS compatible ferroelectric material for ANN application. This project can be divided into four different topics, including (a) sub-5-nm ferroelectric for e-NVM, (b) Multiple Memory Level (MML) of Ferroelectric UTB NVM, (c) sub-5-nm GAA FE-FET with tunable weight, and (d) tunneling junction with a metal-ferroelectric-metal structure for ANN application. After applying various kinds of pulse, we would like to investigate the NVM devices for the first two topics and focus on the tunability of weight value for the third and fourth ones via the difference of transconductance (Gm) or tunneling electroresistance (TER) ratio.

project_title: 應用於類神經網路與光電系統的可撓式電阻式記憶體之製造和特性鑑定
project_title_en: Fabrication,Characterization and Application of Flexible Resistive Switching Memories for Neuromorphic Computing and Optoelectronic Systems
institution: 國立交通大學電子研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 在技術領域不斷變化的環境中，元件製造領域必須迅速採用新技術。要考慮的關鍵因素是低功耗，高微縮性，良好的可靠性以及即將到來的挑戰，例如機器學習、並行處理或是在數據處理中處理大數據以及系統與光學設備的兼容性。為了實現上述技術，我們將提出為期三年的計畫，以進行用於神經形態計算和光電系統的可撓性電阻式記憶體的製造、特性和應用。    計畫第一年，我們將收集有關神經形態和光電電阻式轉換記憶體領域的知識，並準備好所需的設備來開展我們的研究工作。根據突觸和光電功能（即ORRAM），我們將在聚合物基板上製作出含有光敏膜雙層結構的電阻式轉換記憶體（RRAM）和觀察其特性。 使用npn、pnp或np結構的選擇器（由n型和p型氧化物薄膜製成）也將被製造和測試，期望做出高選擇性的元件。計畫第二年，薄膜和界面的結構、組成和表面特性會被檢測，並且探討薄膜和具有突觸和光電功能的ORRAM性能之關聯。    透過上述的關係，我們將探討操作機制和氧空缺扮演的角色來解釋ORRAM的行為。期望經過優化的1R元件能夠完整理解操作機制。計畫第三年，我們將透過調整材料，結構和製程參數來建立1S1R，並且優化1S1R的性能。考慮到潛在的應用，我們將構建ORRAM陣列以演示圖像感測，圖像存儲和圖像對比度增強的功能。
abstract_en_plan: In the changing environment in the technology field, the device fabrication field has to quickly adopt new techniques. The key factors to take into consideration are low power consumption, high scalability, good reliability and coupling with the upcoming challenges such as handling big data for machine learning, parallel processing or in data processing and compatibility of the system with optical devices. In order to realize above technology features, we will propose three years project to perform fabrication,characterization and application of flexible resistive switching memories for neuromorphic computing and optoelectronic systems.In the first year of the project, we will gather enough domain knowledge on the nuromorphic and optoelectrical resistive switching memory devices and arrange the required equipments to carry out our research work. The bilayer structured resistive switching memories(RRAM) containing optically sensitive film on the polymer substrates will be produced and characterized according to synapse and optoelectrical function(that is ORRAM). The selecter based on npn, pnp, or np structure made by n-type and p-type oxides films will also be fabricated and tested to seek for high selectivity devices. In the second year of the project, the structure, composition and surface properties of the thin films and interfaces will be characterized to correlate with the performances of the ORRAMs exhibited synapse and optoelectrical function. Based on the established interrelationship, the operational mechanism and the role of oxygen vacancies will be found to explain ORRAMs’behavior. The optimized 1R devices will be expected to be fabricated attributed to better understanding of the operational mechanism. In the third year of the project, the 1S1R will be established and performance of the 1S1R will be optimized based on adjusting compositions, structure and processing parameters. Under consideration of potential application, the ORRAM arrays will be constructed to demonstrate the functions of image sensing, image memory and image contrast enhancement.

project_title: 基於深度學習之終端型腦波情緒偵測整合系統應用於個人居家身心理監測和健康照護
project_title_en: A Deep Learning-Based Edge-Computing Emotion Recognition System Using Electroencephalography for Personal Home-Based Mental Status Monitoring and Health Care
institution: 國立交通大學電子研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 近期，隨著科技蓬勃發展，資訊的流通越來越普及，身處於資訊爆炸的時代，競爭的越趨頻繁和國際化，導致現代人的心理壓力越來越大，許多心理疾病 (例如憂鬱症、躁鬱症) 開始在不知不覺中產生，當發現時往往都已無法挽回。所以，即時了解自己的生、心理的狀態變得十分的重要。若患者在居家環境下能發現自己是處在負面的情緒當中，可以透過自我神經、生理回饋訓練或家屬的引導作即時性的調適，也可以記錄長期的心理資訊提供心理師作為治療的參考。因此本計畫之智慧電子設計團隊提出一基於深度學習之可攜式腦波情感計算系統，蒐集即時性的腦波生理訊號並偵測當下的情緒，除了可以提供心理師做相關心理疾病的診斷與治療，更可幫助患者將療程帶進居家中進行即時性的自我診斷，達到居家心理治療和健康照護的目的。本計畫將利用腦波訊號和深度學習結合開發跨受測者之情緒辨識演算法，並研發高效能的終端軟硬體系統平台。透過系統晶片實作之技術，將人工智慧之深度學習模組及相關數位訊號處理單元整合至微小及低功耗之人工智慧系統整合型晶片(AISoC)。此基於AISoC的系統平台包含腦訊號前處理單元(Pre-processing Unit)、快速傅立葉轉換單元(Fast Fourier Transform Unit)、深度模型運算加速單元(Deep Learning Accelerator)以及藍芽傳輸通訊系統。此系統平台可以執行即時性的腦波訊號收集、腦波訊號處理和人工智慧輔助判斷，再透過藍芽傳輸將生理參數及情緒辨識結果傳至手機或個人電腦，最後利用圖形使用者介面(GUI)的應用程式(APP)進行生理和情緒狀態之監測，並且使用神經回饋(Neuro-feedback)的機制幫助使用者保持身心理的健康。此系統平台除了終端資料收集和分析，也和雲端的資料庫做結合使用，達到即時且長期性的個人居家身心理監測和健康照護。
abstract_en_plan: Recently, with the rapid development of technology, the circulation of information is increasingly widespread. In the era of information overload, modern people are under great stress due to frequent international competitions. In this situation, mental illnesses that unconsciously outbreak would cause the irreparable tragedies. Hence, the understanding of the own psychological state in time is getting increasingly important. If the patient can realize that he(she) is under negative emotional status at home, he(she) would be able to perform the bio-neuro-feedback exercise to relieve himself(herself) immediately. The family or nurse can also take care of the patient as soon as possible. Furthermore, the long-term information could be presented to the psychologist as the reference. Hence, this project intends to present a portable and deep learning-based affective computing system using the EEG signal. The system can measure EEG and detect the current emotion in real-time. It can be the aid of the diagnosis and take part in the psychotherapy. Moreover, the patient could immediately perform mental accommodation during the outbreak of mental illness by bringing the system home. Achieve home-based mental status monitoring and health care.    The project aims to develop the methodology of cross-subject emotion recognition using the EEG signal and deep learning algorithm. Combining with the implementation of the System on Chip (SoC), we integrate the deep learning model and the related signal processing units into a portable and low-power AISoC platform. The computing platform includes the EEG pre-processing unit, fast Fourier transform unit, deep learning accelerator, and the Bluetooth transmission module. It could perform real-time EEG signal acquisition, processing and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for decision making. The physiological parameters and the emotional status would be transmitted to the smartphone or the personal computer for the GUI display. Finally, the neuro-feedback module on the GUI could help the patient stay healthy physiologically. Except for the acquisition and analysis of the edge information, the system could be able to connect with the cloud database, achieving the objective of real-time and long-term home-based mental status monitoring and health care.

project_title: 人工智慧在前瞻電子設計自動化技術的應用(II)-子計畫五：機器與深度學習導向的數位與類比電路在線路與佈局合成的研究 (II)
project_title_en: Machine and Deep Learning Based Circuit and Layout Synthesis for Digital and Analog Designs  (II)
institution: 國立交通大學電子研究所
abstract_zh_plan: 在積體電路設計發展的範疇，由於能整合多晶片的系統晶片 (System-on-Chip)以及三維積體電路 (3D-IC) 的開發，超大型積體電路得以在更小的體積下維持甚至提升晶片效能。為了發展多元的物聯網 (IoT)產品與AI晶片，積體電路的應用範圍將比以往更加廣泛，有效地製造高可靠度的積體電路實為關鍵指標。另一方面，積體電路開發已經達到5奈米甚至更為微小，電晶體之間的物理效應已經超越了模擬結果，尤其是效能考量優先的類比積體電路。倘若能夠在電路設計時能更精確地考慮電路佈局實體擺放造成的效應，將會降低因為實體佈局關聯效應(Layout dependent effect)所造成的效能降低。為了能夠擷取當前數位與類比積體電路的經驗法則以及設計精華，迅速地在目標電路設計中有效運用，積體電路設計產業自發展以來，已經累積相當規模的電路設計資料。若能導入當今的機器學習技術，將有助於積體電路產業的卓越發展。本計劃在類比電路與混合訊號設計佈局規劃二年發展技術，我們原來已有佈局自動化的研究基礎，希望在既有的擺置表示法與匹配限制下的繞線工具上，加上用學習得到的佈局樣板(Template)加速得到擺置與繞線的雛形(prototyping)，希望可更快得到好的設計參數的佈局，減少pre-sim與post-sim的表現差距(performance gap)。接下來更進一步提升到混合訊號層級的佈局，考慮進一步將machine learning方法，應用在混合訊號不同building blocks之間的floorplanning和routing等問題，包括自動判別building blocks和訊號的屬性等，以期加速整體的設計流程。
abstract_en_plan: Due to the advancement of semiconductor manufacturing, we are facing the major challenges in modern circuit designs including SoC and 3DIC, one of the key issue is the Moore’s Law, which is the first priority law in electronics industry. In order to develop further in cross-dimension IoT (Internet of Things) products and AI-chips, the application of VLSI will become wider in range, high reliability ICs become the key performance index. On the other hand, we have reached the manufacturing node in 5nm or smaller, physical effects in transistors have beyond the ability of simulation, especially in the analog circuits which require high performance and accuracy. If we can consider the issues in physical design of circuits, we can lower the performance loss from LDE (Layout dependent effects). We have accumulated many design experiences and data throughout the years, if we can further utilize the techniques from machine and deep learning, we can get the development boost in EDA tools.We plan to develop 2-year techniques for analog and mixed-signal circuit layout designs. We apply the learning techniques in analog layout, given our prior knowledge in analog layout synthesis: customized placement representation and matching based routing. We hope to obtain the prototypes of layouts efficiently via the learned templates, closing the performance gap between pre-sim and post-sim results. Furthermore, we will use machine and deep learning methods in building blocks floorplanning and routing problems. Those include automated recognition of building blocks in mixed-signal designs and the characteristics of the customized signals, in order to speed up the design process of the analog and digital circuits/systems.

project_title: 應用於無人飛行載具邊緣運算的人工智慧物件偵測晶片系統設計與實現
project_title_en: Design and Implementation of Edge Computing Object-Detection Ai Soc for Multi-Rotor Unmanned Vehicles
institution: 國立交通大學電信工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 無人飛行載具已廣泛應用於空拍、監測、消防、農業等各種用途。本計畫以台灣無人機業者所提出的技術需求為出發，專注於節省功率消耗、低系統延遲與系統微小化，研發適用於多旋翼無人飛行載具之物件偵測系統晶片。因此，本計畫將結合人工智慧演算法和邊緣運算加速器，提出基於無人飛行載具空拍影像物件偵測之邊緣運算加速的關鍵技術。人工智慧演算法的部分，我們將使用深度學習技術，利用無人飛行載具空拍影像數據集，訓練高準確度的物件偵測神經網路模型，搭配影像前處理演算法及模型壓縮技術，建立適用於無人飛行載具的演算法模型。邊緣運算加速器的部分，我們將提出影像前處理、神經網路物件偵測、非極大值抑制的硬體加速器電路，並針對速度、功率消耗和資源使用率進行分析及電路優化，在整合晶片系統後進行基於現場可程式化邏輯閘陣列的系統驗證與展示，以及晶片系統後端設計、驗證與下線。綜合以上技術，本計畫將建立無人機關鍵自主技術並提升產品附加價值，希冀藉由人工智能、低功率半導體技術垂直整合現有無人機與半導體相關產業能量與需求，使台灣成為無人機系統全球關鍵產業鏈及技術輸出國之一，提升國際競爭優勢。
abstract_en_plan: Unmanned aerial vehicles have been widely used in various applications such as aerial photography, surveillance, firefighting, and agriculture. Based on the technical requirements of the Taiwanese unmanned machine industry, the project focuses on reducing power consumption, low system latency and miniaturizing system to develop object detection system-on-chip for multi-rotor unmanned vehicles. Therefore, combining artificial intelligence algorithms and edge computing hardware accelerators, key technologies for object detection edge computing acceleration based on unmanned aerial vehicle images are proposed. For artificial intelligence algorithms part, we will use deep learning technique, utilizing unmanned aerial vehicle image dataset to train high accuracy neural network models. With image pre-processing algorithms and model quantization techniques, algorithm models suitable for unmanned aerial vehicles will be built. For the edge computing hardware accelerators part, we will propose image pre-processing, object detection neural network, non-maximum suppression hardware accelerators, analyzing and optimizing circuits aiming at speed, power consumption and resource utilization rate. After the chip system is integrated, system verification and demonstration based on field programmable gate array, and system backend design, verification and tape-out will be done. Based on the above technologies, the project will establish key autonomic technologies for UAVs and increase product added value. It is hoped that artificial intelligence and low-power semiconductor technology will vertically integrate the existing UAVs and semiconductor-related industry energy and demand, so that Taiwan will become one of the global key industrial chains and technology exporting countries of UAV system to enhance international competitive advantage.

project_title: 基於MobileNet之高效能低複雜度捲積神經網路硬體加速器架構設計與電路實現
project_title_en: The Design and Implementation of a High-Throughput and Low-Complexity Cnn Accelerator Based on Mobilenet
institution: 國立臺灣科技大學電子工程系
abstract_zh_plan: 人工智慧領域相關應用多以卷積神經網路(CNN)為基礎, 並在語音識別, 影像分類, 與自動駕駛等方面扮演關鍵性的技術. 由於CNN的資料量與運算量非常龐大, 使其難以在運算效能有限並要求低複雜度與低功率消耗的嵌入式系統中實現. 近年來, 隨著人工智慧的應用延伸至像是自動駕駛或醫療診斷等嵌入式系統領域, 如何設計並實現CNN專用的高效能硬體加速器的重要性與日俱增. 除此之外, 許多研究開發輕量型卷積神經網路, 使其架構具有較低的運算量及參數大小, 以更適合嵌入式硬體設計. MobileNet系列是輕量型卷積神經網路的經典架構, 它擁有相對較低的運算量並保持相當高的辨識準確性. 我們在前期研究中針對MobileNet設計專門的硬體加速電路並能夠達到高處理速度, 低複雜度以及低功率消耗. MobileNet系列的最新版本MobileNetV3於今年(2019)被提出, 並被證明可以達到更高的 75.2 % Top-1準確度, 對於在需要高準確率的應用如自動駕駛等具有更好的效果. 目前文獻中沒有針對此一MobileNetV3網路的電路架構被發表, 因此而具有極高的研究價值. 在本計畫中我們將採取演算法, 資料處理流程, 與電路架構共同設計的方法針對MobileNetV3進行高效能低複雜度硬體加速電路設計與實現. 我們將首先針對MobileNetV3的網路架構進行軟體模擬以分析運算流程. 我們認為, 資料在記憶體之間的搬移比計算卷積運算本身更消耗能量及造成延遲, 而其中最大的功率消耗和延遲成本是將資料從外部記憶體移動到硬體加速器中. 為了解決這個問題, 我們將針對MobileNetV3設計更有效率的資料處理流程, 主要目標在硬體元件的共同使用以及降低對於記憶體的存取需求以提高處理速度和能量效率. 我們將基於我們提出的資料處理流程設計MobileNetV3電路架構以及硬體元件並進行效能最佳化. 我們的架構設計重點在於使得硬體元件能夠盡量被重複利用, 以達到最佳的使用效率. 在元件使用效率提升的情形下, 我們可以利用較少的元件達到較佳的處理速度. 我們最後將以硬體描述語言實現所設計的電路架構並以數位積體電路開發流程進行到至少布局後的階段. 我們也將把我們開發的MobileNetV3加速器以FPGA平台實現, 並以具體應用系統展示研發成果. 本計畫預計以兩年時間達到規劃的研究目的.
abstract_en_plan: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has been effectively used in the applications such as image classification, voice recognition, and automated driving. However, conventional CNN models contain extremely high computational complexity which are usually in the order of Giga Multiply-and-Accumulate (GMAC) operations. As a result, it is challenging to practically deploy conventional CNN models in embedded platforms like Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). Efforts have been made attempting to propose lightweight CNN models that can be practically realized in embedded systems. It is shown in literature that the MobileNet, which is based on the depthwise separable convolution, achieves the lowest theoretical computational complexity while maintaining acceptable accuracy. In our previous research, we have designed and implemented a hardware accelerator based on the MobileNet structure. Moreover, the newest version MobileNetV3 is presented this year (2019) and is shown to achieve a much improved Top-1 accuracy with very-low complexity. Such feature makes the MobileNetV3 very lucrative for being deployed in the embedded systems. To the best of our knowledge, no VLSI architecture or hardware accelerator for MobileNetV3 has ever been reported in literature.       This project aims to design and implement the efficient hardware accelerator of the CNN based on the MobileNetV3 model and the depthwise separable convolution. In this project, we will first build up the software simulation model, based on the Tensor flow and Keras, for the MobileNetV3 network. We will then analyze and investigate the operation flow of the MobileNetV3 based on the simulated environment. In the following, we aim to design an efficient data processing flow for the MobileNetV3. The objective of the designed data flow is to maximize the re-utilization of the data that is already inside the CNN accelerator and to re-use the operational components. Therefore, the requirement for the on-chip storage elements and the accesses to the off-chip memory are greatly reduced. This results in a great reduction in the access delay and area complexity. Furthermore, we design the VLSI architecture and circuit for the MobileNetV3 based on our designed data processing flow. Our design needs to be fully pipelined and the processing elements need to the efficiently utilized so that the efficiency can be enhanced and the complexity can be reduced. Moreover, the design MobileNetV3 architecture will be implemented based on RTL design and realized through the ASIC design flow until to the stage of post-layout. Extensive experiments and analyses need to be conducted for evaluating the performance and complexity.

project_title: 人工智慧在前瞻電子設計自動化技術的應用(II)-子計畫一：神經網路硬體實現設計自動化技術(II)
project_title_en: Design Automation for Hardware Implementation of Neural Networks  (II)
institution: 元智大學資訊工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 近年來，AI與物聯網(IoT)的結合受到注目，智能化的終端裝置驅動了許多新應用。然而，接近資料來源端的終端運算裝置通常具有低耗電需求，不同於在資料中心的大型運算伺服器，終端裝置在能量和運算能力上都受到了限制。因此，如何有效地將複雜的AI技術實現在資源受限的硬體裝置上成為了重要的議題。為此，針對神經網路，許多專家學者提出模型簡化技術與硬體實現技術。由於這些技術往往造成神經網路的準確性下降，模型優化與準確性之間存在著trade-off問題。因此，本子計畫將探討神經網路硬體實現化議題，開發一套完整的解決方案，從神經網路設計、訓練，一直到數位化和硬體實現。在上年度計畫中，我們探討神經網路數位化技術，考慮神經網路中不同階層具有不同容錯能力之特性，施予不同的量化程度，在神經網路準確度損失和優化程度間取得完善的平衡。延續上年度計畫目標與成果，本子計畫第一年探討神經網路邏輯合成技術，先以面積最小化為目標，強調直接合成技術，將神經網路中的參數合成至電路中，以減少裝置上的記憶體空間需求以及提升硬體安全性。第二年則開發視覺化的神經網路開發平台，提供簡易的視覺化網頁介面，並且整合PyTorch開發平台，讓開發者可以簡單透過網頁介面完成神經網路設計與訓練。最後整合所開發技術，完成一個具備神經網路前端設計與訓練，和後端硬體實現的開發平台。我們預期所提開發的技術將能有效增進神經網路硬體實現化技術，對AI與相關半導體產業帶來助益
abstract_en_plan: Recently, the integration of AI and IoT has been attracting much attention. Intelligent edge devices drive many new applications. However, the edge computing devices near the data source usually have a low-power requirement. Unlike the powerful workstations in the data center, both of the energy and computing power of the edge devices are constrained. Thus, how to effectively realize complex AI techniques with source-limited edge devices is an important issue that needs to be addressed. To this end, many researchers have proposed model compression and hardware implementation methods for neural networks (NNs). Since these methods usually lead to the drop of NN accuracy, there exists a trade-off problem between model optimization and accuracy drop.Thus, this sub-project will investigate the issue of NN hardware implementation and propose a complete solution for NN design, training, digitalization and hardware realization. In the last-year project, we investigate the technique for NN digitalization. We consider the different error tolerance of different layers in a NN, and apply different quantization levels to them for achieving a good balance between model optimization and accuracy drop. Based on the research results, in the first year of this sub-project, we will continue to investigate the logic synthesis technique for NNs with the objective of area minimization. We focus on the direct synthesis technique which synthesizes the parameters in a NN into the logic circuit for reducing the requirement of memory space and increasing hardware security. In the second year, we will develop a visual framework for NN development, which provides an easy and web-based interface and integrates the PyTorch framework, so that developers can easily design and train their NNs via the web-based interface. Finally, we will integrate the proposed techniques within the three years to present a framework that involves NN design and training at the front end, and then hardware implementation at the back end.We expect that the proposed techniques can effectively enhance the NN hardware implementation technology, and favor the AI and related semiconductor industry.

project_title: 數位神經網路低功耗高可靠加速技術之研究
project_title_en: Study on Low-Power High-Reliability Digital Neural Network Acceleration
institution: 國立彰化師範大學電子工程學系
abstract_zh_plan: 人工智慧為國內外積極發展的重點領域，加速了人類對計算量的需求。研究機構普遍認為計算量需求形成一個每三個多月便會倍增的超摩爾定律；但是專家也警告，地球能源增加速度緩慢，不降低計算功耗的話，再過二十幾年將不足計算所需；因此，既能降低功耗的神經網路加速技術便為當務之急！本計畫針對數位神經網路硬體加速提出兩類共三種技術：(I)近似計算法：包含：各層乘加網路的「批次學習近似計算法」和應用於各層激勵函數的「範圍定址查表法」；以及(II)適用整體網路精準計算之「殘數系統」。我們發表最佳化布斯演算法以為三技術轉換最佳三值二元碼之用，在批次學習中創新準常數累加，並提出準確速率回饋誤差控制，使低功、加速與準確度達到最佳化；再以本實驗室專利之範圍可定址記憶體以最佳化折線函數來查表，其斜率乘法得以化成四個輸入的加法器。在殘數系統方面更是洞悉上百篇主要文獻尋找模數集之關鍵，找出以自動化設計之演算法，來自動合成所需之殘數系統，在簡化與準窮極法的驗證控制下，確保發展出來的系統能在低功加速下，兼具自我檢查、乃至於容錯的高可靠性。本計畫已有幾年的基礎，並在兩三次國際研討會中激盪衍生而出；實則，其推導和各別模擬例證均在初步腹案中幾近完成，本實驗室所有成員對具體實現均是充滿信心；除了在學術上每一技術期待能各在知名國際研討會交換意見外，更能修正改良後各發表1篇的SCI期刊論文，更希望加緊努力，使理論能實現於產學合作中，能為我國人工智慧產業盡一分心力！
abstract_en_plan: Artificial Intelligence has becomes the key domain where the international and national industries devote to. It eventually accelerates the needs of people on huge computation capacity. Many research institutes have asserted that the requirement of computation has become a More Than Moore Law with a doubling rate per 3.4 months. However, a lot of experts warn us the energy on earth won’t be enough within twenties years if we don’t study low-power computing acceleration.Therefore in this project, we propose two kinds including three technologies, approximate computing for batch learning, activation using range looking up tables, and a self-checking residue number system. Based on our weight-minimized Booth Algorithm, the optimal ternary binary codes will be taken advantage of in these technologies. The semi-constants make the multiply-and-add network can be reduced to simple accumulation. A PWL searching algorithm for range CAM is developed for low-power fast activation functions. We also finally find that the moduli set in a residue number system could and should be optimized using EDA methods. Our study results prove that the developed low-power RNS can accelerate with a high self-checking ability, and even fault-tolerant capacity.This project is based on the forgoing foundation but bursts out high novelty and innovation. In the preliminary preparation, we have actually completed most derivations and simulations. All members in our lab believe feasibility. One international conference paper and one associated SCI journal will be expected to publish for each proposed technology. Further cooperation with the industry will also expected for possible contribution to our society and industry.

project_title: 應用於類神經網路運算之薄膜電晶體型鐵電突觸記憶體元件整合技術開發
project_title_en: Technology Integration Development of Thin-Film-Transistor-Based Ferroelectric Synapse Memory for the Application of Neuromorphic Computing
institution: 國立臺北科技大學材料及資源工程系
abstract_zh_plan: 近期，以鐵電記憶體作為突觸元件，用於類神經網路型態運算(Neuromorphic Computing)中的相關研究結果已經被陸續揭露。然而，研究結果顯示，鐵電記憶體性能不佳，包含低開關電流比，以及資料保留力差等問題，將導致權重更新(Weight Updates)對稱性和線性度不佳。因此，如何有效改善多重鐵電域(Multi-domain)切換特性，是鐵電記憶體在類神經網路應用上面臨的一大挑戰。近期我們已成功開發出薄膜電晶體型鐵電記憶體元件(TFT-Based FeRAM)，由初期研究成果中發現，此鐵電記憶體具備良好的記憶窗口(~6V)和優異的資料保留力。不僅有效改善了傳統1T鐵電記憶體記憶窗口過小，以及資料保存性差等問題，未來也有助於改善權重更新線性度問題。為了更進一步開發符合類神經網路應用的鐵電記憶體技術，本研究計畫提出兩年期實驗規畫與相對應解決方案，具體研究方向包含第一年的鐵電電容元件製程優化和突觸元件權重計算分析系統建立，以及第二年的薄膜電晶體型鐵電記憶體元件製程開發和後續的類神經網路權重分析與探討。我們近五年在薄膜電晶體和鐵電記憶體的研發成果，已發表於IEEE國際會議2015 VLSI, 2016 IRPS, 2018 IRPS以及2019 VLSI上，可說明我們已具備足夠研究能力執行此一兩年期計畫。本計畫也將同步探討不同結晶相的鐵電材料與多重鐵電域操作，對於鐵電電容元件及鐵電記憶體電性之影響，以期能成功研發出符合下世代類神經型態工程需求之記憶體元件。
abstract_en_plan: To support the development of internet of things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI) chips, the semiconductor industries give the priority to the technology research on the next-generation transistor featuring ultralow low-power operation. Recently, the researches focused on the ferroelectric memory as synapse device for the application of neuromorphic computing have been revealed. However, the small on/off current ratio and poor data retention of ferroelectric memory significantly cause the nonlinearity and asymmetry of weight updates in the neuromorphic computing engineering. Therefore, the strategy for improving the ferroelectric multi-domain switching is important. Recently, we have successfully developed the TFT-based ferroelectric memory (TFT-based FeRAM) with one-transistor one-capacitor (1T-1C) structure. From the preliminary experimental results, we can find that the novel ferroelectric memory features a large memory window of 6V and good data retention, which not only improve the performance issues of small memory window and poor retention in traditional 1T ferroelectric memory, but is also helpful to improve the linearity of weight updates for neuromorphic computing. To further develop the ferroelectric memory technology to meet the requirements of neuromorphic computing engineering, we will propose a 2-year project to achieve the goal of stable multi-state switching. The research works in these two years include the optimization and evaluation of ferroelectric synapse memory device (1st year) and the process development and synaptic weight update analysis of TFT-based ferroelectric memory (2nd year). Our previous research works on metal-oxide TFTs and ferroelectric memories have been successfully published in 2015 VLSI, 2016 IRPS, 2018 IRPS, 2019 VLSI papers. These research throughout confirmed that we have the research capability to execute this 2-year project. The influence of ferroelectric crystal phases and multi-domain switching in ferroelectric memory will be simultaneously investigated to realize a well-controlled ferroelectric memory technology for the application of neuromorphic computing engineering.

project_title: 具有物聯網聯網功能與T-S模糊控制系統之類神經預測型直接轉矩控制混波晶片設計與製作
project_title_en: Design and Implementation of the Neural Predictive Direct Torque Control Mixed-Mode Chip with Iot Communication and T-S Fuzzy Control System
institution: 國立臺北科技大學電機工程系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 本計畫擬於三年內以混波積體電路技術來設計並製作一顆具有類神經比例積分微分速度控制器、多階模糊化磁滯比較器、T-S模糊控制器、類神經多重電壓向量表、USB/RS485傳輸介面、Type-C傳輸介面、乙太/光纖網路媒體傳輸層、與傳輸媒介無關的傳輸介面、動態差額循環/靜態隨機存取記憶體與三角積分類比數位轉換器等電路之類神經預測型直接轉矩控制混波晶片，使得馬達端的監控工作可以經由USB/RS485與Type-C傳輸介面，透過乙太/光纖網路傳送到遠端的個人電腦或伺服器來達成，同時促使『馬達驅動控制』、『半導體技術』與『物聯網系統』的異業結盟，提高馬達控制產業的競爭力與市佔率。引入積體電路技術不僅可以減少控制器的體積，同時可以提高控制精度與技術層次；整合USB/RS485與Type-C傳輸介面，可以成功地完成多通道傳輸架構，同時監控多個馬達運作情形；再者，研發乙太網路轉同步光纖網路的橋接器，可以提昇網路傳輸速度至每秒100億位元，解決多通道馬達控制所產生的頻寬不足問題；而加入三角積分類比數位轉換器電路，可以提高控制信號的解析度到十五位元，增加控制精度並減少漣波誤差。這些技術的整合與晶片化，可以大大提昇馬達控制技術的深度與廣度，增加競爭優勢，有助於馬達產業的未來發展。
abstract_en_plan: In the following three years, this project intends to bring the design skill of mixed-signal integrated circuit (IC) into the neural predictive direct torque control (NPDTC) system for AC induction motor, which is composed of the neural PID speed controller, multistage fuzzy hysteresis comparator, T-S fuzzy control system, neural multiple voltage vectors table, USB/RS485 communication interface, USB Type-C interface, and GMII. By integrating the above-mentioned NPDTC with Ethernet/SONET, DRR/SRAM package scheduling and delta-sigma analog-to-digital converter (ADC), a mixed-signal IC is proposed for controlling the AC induction motor. The destination not only remotely controls the AC motor through USB/RS485 interface, but also stores those sensing data into PC or server through the Ethernet/SONET. In the meantime, the confederation between induction motor control industrialism, semiconductor industrialism, and IoT industrialism is enhanced to raise the competition and market share of motor control. The wafer technology will decrease the controller’s size and raise the control resolution with high technical layer. Furthermore, the multiple-channel communication architecture of motor controller can be established by integrating the Ethernet/SONET with RS485 or USB. A high-speed bridge is designed to have a transmission speed of 10 gigabits by transferring package from Ethernet to SONET. In addition, a 15-bit MASH delta-sigma ADC is designed to improve the control resolution and to reduce the ripple’s amplitude. High integration of wafer scale promotes the future development of motor industrialism and highlights its competitive advantage by boosting production both intensively and extensively.

project_title: 雲端模擬與群組機器人之研究-子計畫三：輪型機器人之關鍵技術開發
project_title_en: Development of Key Technologies for Wheeled Robots
institution: 淡江大學電機工程學系
abstract_zh_plan: 本計畫為雲端模擬與群組機器人之研究的子計畫三-輪型機器人之關鍵技術開發。本計畫共有四個研究主題：(1) 強化學習應用於目標軌跡追蹤及阻擋，(2)基於ROS2之多機器人的通訊架構與協作，(3)可重組類神經網路硬體電路設計以及(4)機器人語音控制技術。主題1的研究為偵測目標物，並且預測目標物軌跡，最後在攔截點順利攔截。主題2為建立多機器人的通訊框架，並且控制機器人互相協作完成隊形排列。主題3為設計低價高性能的類神經網路硬體電路，來輔助機器人主機的人工智慧的運算。主題4是運用OpenSeq2Seq軟體來開發設計一套語音辨識系統，用來指揮控制機器人。最後會透過機器人模擬平台以及實際機器人控制來實現虛擬整合，並驗證各主題的功能。
abstract_en_plan: This project is the the sub-project three of  cloud simulation and research of group robots. The project name is key technology development for wheeled robot. This project has four research topics: (1) reinforcement learning applied to target trajectory tracking and blocking, (2) communication architecture and collaboration of multiple robots based on ROS2, (3) reconfigurable neural network hardware circuit design, and (4) robot voice control technology. The research in Topic 1 is to detect the target, predict the target's trajectory, and finally block it at the goal area. Topic 2 is to establish a multi-robot communication framework, and control the robots to cooperate with each other to complete the lineup. Topic 3 is the design of low-cost and high-performance neural network-like hardware circuits to assist the artificial intelligence calculation of the robot host. Topic 4 is the development and design of a speech recognition system using OpenSeq2Seq software to command and control the robot. Finally, the robot simulation platform and actual robot control will be used to achieve virtual integration and verify the functions of various topics.

project_title: 應用於神經元突觸之新穎鐵電穿隧接面元件研製與特性研究
project_title_en: Fabrication and Characteristics of Novel Ferroelectric Tunneling Junction (Ftj) Device for Neuronal Synapse Application
institution: 逢甲大學電子工程學系
abstract_zh_plan: 近年來鐵電穿隧接面(ferroelectric tunnel junction, FTJ)記憶體已被視為未來重要的記憶體元件，因FTJ元件為兩端的非揮發性記憶體，適合神經元突觸元件 (neuronal synaptic device) 的應用，目前此方面的研究尚在起步階段，需經由實驗與元件製程優化開發，以提升神經元突觸元件技術。本計畫擬進行FTJ元件之氧化鋯鉿(HfZrO2)鐡電薄膜與不同界面層(interfacial layer, IL)的優化製程技術開發、高性能FTJ金屬電極功函數與金屬晶向優化製程開發、覆蓋氮化矽應力層之FTJ元件特性研究、應用FTJ於神經元突觸元件之權重線性度(linearity of synaptic weight)特性研究，以及應用FTJ於新穎鐡電閘極無接面電晶體(FTJ-JL-FeFET)元件開發等4項主要研究。本計畫之最終目標為完成高ON/OFF電流比例的FTJ記憶體技術、高速轉換、高矯頑電壓以及高可靠度的FTJ元件技術，以及開發高線性度的神經元FTJ突觸元件與FTJ無接面電晶體(FTJ-JL-FeFET)的製作與特性研究。
abstract_en_plan: In recent years, ferroelectric tunnel junction (FTJ) memory has been regarded as an important memory device in the future. Because FTJ device is a two-terminal non-volatile memory device, it is suitable for neuron synaptic devices. The research in this field is still not clear, and it needs to be developed through experiments and component process optimization to improve neuron synaptic device technology. There are 4 main research items in this project. Firstly, this project intends to develop optimized process technology for hafnium-zirconium oxide (HfZrO2) thin film and different interfacial layer (IL) of FTJ device. The second item is to develop high-performance FTJ with metal electrode work function and metal crystal orientation optimization process. The third item is the FTJ device covered the silicon nitride (Si3N4) as the stressor to study the performance. The fourth item is the application of FTJ to study the linearity of synaptic weight neuronal synaptic device, and the development of FTJ applied to the novel ferroelectric gate dielectric of junctionless FeFET device (FTJ-JL-FeFET).The final purpose of this work of this project is to complete FTJ memory technology with high ON/OFF current ratio, high-speed switching, high coercive voltage, and high-reliability FTJ device, and to gain the high-linearity neuron FTJ synaptic elements and FTJ ferroelectric Transistor (FTJ-JL-FeFET) with high performance.

abstract_zh_plan: 有鑑於近年來人工智慧的快速發展，新世代的半導體元件須具備有模仿人類學習之能力，而突觸電晶體的概念將能夠模仿人類神經傳遞之行為，從而實現具有學習能力晶片系統之目標。目前，已經有研究採用氧化物半導體作為突觸電晶體之主動層，但大多是使用氧化銦鎵鋅相關之材料系統。此外，其薄膜之沉積方式也大多是依靠濺鍍或是脈衝雷射沉積法。以上兩種薄膜沉積技術屬於耗能，對於環境負擔較大。考量到上述之原因，本計畫將提出另一種薄膜沉積技術，稱為霧化常壓化學氣相沉積法，用於沉積突觸電晶體結構中所使用到的各式氧化物薄膜。再者，本計畫中使用具有鈣鈦礦結構之氧化鋇錫作為突觸電晶體之主動層，並在元件結構設計中使用奈米顆粒、負電容與穿隧接面等技術降低突觸電晶體之功率消耗。最後，將計畫中所研發之突觸電晶體製作成3×3陣列記憶體電路，並探討與分析其相關特性。
abstract_en_plan: Due to rapid growth of artificial intelligent (AI), the capabilities of mimicking human behaviors such as learning and memory are required for the next-generation semiconductor devices. The concept of synaptic transistors is to mimic neuron transmission/receiving behaviors and to be used to realize the chip/system with learning capability. So far, oxide-based semiconductors have been applied as an active layer of synaptic transistors. Among them, In-Ga-Zn-O material system is widely used in synaptic transistors due to mature deposition technology such as sputter and pulse laser deposition (PLD). However, sputter and PLD are energy-consuming and non-environmental-friendly processes. Therefore, this project proposes using mist atmospheric pressure chemical vapor deposition (MAPCVD), an environmental-friendly thin film deposition technology to grow various oxide-based thin films. Besides, the BaSnO3 with perovskite structure is used as an active layer of the synaptic transistor. Nanoparticle, negative capacitance, and tunneling junction are included in the device structure to reduce the power consumption of the synaptic transistor. Finally, a 3×3 array memory circuit is made of the BaSnO3-based synaptic transistors is designed, fabricated, and characterized.

project_title: 聚矽氮烷液態高分子陶瓷前驅物熱解形成複合高熵陶瓷之介電與熱傳性質於高功率及高頻電子元件陶瓷基板之研究
project_title_en: The Dielectric and Thermal Properties of the High Entropy Ceramic Composite with Pyrolytic Polysilazane Preceramic Precursor for the Ceramic Substrates of High Power/Frequency Devices.
institution: 國立中山大學機械與機電工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 在未來5G/6G甚至AI晶片所需更高頻高功率之電子元件基板，LTCC及HTCC陶瓷基板之熱傳及結構強度，遠優於傳統塑膠基板而將扮演重要角色。然而、傳統之陶瓷基板其熱膨脹係數與矽相差過大，而產生熱匹配問題。目前、因氮化鋁其熱膨脹係數與矽相近且熱傳導係數，約為氧化鋁的十倍，而成為最適合之陶瓷基板材料，但其問題為易發生水解反應。本計畫之目的為，開發出⸢雙層高熵碳氮氧化矽/氮化鋁複合陶瓷基板⸥。在材料方面將利用⸢聚矽氮烷液態高分子陶瓷前驅物⸥ 作為陶瓷基板鍍膜之材料母體，並以等莫耳奈米陶瓷粉與之結合，形成⸢膠狀高熵陶瓷前驅物⸥並旋塗於氮化鋁基板表面，經過特定高溫熱解後形成⸢多層高熵碳氮氧化矽/氮化鋁複合陶瓷基板⸥。第一年的主軸則是量測在不同厚度及熱解溫度下，高熵碳氮氧化矽薄膜在低頻及直流條件下其介電常數及損失，以了解其介電特性是否適合作為高功率基板。第二年實驗將瞭解⸢雙層高熵碳氮氧化矽/氮化鋁複合陶瓷基板⸥在熱疲勞循環下造成的破壞，利用量測碳氮氧化矽陶瓷薄膜與氮化鋁之熱傳導係數以瞭解其熱傳遞現象，分析其不同膜厚及熱解溫度下之熱傳導現象。最後一年之計畫主軸則為困難度最高的部分，在找到其最佳熱解溫度後，量測其在毫米波段下之介電特性(<20GHz)及暫態變頻之條件下，量測⸢多層高熵碳氮氧化矽/氮化鋁複合陶瓷基板⸥之介電常數及損失與頻率之關係(2.5~20GHz或更高頻)，以確定其應用在高頻元件之穩定性。而三年之實驗規劃，將依實際實驗結果進行調整。初期實驗已經證實，利用⸢聚矽氮烷液態高分子陶瓷前驅物⸥表面鍍膜於氮化鋁粉體表面，熱解之後所形成之碳氮氧化矽陶瓷膜，在一定厚度之下具有抗水解的能力且在高溫水解實驗之下，其pH值在兩個星期之後亦保持穩定。在500ºC熱解之矽基陶瓷膜鍍於陽極處理鋁合金表面經奈米壓痕測試，其硬度分別可達HV 620且其楊氏係數可達到102 Gpa.在初步電化學實驗中，將銅泡棉浸潤於⸢聚矽氮烷液態高分子陶瓷前驅物⸥後熱解，並利用不同電解液以及掃描頻率，以動態電位進行塔佛曲線量測。初步的實驗結果以硫酸為電解液，其為SiCNO陶瓷銅泡棉電極的腐蝕電位0.002V，高於純泡棉電極的腐蝕電位-0.062 V。除了腐蝕電位之外，SiCNO陶瓷銅泡棉電極腐蝕電流密度，亦低於純泡棉電極的腐蝕電流密度。其結果顯示SiCNO陶瓷膜其腐蝕電位亦高於高熵合金Al0.5CoCrCuFe
abstract_en_plan: The heat transfer and mechanical strength of LTCC /HTCC ceramic substrates are far superior to the traditional plastic substrate and to play an important role for high power/frequency and 5G/6G electronic devices. However, the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) of traditional ceramic substrates has huge difference with silicon to cause thermal mismatch issue. Aluminum nitride (AlN) has a similar CTE to silicon and its thermal conductivity is about ten times to that of alumina; therefore, AlN substrate has become a promising candidate for power electronics; nevertheless, its problem is easy to hydrolytically react with moisture. The goal of this research proposal is to utilize “Polysilazane Preceramic precursor” as the material matrix for equiatomic nano ceramic powder fillers and coating ceramic substrate to form “gel-like high entropy preceramic precursor” that will be spin-coated on a AlN substrate. After pyrolysis, the “double layer high entropy SiCNO/AlN composite ceramic substrate” is formed. The experiment in the first year will be focusing on the thermal mismatch to cause the fatigue failure, which can be analyzed by measuring the thermal conductivity of “double layer high entropy SiCNO/AlN composite ceramic substrate” with different thickness and pyrolytic temperature of the SiCNO film to reduce the temperature gradient during thermal fatigue. The experiment in the second year will be focusing on measuring the dielectric properties with different thickness and pyrolytic temperature of the SiCNO film, including dielectric constant and dielectric loss under low frequency and DC conditions. The experiment in the third year would be the most challenge part that will be focusing on measuring the dielectric properties, permittivity and tangent loss at high frequency(2.5GHz~20GHz). This measurement will be the stability of dielectric constant and loss of the “double layer high entropy SiCNO/AlN composite ceramic substrate” at transient frequency. If possible, the higher frequency will be applied for this measurement. The previous work published shows that polysilazane preceramic precursor pyrolyzed to form SiCNO ceramic film on the surface of AlN powder provides highly ability to anti-hydrolysis in the high temperature hydrolytic reaction. The pH value remains constantly for over 10 days. The initial results show that the hardness of SiCNO ceramic film coated on the anodized aluminum alloy pyrolyzed at 400 and 500 ºC can achieve HV 580 and HV 620, respectively and the young’s modulus of SiCNO ceramic pyrolyzed at 500 ºC can reach 102 Gpa by nanoindentation measurement. The corrosion potential of SiCNO coated copper foam in sulfuric acid solution is 0.002 V higher than those of pure copper foam electrode, -0.062 V and high entropy alloy, Al0.5CoCrCuFe.

project_title: 具有高效率且可重組態神經網路加速器之智慧水產養殖監控邉緣系統之實現
project_title_en: Implementation of a Smart Aquaculture Surveillance Edge System Equipped with High-Efficient Reconfigurable Neural Network Accelerators
institution: 國立中山大學資訊工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 隨著AI人工智慧的快速發展，相關應用快速地擴散到各個應用場域，配合下一個世代之無線網路之基礎建設，智慧物聯網AIoT之應用架構將越來越成熟。為此本計畫的主要目標乃是設計出一個具有高效率之AI邉緣處理系統，這個系統將首先開發一個高效率的可重組態之深度神經網路加速器，預計開發之加速電路模組高度強調效率、以及實際系統操作應用之運作。因此在架構上預計以位元序列的算術邏輯為基礎，開發各種最佳化的技術，包含位元量化、 模型和位元長度之自動切換、 位元序列運算電路之簡化等等。而針對實際電路系統操作，將考慮有關軟硬體的協同設計整合 、系統資料搬移、驅動程式之撰寫開發、AI編譯器之整合等議題，因為這些議題譬如特徵及權重資料之擺放一匯流排資料搬移策略，都會影響系統實際運作之效能。另外本計畫也將開發基於階層式時序記憶HTM模型之應用開發及電路架構設計，此種模型所使用之神經元，有別於一般採用之神經元模型，非常適合應用於異常偵測。相關的研究尤其是電路架構之實作，無論在國內或全世界相關研究非常缺乏。 因此這個計畫的一項主要特點也是將開啟國內少有研究HTM之模型及電路實現之研究。本計畫所開發之系統將實際應用於智慧水產之監控，負責實現行相關養殖監控制之AI演算法， 包含物件辨識、切割以及行為及感測器訊號異常偵測 ，希望能對於智慧水產養殖之應用有實質的貢獻，以提高台灣養殖漁業的競爭力。而所開發的系統也將不僅限於水產應用，而是可應用於適合未來智慧物聯網架構下的邉緣處理。
abstract_en_plan: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI), related applications have been rapidly spreading to various fields in recent years. Along with the next generation of wireless network infrastructure ready to go, the AI Internet of Things (AIoT) architecture will not only become more mature, but also be one of the most important key techniques.   Therefore, the main goal of this project is to design a high-efficient AI edge processing system. We will first develop a highly efficient reconfigurable deep neural network accelerator, which will emphasize on the efficiency of practical operations of application systems.  Our accelerator will be developed based on the bit-serial arithmetic logic.  Various optimization techniques, including bit quantization, automatic reconfiguration of different models and bit lengths, and simplified bit-serial arithmetic unit design, will all be addressed in the project.   In order to achieve high operation efficiency, we will also address different system-level optimization issues which include hardware and software codesign, system data transfer, and system driver development.  The other key aspect of this project is to develop the applications and circuit architecture design of a new neuron model called hierarchical temporal memory (HTM).  The neurons used in this model are different from the commonly used neuron models and are very suitable for anomaly detection.  Relevant research, especially the implementation of circuit architecture, is scarce both domestically and worldwide.  Therefore, one of the main features of this plan is to start the research on this new models and its hardware implementation.  The system developed by this project will be applied to the monitoring of smart aquaculture.  It will implement related aquaculture AI algorithms such as shrimp object identification, segmentation, and abnormal detection of behavior and sensor signals.   The results can be beneficial to the improved competitiveness of Taiwan's aquaculture fisheries.  Furthermore, our system will not only be limited to aquatic applications, but can be expected to be applied to many edge applications under the AIoT framework.

project_title: 支援多種神經網路運算形態之深度學習加速器設計和系統整合
project_title_en: Design and System Integration of Deep Learning Accelerators Supporting Various Neural Computation Types                 Design and System Integration
institution: 國立中山大學資訊工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 包含多層convolution Neural Networks (CNN)架構的深度神經網路機器學習模型，最近已被成功的使用於物件類別辨識的準確率和其他人工智慧相關應用。由於CNN機器學習運算量非常龐大，因此大多藉由高階繪圖處理器的平行運算功能加速，但是這些高階運算平台的速度和功率消耗表現，仍然無法達到許多應用的需求，尤其是在資源有限的嵌入式人工智慧終端設備，速度功耗比是重要的效能衡量指標。此外，除了卷積運算層之外，很多神經網路模型還包括其他類型的運算形態，如生成對抗網路的反卷積運算、以及遞迴神經網路(recurrent neural network)的長短期記憶(Long Short Term Memory, LSTM)運算等。本計畫的主要目標是設計可支援多種神經網路運算形態之深度學習加速器。首先我們將探討如何利用不同的硬體平行度，設計深度神經網路架構，分析不同架構和處理單元數之速度／面積／功耗，尋找最佳化的架構。然後，針對目前常見的神經網路層運算形態，設計相關的運算處理單元。由於深度學習硬體加速器中的內部記憶體和緩衝器通常佔整體面積一半以上，因此，本計畫將提出有效率的記憶體設計，並且針對不同尺寸／步伐的卷積核心，設計一個通用的線形緩衝器(line buffer)。此外，CNN運算的權重和運算過程中的資料有很大比率為零值，本計畫將考量此稀疏性(sparsity)，避免冗餘資料／權重的存取和運算，以降低功耗和運算時間。最後，我們將提出結合軟硬體的設計流程，針對各種不同的神經網路運算形態，制定相關指令集以控制硬體加速器，並探討最佳的運算排程和記憶體配置方式，在FPGA雛形驗證平台執行完整的CNN-based物件偵測應用。
abstract_en_plan: Machine learning architectures based on deep convolutional neural networks (CNN) have been successfully adopted for accurate object classification/detection and many other artificial intelligence applications. Due to the large computation complexity, most CNN operations are executed on high-end parallel computation platforms with graphics processing units (GPU) accelerating the involved operations. However, these high-power GPU-based platforms cannot be used in hardware-resource-limited embedded edge devices where speed/power ratio is one of the importance performance metrics. In this proposal, we will design a deep learning hardware accelerator that supports various neural computation types targeting for edge devices. First, we will design architectures by exploring various computation parallelism and data reuse schemes in deep learning, and analyze the design trade-off among area cost, power, and speed. Then, we will enhance the processing elements (PE) so that it can execute various neural computation types in different neural layers, including convolution, de-convolutiion, LSTM (long short term memory). Since internal memory usually takes more than half of the total area cost in most deep learning accelerators, we will present efficient memory design. Besides, a universal line buffer will be proposed to support various sizes and strides of convolution filters in different neural network layers. Furthermore, since neural computation involves large amount of zeros in weights and activation data, we will exploit such sparsity to reduce memory access power and increase computation speed. Finally, we will present a complete design flow to integrate hardware accelerators and software machine learning models by designing our own instruction set to map various neural computation types onto the corresponding hardware with optimized scheduling and memory allocation. The complete hardware/software system will be ported to FPGA boards to execute the CNN-based object detection.

project_title_en: Thermal-Aware Adaptable Neural Turing System Architecture Design with Reliable Computing
institution: 國立中山大學資訊工程學系(所)
abstract_zh_plan: 隨著人工智慧以及物聯網技術的蓬勃發展，帶動了各種產業的發展也逐步改變人類的生活方式。一般而言，人工智慧技術的發展可分為1)以邏輯規則為主的人工智慧、2)機器學習、3)具認知能力的人工智慧、和4)可自主學習的人工智慧。第一階段的人工智慧技術利用邏輯學以及各項法則進行設定，並可用來做一些基本的邏輯判斷；第二階段的人工智慧技術透過統計學的概念，利用大量的資料來訓練機器，並找到資料輸入與輸出之對應關係，也是目前大部分人工智慧技術之發展階段。雖然獲得了很好的成效，但由於需要使用大量的參數來支撐起龐大的學習模型，因此無法適應不斷變化的條件。    為了解決第二階段人工智慧設計上的限制，美國國防先進技術研究計畫機構於2018年起，投入超過二十億美金來研發下一代人工智慧技術，來提升人工智慧技術整體的可適性。因此，第三階段以及第四階段之人工智慧技術將須具備學習歸納與感知的能力以達到適應環境之改變。然而，要達到此目標，就必須要能在接收任一種資料型態下，立即調整自身的運算行為並精準地給予反饋。意即，未來的人工智慧技術必須要滿足圖靈完備性，使其具有與人類等價的判斷思考能力。由於目前許多機器學習運算已逐步實現於硬體資源相對受限的端點裝置中，如何設計一輕量化之可適性人工智慧技術並滿足圖靈完備性，以及兼顧學習效能與可靠度，將是本計畫的主要研究方向。    為了要使人工智慧技術具備感知與自我調整之能力，異質類神經網路處理器架構將會是實現下一代人工智慧發展的關鍵技術。由於類神經網路是模仿生物大腦的神經網路，且大腦運作也牽涉到複雜的異質處理程序。因此，我們將類神經圖靈系統架構與人類腦部結構進行對應分層，並進行合適的技術對應，本計畫之研究範疇將歸納為大腦層、間腦層、腦幹層、及小腦層。大腦層相當於一個類神經處理系統，用以處理大部分機器學習的運算；間腦作為訊息傳至大腦的中繼站，將傳送大腦給運動系統的訊息做初步的處理，因此本計畫以此概念提出用於機器學習的資料壓縮技術；腦幹層主要負責各子腦系統間的信號傳輸，因此本計畫以此概念建構一異質類神經圖靈系統連線結構；小腦層負責維持整個大腦系統的根本性需求(如維持神經傳導正確性以及生命徵象等)，因此本計畫將運用此概念提出溫度感知可靠度類神經運算流程。透過各層的技術規劃，來使該類神經圖靈系統具有溫度感知、高運算可靠度、以及可適性等特色，並能實際應用於未來產業發展上。
abstract_en_plan: With the development of artificial intelligent (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT) techniques, it has led to the development of various industries and gradually changed human life. In general, the four waves of artificial intelligence technique are 1) Rule-based AI, 2) Machine Learning, 3) Cognitive AI, and 4) Self- learning AI. The first-wave AI technique involves numerous rules to make further judgments. The second-wave AI technique (most of the current AI techniques belong to) applies the concepts of statistics to train the machine through a massive number of data, which helps to find the correlation between the input data and the output results. Although the current AI techniques achieve good results, they cannot adapt to the scenario with the consecutive changing condition. Besides, it is difficult to realize the learning process because the current methods usually need big data to support the learning model.       To solve the design aforementioned constraints, the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has invested more than 2 billion US dollars in 2018 for the “AI Next” project, which aims to improve the adaptability of the general AI techniques. Hence, the third- or fourth-wave AI techniques will have the ability to self-adjust the involved computing model to adapt to the facing situations. To achieve this goal, the future AI technique must meet Turing completeness; thereby it has the same ability as the human to perform any cognition, recognition, and judgment. Because many AI operations are implemented on the resource-limited edge devices in recent years, it is the main design challenge to realize the goal of the edge Turing-AI operation. Hence, in this project, we will propose a lite and adaptable AI technique to meet Turing completeness. Besides, the learning efficiency and computing reliability is another focus in this project.       To quickly adapt to the diverse types of data in IoT applications, the heterogeneous neural network architecture is needed for the next-generation AI technique. Because the usual artificial neural network is used to mimic the biological brain, we analogize the layers of research topics in this project as a biological brain, which is composed of cerebrum, diencephalon, brain stem, and cerebellum. The cerebrum layer is like the general neural network processor, which performs most of the AI operations. The mesencephalic will initially process the information sent to the muscle. Thereby this project uses this concept to propose a data compression technique for the AI operation. The brainstem layer is used for the signal transmission between the sub-brain systems. This project is inspired by this concept and will construct an efficient interconnection in the heterogeneous neural Turing system. The cerebellum is responsible for maintaining the fundamental needs of the entire brain system, such as maintaining the correctness of nerve conduction and maintaining vital signs. Therefore, this project uses a similar concept to propose a thermal-aware reliable neural computing process. Through the layer-wise organization, the characteristics of the neural Turing system are temperature awareness, high computing reliability, and adaptability, which is proper to apply for future industrial development.

project_title: 結合強化式模糊積分二元化全卷積類神經網路與異質影像融合方法實現人工智慧機器人載具電路系統設計(II)
project_title_en: Development of Bnn Fully Convolutional Neural Network with Enhanced Fuzzy Integrals and Thermal Image Fusion Technology for Artificial Intelligent Soc-Fpga Embedded Platform (II)
institution: 國立虎尾科技大學電機工程系
abstract_zh_plan: 目前在機器人應用設計領域中，人工智慧即時影像處理與同步定位與地圖構建是現階段機器人領域計算門檻需求其中最高的，一般攝影機進行路面與平面區域的可行進區塊進行辨識、標記，藉由辨識、標記可即時做最佳的路線規劃，利用同步定位與地圖構建的方法，可將行走路線與掃描環境建立於遠端伺服裝置，使用者可透過地圖構建的使用者操作介面進行環境的觀測。在本次專題研究計畫提案中，其研究目在地面型UGV機器人載具人工智慧影像處理與異質影像融合技術之結合，以UGV載具搭載無線訊號傳輸設備、熱顯影鏡頭模組、光達LiDAR感測器以及運算核心AI SoC-FPGA人工智慧開發平台，並透過開源機器人作業系統ROS中的RVIZ顯示無人載具及時偵測周圍環境的狀態，以利加強周邊地形或是艱困環境的探索以及環景建構作業。本案提出的兩項重要演算方法為應用模糊積分之二元化全卷積神經網路演算方法偵測地面區域及熱顯影異質影像融合演算法。應用模糊積分之全卷積神經網路是透過一般影像鏡頭將其影像輸入於演算方法內，並結合超像素、Canny Edge Detector等方法進行分類與標註可行進區塊，最後經由二元化全卷積神經網路(BNN Fully Convolutional Neural Network，BNN-FCN)進行機器人載具地面範圍分析與判斷，為了提升其辨識精準度，團隊更運用了強化式模糊積分產生出辨識率更好的解決方案，結合二元化DeepLabv2對原先BNN-FCN的演算法進行優化。另外為了能夠可以快速將演算方法操作、執行於AI SoC-FPGA嵌入式開發平台之中，將探討不同類型二元化神經網路是否可以更有效的改善深度學習網路對FPGA晶片內部BRAM的負載量，有效減輕對AI運算核心的負擔。另一項演算方法是異質影像融合技術，其技術為將一般攝影鏡頭與熱顯像儀的影像視覺輸入至運算平台中，藉由特徵點擷取，最後將熱影像與一般影像完美融合成為單一影像輸出，提供操作者擁有更多的偵測資訊，方便機器人辨識異質熱點對各環境的辨識。目前第一年度已完成計劃前期工作準備、相關文件資訊蒐集研讀與分析，相關演算法於客製化AI SoC-FPGA嵌入式系統亦順利進行中，已初步將二元化BNN類神經網路結合增量技術後可將地面範圍偵測於FPGA架構上提升效能至95.63%，另異質影像融合技術分析測試皆進行中。
abstract_en_plan: Current in the field of robot system design, real-time machine learning processing and simultaneous localization and mapping in artificial intelligence are the highest among the computing power. The robot vision can prevent collision through estimating walkable areas, the identification and marking can be used to make the best route planning in real time. With the simultaneous localization and mapping, the walking route and the scanning environment can be established on the remote server, and the user can operate through the remote interface for map observation. In this research project proposal, our purpose is to develop ground-based robotic artificial intelligence image processing and heterogeneous image fusion technology. The ground-based platform will equip wireless signal transmission module, thermal camera module, and 2D LiDAR based on an AI SoC-FPGA with artificial intelligence heterogeneous computing ability. Meanwhile, the RVIZ within robot operating system supporting can enable remote control of the unmanned vehicles to detect the state of the surrounding environment in real-time in order to enhance the exploration of the surrounding terrain or the difficult environment. The proposed BNN Fully Convolutional Neural Network (BNN-FCN) is able to estimate the ground region, to improve its identification accuracy, an enhanced fuzzy integrals is applied to produce a better estimation results. In addition, in order to be able to operate the proposed method on an AI SoC-FPGA embedded development platform, we will also investigate different types of binary neural networks to explore more effectively binary deep learning network to reduce the internal BRAM loading in the FPGA chip. For thermal heterogeneous image fusion technology, which is to fusing visible image and thermal image into the computing platform, as well as labeling. It can provide the operator with more detection information, and providing analysis of the robot on the fusion technology and environment.	At present, the project has already completed the preliminary work preparation, paper survey and analysis of related information. BNN neural networks have been initially combined with the training dataset incremental method, the ground range detection can be improved to 95.63% on the AI SoC FPGA architecture. Meanwhile the analysis and testing of heterogeneous image fusion technology are all in progress.
